izzyondroid:com.flashsphere.privatednsqs.name: Private DNS Quick Setting
izzyondroid:com.flashsphere.privatednsqs.summary: Toggle Private DNS from Quick Settings (needs Shizuku or ADB for initial setup)
izzyondroid:com.flashsphere.privatednsqs.description:
Configure your preferred DNS modes to toggle in app and toggle your Private DNS mode from your quick settings panel.
 In order to change the Private DNS setting, this app requires the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission.
 This permission can only be granted either by Shizuku or in an ADB shell.
 Shizuku 
 Start Shizuku , then open this app, and the permission should be granted automatically.
 ADB
 Use the command: adb shell pm grant com.flashsphere.privatednsqs android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS 
 Check out private-dns-qs.web.app/help on the steps to use adb to grant the permission.
 If you prefer not to have a launcher icon on your home screen, check out the no-launcher version .

izzyondroid:io.alexrintt.kanade.name: Kanade
izzyondroid:io.alexrintt.kanade.summary: a minimalist darker Apk Extractor available for Android 4.4 or above
izzyondroid:io.alexrintt.kanade.description:
Kanade is a simple app that allows you to extract apk from your apps list. Fully open-source and zero-ads. Works for Android 4.4 or above.
 Installed apps from PlayStore doesn't expose their apk installation files by default. So if you want to share some app you will need to send the PlayStore link. So if you are offline or the app is no longer available on the PlayStore you won't be able to share the app.
 So here we are, whatever the reason, if you want to share some app directly through a p2p connection (Bluetooth, Wifi-Direct, etc.) you can use apk extractors! These kind of apps allow the user to extract the hidden apk files from almost any installed app to a visible location (e.g Downloads folder).

izzyondroid:org.nlckysolutions.privacyst.name: PrivacyStats
izzyondroid:org.nlckysolutions.privacyst.summary: Calculate your Android device’s privacy score based on installed apps.
izzyondroid:org.nlckysolutions.privacyst.description:
PrivacyStats checks your Android device’s privacy level based on installed packages.

fdroid:app.scratchpad.launcher.name: Scratchpad Launcher
fdroid:app.scratchpad.launcher.summary: A minimal launcher with an always-visible scratchpad. Zero ads.
fdroid:app.scratchpad.launcher.description:
Your phone as a piece of paper. 
 Scratchpad Launcher is a minimal Android home screen split in two: the top half is a plain text box that's always there, so you can write something down without opening any app. The bottom half is a small, fixed list of your most-used apps. Nothing else.
 FEATURES: 
 Always-visible scratchpad: Saved as you type, survives reboots, stored locally and excluded from Android backups.
 Light markdown: Headings, bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, code, tappable links, lists and to-do checkboxes you can tick with a tap.
 Type to launch: Swipe up, type a few letters, and the app opens as soon as there's one match.
 Sync as scratchpad.md: Optionally mirror the scratchpad into a folder, such as an Obsidian vault.
 Minimal app list: A handful of apps, no icons, no clutter. Rename, hide and align them.
 Gestures: Double tap to lock screen. Swipe left or right to open apps. Swipe down for notifications or search.
 Readable: Separate text sizes for the scratchpad and the launcher, dark and light themes.
 Privacy: No data collection, no accounts, no tracking. FOSS, licensed GPLv3.
 Launcher features: Dual apps, work profile and private space support.
 Accessibility Service: Used exclusively to let you turn off your phone's screen with a double-tap gesture. It is optional, disabled by default, and doesn't collect or share any data.
 This is a fork of Olauncher , a minimal ad-free launcher by tanujnotes, with the app grid cut down and a scratchpad put in its place.

fdroid:au.id.colby.nfcquicksettings.name: NFC Quick Settings
fdroid:au.id.colby.nfcquicksettings.summary: View NFC status, and quickly access NFC settings, from the Quick Settings menu
fdroid:au.id.colby.nfcquicksettings.description:
NFC Quick Settings is a simple, open source, utility for quickly checking the device's current NFC status, and enabling or disabling NFC with as few taps as possible.
NFC Quick Settings has no user interface of it's own. Instead, once installed, you will see a new "NFC" tile available when customising your Quick Settings menu. See "Add, remove, or move a setting" in Android Help for more information on customising the Quick Settings menu: https://support.google.com/android/answer/9083864?hl=en#customize_settings
Once the NFC Quick Settings tile has been added to your Quick Settings menu, the tile will show the current NFC status.
Android security limitations do not allow any third-party apps, such as this, to turn NFC on or off directly, so when tapped, the NFC Quick Settings tile will simply open the device's NFC Settings page (if the device has one), where you can enable or disable NFC as desired.
NFC Quick Settings also has an advanced mode that allows NFC to be toggled directly from the tile, without having to going the NFC Settings page. But this advanced mode requires special permissions, which can only be granted via the Android Debug Bridge on a desktop computer. You can read more about this mode at https://github.com/pcolby/nfc-quick-settings?tab=readme-ov-file#advanced-mode
NFC Quick Settings is freely available under the GPLv3 open source license. The source code is available at https://github.com/pcolby/nfc-quick-settings

fdroid:com.coboltforge.dontmind.multivnc.name: MultiVNC
fdroid:com.coboltforge.dontmind.multivnc.summary: VNC viewer that aims to be easy to use and fast
fdroid:com.coboltforge.dontmind.multivnc.description:
MultiVNC is an open-source VNC viewer that aims to be easy to use and fast. It includes the following features:
* Support for most VNC encodings including Tight.
* TLS support, i.e. AnonTLS and VeNCrypt, including support for self-signed certificates.

* UltraVNC Repeater support.
* Discovery of VNC servers advertising themselves via ZeroConf.
* Bookmarking of connections.
* Import and export of saved connections.
* Virtual mouse button controls with haptic feedback.
* Two-finger swipe gesture recognition.
* A super fast touchpad mode for local use.
* Hardware-accelerated OpenGL drawing and zooming.
* Supports server framebuffer resize.
* Copy&paste to and from Android.

fdroid:com.cvc953.localplayer.summary: Modern local music player with word-by-word synchronized lyrics support.

fdroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.hammer.a.name: Hammer
fdroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.hammer.a.summary: A simple tool for building stories.
fdroid:com.darkrockstudios.apps.hammer.a.description:
Please join our Discord to report issues! https://discord.gg/GTmgjZcupk
Multi-platform
This app is where ever you are. Your phone, tablet, desktop, laptop, this program can be installed and run, not simply a website-in-a-box, but instead using native client side technologies to provide the best experience possible.
Offline first
I was frustrated with most of the story writing software I was finding as they were using web technologies (aka: Web Page in a box) which always seems to run into problems while being used offline for long periods of time. Hammer is designed from the ground up to be entirely local, no internet connection required, ever.
Transparent Data
Your data is yours. It's not stored in the cloud, or some opaque database. It is stored in simple, human readable files, just using files and folders to define the project structure. You can open your OSes file browser and take a look for your self. If this program went away today you would be able to easily interact with your data.
Intelligent Syncing between devices
Your data can be synchronized between devices allowing you to work on your story from anywhere, and have no fear of a change on one device, overwriting a change on another device.
Optional and Self hosted Syncing
Syncing is entirely optional, you can install the client and use it on one device, or you can install the server and sync your data between devices.
Wear OS companion
Capture notes and story ideas from your wrist with the Wear OS app, then pick them up on your other devices. Dictate or type a quick note and file it under a project. Add the Capture tile to start a note or story idea in a single tap, or put the Hammer complication on your watch face to open a new note. The watch app syncs through your Hammer sync server.

fdroid:com.eightsines.firestrike.opensou.name: Fire Strike Retro
fdroid:com.eightsines.firestrike.opensou.summary: An old-school 3d-shooter with cartoon graphics from creators of Gloomy Dungeons.
fdroid:com.eightsines.firestrike.opensou.description:
Fire Strike Retro is an old–school 3d–shooter with cartoon graphics from creators of Gloomy Dungeons.
 Initially, we had an idea to take the Gloomy Dungeons 2 engine, use cool cartoon graphics (instead of 8-bit), change levels a little, and go on. But in the middle of the process it became clear that it would take much more time :)
 We completely redesigned the tutorial. We hope that it will be not too complicated for beginners, and, on the other hand, it will not be too dull for experienced players in 3d–action games.
 The minimap has completely changed. Instead of turning it on and off (as in the original Gloomy), it is now always visible. In addition, it always shows where to go (instead of arrows on the floor, as it was before), so you won’t get lost in endless labyrinths.
 The game was carefully rebalanced (it is a shame, but earlier we did it almost randomly). It’s up to you to decide whether we’ve done it well or not, but to our taste it became much more fun to play.
 We’ve added the ability to quickly change weapons (instead of constantly entering the menu). It seems to us that this is a handy feature, especially at the final levels, in order to quickly switch between grenades and winchester.
 And finally, the main feature that distinguishes this game from our previous ones is the use of procedural generation as a base for creating levels. Of course, we did not put the generated levels as is - each of them was corrected by hands with love. Nevertheless, it was procedural generation that set the basic structure and "rhythm" of the level. Perhaps, because of it, on some levels you will have to run back and forth, but, in our opinion, this adds something special to the game.
 Compared to Gloomy, this game is much more dynamic. No more boring monsters - only hardcore! If you loved 3D first person shooters (FPS), give this game a chance :)
 And briefly for the rest of the features:
 35 levels.
 7 different weapons.
 More than 5000 enemies.
 About 5 hours of gameplay.
 24 achievements.
 Each level have one or more secrets.
 Have fun!
 In version for F-Droid analytics and crash reporting were removed. The game may display non-personalized advertising from EightSines Studio.

fdroid:com.iceout.app.name: I.C.E Out
fdroid:com.iceout.app.summary: Community safety reporting — anonymous ICE activity tracking
fdroid:com.iceout.app.description:
I.C.E Out is an ad-free, open-source community safety tool for reporting
Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity after it occurs. Built with
privacy-first principles — no accounts, no tracking, no data sold.
 Anonymous report submission (no personal data collected)
 Community-sourced activity map with color-coded markers
 Report types: raid, checkpoint, surveillance, patrol, transport, other
 Know Your Rights resources & emergency contacts
 ICE facility directory
 OpenFreeMap vector tiles + Leaflet/MapLibre
 Fully offline-capable (mock mode when backend unavailable)
 Self-hostable Supabase backend — users can configure their own
 Reports expire after 72 hours
 Zero proprietary dependencies
 No analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party SDKs
All reports are view-only observations logged after incidents occur.
This app does not encourage physical interference with law enforcement operations.
 Network usage: By default, the app connects to a community backend hosted by the developer (Supabase) to share crowd-sourced sighting reports. This can be changed to any self-hosted Supabase instance in the app's configuration. Typed addresses are geocoded via nominatim.openstreetmap.org. Map tiles are loaded from tiles.openfreemap.org. Facility location data is bundled with the app and never sent to any server.

fdroid:com.kounex.obsBlade.name: OBS Blade
fdroid:com.kounex.obsBlade.summary: OBS remote for your stream - scenes, audio, stats and chat, all in your pocket.
fdroid:com.kounex.obsBlade.description:
DISCLAIMER: This app is not in any way affiliated with OBS (Open Broadcaster Software). It's an unofficial, free and open source app to control OBS (https://github.com/Kounex/obs_blade)
OBS Blade is your stream companion. Connect to OBS over your network and run your whole show from your phone or tablet - no need to jump back to your PC mid-stream.
Built for phone and tablet alike. Needs OBS Studio 28 or newer (OBS WebSocket 5 is built in).
- Start and stop your stream, recording, replay buffer and virtual camera
- Switch scenes, with studio mode and transitions

- Mix audio with live volume meters, or mute in one tap

- Twitch, YouTube, Kick and Owncast chat in its own tab - or next to your controls while you're live
- Arrange the dashboard your way
- Quick Connect: scan the QR code from OBS' WebSocket settings
This is the open source build: no in-app purchases, no tracking. The App Store / Google Play version additionally sells "Pro" extras (native chat engines, remote access from anywhere, activity feed, chat read aloud, custom themes) - those aren't part of this build.
Got a bug, an idea or a feature request? Get in touch - on GitHub or at contact@kounex.com

fdroid:com.neuronencrypt.app.name: Neuron Encrypt
fdroid:com.neuronencrypt.app.summary: Local file encryption. No accounts. No internet. No compromise.
fdroid:com.neuronencrypt.app.description:
Neuron Encrypt is a local file encryption app that keeps your files private. No accounts, no internet, no cloud — everything happens on your device.
 Security 
• AES-256-GCM-SIV (RFC 8452) — nonce-misuse resistant authenticated encryption
• Argon2id key derivation (256 MiB memory cost) — GPU/ASIC resistant
• HKDF-SHA512 key expansion with per-version domain separation
• VAULTX04 format with authenticated header (AAD on every chunk)
• 100% Safe Rust core — zero unsafe blocks in the crypto library
• Zero internet permissions, zero storage permissions (uses SAF)
• Keys and plaintext wiped from RAM with Zeroizing on drop
 Features 
• Encrypt any file to a .vx2 container
• Decrypt .vx2 files back to original
• Batch processing — queue multiple files with one passphrase
• Auto-detects encrypt vs decrypt mode from file magic bytes
• Cancel mid-operation (within one 1 MiB chunk)
• Password strength meter
• Secure wipe original file after encryption (with confirmation)
• Open source (GPLv3)
 How it works 
1. Select a file (or drop one from your file manager)
2. Enter a strong passphrase
3. Tap ENCRYPT — your file is encrypted to .vx2 beside the original
4. Optionally wipe the original file
Your passphrase never leaves the device. There is no recovery — if you forget the passphrase, your files are gone. This is by design.
 Privacy 
• No analytics, no tracking, no telemetry
• No network permissions in the APK
• No storage permissions (uses Android Storage Access Framework)
• No backup (android:allowBackup=false)
• Source code available at gitlab.com/theredhacker0345/neuron-encrypt
 Technical specs 
• Cipher: AES-256-GCM-SIV with BE32 streaming (1 MiB chunks)
• KDF: Argon2id (m=256 MiB, t=3, p=4, 64-byte output)
• RNG: OS CSPRNG (OsRng via getrandom)
• Min Android: 7.0 (API 24)
• ABIs: arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, x86

fdroid:io.github.mickaelmagniez.windbubb.name: Wind Bubble
fdroid:io.github.mickaelmagniez.windbubb.summary: See where the wind hits you, on top of your navigation app.
fdroid:io.github.mickaelmagniez.windbubb.description:
Wind Bubble floats a small dial on top of your navigation app and shows where the wind hits you
relative to your direction of travel: headwind, crosswind or tailwind.
The dial is locked on your heading — the top is always where you are going — and a coloured marker
sits on the ring at the angle the wind comes from: red straight in your face, amber across, green
pushing you along.

* Floating bubble over any app, draggable, tap to expand a short summary
* Live wind, gusts and temperature from Open-Meteo (no account, no API key)
* Head/tail and crosswind components, with the side it blows from

fdroid:io.github.sspanak.tt9.name: Traditional T9
fdroid:io.github.sspanak.tt9.summary: A T9 keyboard inspired by the classic Nokia phones of the 2000s.
fdroid:io.github.sspanak.tt9.description:
TT9 is a Nokia-style 12-key T9 keyboard. It provides predictive text input in 50+ languages, configurable hotkeys, clipboard, undo/redo, and extensive customization. It works on touchscreens, physical keypads, and TV remote controls. And best of all, it doesn't spy on you!
Supported languages: Arabic, Belarusian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Simplified Chinese (Pinyin), Traditional Chinese (Bopomofo), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Estonian, Farsi, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Gujarati (phonetic), Hebrew, Hindi (phonetic), Hinglish, Hungarian, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese (Romaji), Kiswahili, Korean, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Norwegian (Bokmål and Nynorsk), Polish, Portuguese (European and Brazilian), Romanian, Russian, Serbian (Cyrillic and Latin), Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Moroccan Tamazight (Latin and Tifinagh), Thai, Toki Pona, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Yiddish.
Philosophy:
- No spying, tracking, telemetry, reports, or data collection of any sort.
- No ads or unnecessary bells and whistles. It only does its job, typing.
- No unnecessary network connections. The Full version operates entirely offline, and the Lite version connects only to download dictionaries from GitHub. Voice Input may require Internet access, depending on the available voice services.
- Open-source, permitting you to verify all the above yourself.
- Created with help from the entire community.
- Things it will (probably) never have: QWERTY layout, swipe-typing, GIFs, and stickers.
- Not intended as a clone of TouchPal, Sony Ericsson, KaiOS, Samsung, etc. While it captures the feel of the classics, TT9 offers its own experience and won’t replicate any device or app exactly.
Note: the Google Play version is almost identical to the lite version, except that it includes extra "premium" features that are closed-source. Nevertheless, none of the extra components compromises the principles outlined above.

fdroid:net.thunderbird.android.beta.name: Thunderbird Beta for Testers
fdroid:net.thunderbird.android.beta.summary: Thunderbird is a 100% open source, privacy focused email app.
fdroid:net.thunderbird.android.beta.description:
Help make the next Thunderbird release as awesome as possible by downloading Thunderbird Beta and getting early access to the latest features and bug fixes before they're officially released. Your testing and feedback are important, so please report bugs, rough edges, and share your thoughts with us!
Find our bug tracker, source code, and wiki at https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android .
We’re always happy to welcome new developers, designers, documenters, translators, bug triagers and friends. Visit us at https://thunderbird.net/participate to get started.
Thunderbird is a powerful, privacy-focused email app. Effortlessly manage multiple email accounts from one app, with a Unified Inbox option for maximum productivity. Built on open-source technology and supported by a dedicated team of developers alongside a global community of volunteers, Thunderbird never treats your private data as a product. Supported solely by financial contributions from our users, so you never have to see ads mixed in with your emails again.
 What you can do 
 Ditch multiple apps and webmail. Use one app, with an optional Unified Inbox, to power through your day.
 Enjoy a privacy-friendly email client that never collects or sells your personal data. We directly connect you to your email provider. That’s it!
 Take your privacy to the next level by using OpenPGP email encryption (PGP/MIME) with the “OpenKeychain” app, to encrypt and decrypt your messages.
 Choose to sync your email instantly, at set intervals, or on-demand. However you want to check your email, it’s up to you!
 Find your important messages using both local and server-side search.
 Compatibility 
 Thunderbird works with IMAP and POP3 protocols, supporting a wide range of email providers, including Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, iCloud, and more.
 Why use Thunderbird 
 The trusted name in email for over 20 years - now on Android.
 Thunderbird is fully funded by voluntary contributions from our users. We don’t mine your personal data. You are never the product.
 Made by a team that is as efficiency-minded as you are. We want you to spend minimal time using the app while getting maximum in return.
 With contributors from all over the world, Thunderbird for Android has been translated into more than 20 languages.
 Supported by MZLA Technologies Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Mozilla Foundation.
 Open Source and Community 
 Thunderbird is free and open source, which means its code is available to see, modify, use and share freely. Its license also ensures that it will be free forever. You can think of Thunderbird as a gift from thousands of contributors to you.
 We develop in the open with regular, transparent updates on our blog and mailing lists.
 Our user support is powered by our global community. Find the answers you need, or step into the role of a contributor - whether it’s answering questions, translating the app, or telling your friends and family about Thunderbird.

flathub:org.aegisub.Aegisub.name: Aegisub
flathub:org.aegisub.Aegisub.description:
Aegisub is a free, cross-platform open source tool for creating and modifying subtitles. Aegisub
 makes it quick and easy to time subtitles to audio, and features many powerful tools for styling
 them, including a built-in real-time video preview.
 Aegisub was originally created as a tool to make typesetting, particularly in anime fansubs,
 a less painful experience. At the time of the start of the project, many other programs that supported
 the Advanced Substation Alpha format lacked (and in many cases, still lack; development on several
 competing programs have since been dropped for various reasons completely unrelated to Aegisub)
 many vital functions, or were too buggy and/or unreliable to be really useful.
 Since then, Aegisub has grown into a fully fledged, highly customizable subtitle editor. It
 features a lot of convenient tools to help you with timing, typesetting, editing and translating
 subtitles, as well as a powerful scripting environment called Automation (originally mostly intended
 for creating karaoke effects, Automation can now be used much else, including creating macros and
 various other convenient tools).
 Some highlights of Aegisub:
 Simple and intuitive yet powerful interface for editing subtitles
 Support for many formats and character sets
 Powerful video mode
 Visual typesetting tools
 Intuitive and customizable audio timing mode
 Fully scriptable through the Automation module

flathub:org.standardnotes.standardnotes.name: Standard Notes
flathub:org.standardnotes.standardnotes.summary: A simple and private place for your notes, thoughts, and life's work
flathub:org.standardnotes.standardnotes.description:
Standard Notes is a simple and private notes app. It syncs your notes securely across all your
 devices, including your Android devices, Windows, iOS, Linux, and Web.
 Private means your notes are end-to-end encrypted, so only you can read your notes. Even we
 can't read the contents of your notes.
 Simple means it does one job and does it well. Standard Notes is a safe and lasting place for
 your life's work. Our focus is making it easy to write notes wherever you are and syncing them
 with encryption to all your devices.
 Our users love us for:
 Personal Notes
 Tasks & Todos
 Passwords & Keys
 Code & Technical Procedures
 Private Journal
 Meeting Notes
 Cross-platform Scratchpad
 Books, Recipes, & Movies
 Health & Fitness Log
 Standard Notes comes free with:
 Seamless sync across all your devices, with easy to use applications on Android, Windows,
 Linux, iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web browsers.
 Offline access, so you can access your downloaded notes even without a connection.
 No limit on number of devices.
 No limit on number of notes.
 Passcode lock protection, along with fingerprint protection.
 A tagging system to organize your notes (like #work, #ideas, #passwords, #crypto).
 The ability to pin, lock, protect, and move notes to trash, which allows you to recover deleted
 notes until the trash is emptied.
 Standard Notes is completely open-source, which means when we say your notes are encrypted with
 AES-256 encryption, and that only you can read your notes, you don't have to take our word for
 it. Our code is open to the world to audit.
 We made Standard Notes simple because longevity is important to us. We want to make sure we're
 here, protecting your notes, for the next hundred years. You shouldn't have to find a new notes
 app every year.
 To sustain our development, we offer an optional paid program called Standard Notes Extended.
 Extended gives you access to powerful tools including:
 Productivity editors (like Markdown, Code, Spreadsheets)
 Beautiful themes (like Midnight, Focus, Solarized Dark)
 Powerful cloud tools including daily backups of your encrypted data delivered to your email
 inbox every day, or backed up to your cloud provider (like Dropbox and Google Drive).
 You can learn more about Extended at standardnotes.com/extended.

 The app allows you to adjust attributes like brightness or contrast as well as add effects like a vignette or a border. It also allows you to flip, rotate and crop the image to your heart's desire. If you're a pro, you can even preview your edits on a histogram.

fedora-packages:coin-or-HiGHS/coin-or-Hi.name: coin-or-HiGHS
fedora-packages:coin-or-HiGHS/coin-or-Hi.description: HiGHS is a high performance serial and parallel solver for large scale sparse linear optimization problems of the form ``` Minimize (1/2) x^TQx + c^Tx subject to L <= Ax <= U; l <= x <= u ``` where `Q` must be positive semi-definite and, if `Q` is zero, there may be a requirement that some of the variables take integer values. Thus HiGHS can solve linear programming (LP) problems, convex quadratic programming (QP) problems, and mixed integer programming (MIP) problems. It is mainly written in C++, but also has some C. HiGHS has primal and dual revised simplex solvers, originally written by Qi Huangfu and further developed by Julian Hall. It also has an interior point solver for LP written by Lukas Schork, an active set solver for QP written by Michael Feldmeier, and a MIP solver written by Leona Gottwald. Other features have been added by Julian Hall and Ivet Galabova, who manages the software engineering of HiGHS and interfaces to C, C#, FORTRAN, Julia and Python. Although HiGHS is freely available under the MIT license, we would be pleased to learn about users' experience and give advice via email sent to highsopt@gmail.com.

firefox-addons:999984.name: Sidebery
firefox-addons:999984.summary: Vertical tabs tree and bookmarks in sidebar with advanced containers configuration, grouping and many other features.
firefox-addons:999984.description:
Sidebery provides the list of tabs structured in a tree, bookmarks and history within the customizable panels. It aims to be fast and configurable.
 Notice: Sidebery may conflict with addons that handle position of new tabs (e.g. Tree Style Tabs) or addons that move/sort tabs, which may result in unexpected behavior or broken tabs state at initialization. To avoid potential issues, please, disable such addons in Add-ons Manager page (about:addons).
 Some of the key features: 
 - Tabs - Simple flat list or tree with the option to set tree limit.
- Group tabs (aka folders) with a custom name helps organize open pages.
- Tabs colorization: Automatic per-domain/URL or manual.
- Tabs sorting: by title, url or access time
- Automatic unloading of tabs in a folded branch / inactive panel.
- Customizable tab title.
- ... - Bookmarks - Tree or chronological view.
- Sort by name, URL or creation time
- Basic operations: open in... / create / edit / delete.
- Ability to highlight open bookmarks and activate the corresponding tab instead of opening a new one when clicked.
- Automatically delete a bookmark on opening from "Other Bookmarks" folder or configured bookmarks panel.
- ... - Tabs / Bookmarks panels - Organize your browsing with panels of tabs/bookmarks.
- Convert open tabs in the panel to bookmarks and vice versa.
- Automatically move tabs by URL to configured panel.
- ... - Containers - Bind container to the tabs panel.
- Automatically reopen tab in the target container by URL.
- Setup proxy config and UserAgent header for tabs in a container.
- ... - Customizable context menu Sidebery allows you to change the context menu for tabs and bookmarks. You can enable/disable/move options, create sub-menus/separators. - Customizable mouse/keyboard controls - Option to switch tabs with mouse-wheel.
- Configurable drag and drop behavior.
- A growing list of available actions for mouse/keyboard bindings. - Customizable styles Sidebery provides full control of styles for sidebar and group page via variables and custom CSS. - Snapshots You can setup auto snapshots that will keep info about open windows and tabs. 
 Privacy policy 
 - Sidebery does not engage in ad targeting, data collection, or other activities that could compromise your privacy.
- By default, all data is stored locally on your machine.
- Sidebery sends data only when synchronization is enabled and only to chosen provider.
- You can optionally enable one or more synchronization providers (third-party services) to sync your data across multiple devices.
More detailed information can be found on this page: https://github.com/mbnuqw/sidebery/blob/v5/PRIVACY.md 
 Source code 
 Source code can be found here: https://github.com/mbnuqw/sidebery 
 Permissions 
 - "Access recently closed tabs" - needed for the "Undo close tab" function.
- "Access browser tabs" - needed to get info and control tabs.
- "Store unlimited amount of client-side data" - needed to store favicons cache and snapshots. 
 Optional permissions 
 - "Access your data for all websites" and "Control browser proxy settings"
 Required for the next features:
- Context menu option for cleaning cookies
- Proxy and url rules of containers
- Page-screenshots for the group page and windows selection panel
- Changing the User-Agent per container - "Hide and show browser tabs" Required for the next features:
- Hiding tabs on inactive panels
- Hiding folded tabs - "Read and modify bookmarks" - needed for bookmarking the tabs and bookmarks panel functionality.
- "Access browsing history" - for history panel functionality.
- "Input data to the clipboard" - Context menu option for copying urls of tabs and bookmarks
- "Download files and read and modify the browser’s download history" - Auto-export of snapshots.
Note: You can deny these permissions at any time on the settings page. 
 Notes 
 - Firefox doesn't allow addons to hide the native (horizontal) tab bar. To achieve that, you can use userChrome.css hacks .

firefox-addons:3126582.name: DarkScout Password Manager
firefox-addons:3126582.summary: Zero-knowledge password manager. Your master password never leaves your device. Vault items are encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM, and sign-in uses OPAQUE, so the server never sees your password.
firefox-addons:3126582.description:
Description:
DarkScout Password Manager stores your logins in an encrypted vault and fills them in when you need them. Encryption and decryption happen in your browser. Our servers only hold ciphertext.
How your data is protected
Your master password is never sent. Sign-in uses OPAQUE (RFC 9497), a password-authenticated key exchange. The server checks that you know your password without ever receiving it or a hash of it.
Every item is encrypted on your device. Each vault item is encrypted separately with AES-256-GCM before it is uploaded.
Keys are derived with Argon2id. Separate salts keep the authentication key apart from the encryption key.
Changing your password is fast. Your vault key is re-wrapped under the new password, so the whole vault doesn't need to be re-encrypted.
Auto-lock. Decrypted keys stay in memory only and are wiped after a period of inactivity (5, 15 or 30 minutes; 5 by default).
Phishing-resistant matching. Credentials are offered only on the exact domain they were saved for, so look-alike sites don't get them.
Features
Autofill saved logins on the current site from the popup or an in-page prompt.
Offers to save new credentials when you submit a login form.
Strong password generator in the popup and the right-click menu.
Right-click menu options: "Autofill Credentials" and "Generate Strong Password".
Vault syncs with the DarkScout web app at getdarkscout.com .
Add, edit and delete items from the toolbar popup.
Permissions
Access your data for all websites: needed to find login forms, autofill credentials and offer to save new ones. Page content is never sent to our servers.
Storage: keeps your settings and encrypted session state.
Tabs / active tab: finds which site you're on so matching logins can be shown.
Alarms: runs the auto-lock timer.
Context menus: adds the right-click autofill and generator options.
You need a free DarkScout account. Create one in the extension or at https://getdarkscout.com/services/password-manager/

firefox-addons:976890.name: Bookmark Tree for Tree Style Tab
firefox-addons:976890.summary: Bookmark and restore Tree Style Tab data.
firefox-addons:976890.description:
⚠ This addon extends and works best with Tree Style Tab . (There is also support for other similar addons such as Sidebery .)
This extension can bookmark and restore tree structures for Tree Style Tab.
Use the context menu item on a parent tab to bookmark its tree. You can also select multiple tabs with the Multiple Tab Handler extension and bookmark the tree information for all of them via that extensions context menu. In Firefox 64 and later you can use Firefox own multi-select feature.
To restore trees from bookmarks you right click on a bookmark folder saved with this extension and click the "Restore Tree" item. Due to API limitations this context menu item is only visible for bookmarks in the toolbar and in the bookmark toolbar button menu. The context menu item can't be used for bookmarks in the sidebar or in the library window. This limitation has been fixed in Firefox 66 and later where the context menu item does work on bookmarks in the sidebar and in the library window.
If you don't want to restore the the contents of a whole bookmark folder then you can use the context menu item on a bookmark instead. This extension will then look at the folder that the bookmark is in and figure out what bookmarks it is parent for and open them as child tabs for the bookmark's tab. If the bookmark's tab wouldn't have any children it will instead look at what bookmark represents its parent and open that together with its child tabs. The bookmark folder that you use this in needs to have been saved with this extension.
Note: this extension can't restore trees that were bookmarked with the legacy version of Tree Style Tab.
 Bookmarks support in Tree Style Tab v3.2.0: 
Tree Style Tab v3.2.0 and later have support for saving tree structures to bookmarks without installing this extension. The way Tree Style Tab saves tree data is different from how this extension used to save it. Tree Style Tab prefixes bookmark titles with a number of " > " characters while this extension used bookmark separators to save the tree structure. 
Version 4.0 of this extension adds support for restoring and saving tree data using Tree Style Tab's data format but by default it will still use bookmark separators so that it is easier to restore any bookmarks that are already saved using that strategy. There is also an extra context menu item for bookmarks that can migrate data from one bookmark format to another, note that this context menu item is disabled by default and needs to be enabled in the extension's option page.
 Comparison with Tree Style Tab v3.4.8: 
 This extension can be used to bookmark partial tree, that is to say a parent tab and a selection of its child tabs. If you select multiple tabs and not all of a parent tab's children are selected then those tabs won't be bookmarked while Tree Style Tab will bookmark the entire trees even if not all of the tabs are selected.
 Tree Style Tab's restore tree functionality can only be used for entire bookmark folders while this extension can be used to also restore a single tree inside a bookmark folder. (Edit: Tree Style Tab's developer has released a separate addon TST Open Bookmarks as Partial Tree that offers this functionality.)
 The unloaded tabs restored by this extension uses the bookmarks' titles as the names of the created tabs until they are loaded while Tree Style Tab uses the URLs.
 Tree Style Tab offers a menu to choose where you want to bookmark your tabs while this extension always saves them to the default bookmark location.
 Tree Style Tab has better compatibility with containers .

Download AccuWeather®, The Most Trusted Weather App. Get real-time weather alerts and hyperlocal weather updates with proven Superior Accuracy™. Access an award-winning weather tracker with live radar, lightning alerts, weather forecasts, and much more, helping you make the best decisions and be more in the know through weather warnings.
Be prepared with storm radar when it matters most. Get real-time live radar and weather alerts for hurricanes, tornadoes, snow or ice, flooding rains, mudslides, high winds, extreme heat or cold, polluted air, wildfires, smoke, or any other major weather event.
AccuWeather's Hurricane Tracker, storm radar, live radar, and weather warnings are almost always significantly more accurate, provide greater advance notice, and communicate clearly with more detail and value than all other sources.
AccuWeather can be downloaded for free from the App Store and provides proven weather tracker alerts with Superior Accuracy™, severe weather alerts, storm radar, hurricane tracker, live radar notifications, and daily forecasts with hourly and Minute-by-Minute® weather updates tailored for any location. AccuWeather's accurate forecasts and alerts will better protect your family and keep them safer.
The app delivers more reliable and more accurate weather forecasts from wind speed to temperature and tracks severe weather with animated radar. Track AccuWeather exclusives, including MinuteCast®, AccuWeather RealFeel® Temperature, AccuWeather Snow Probability Index™, and more in your area. Forecasts can be localized to your exact street address.
AccuWeather App Features:
• NEW: Personalized Experiences — curated and collected weather tracker based on your lifestyle and interests (School, Fall Foliage, Pets, and UV & Sun to start – more soon).
• Maps to help you visualize wildfire smoke impact areas, as well as localized air quality index (AQI) tracking to help plan outdoor activity and exposure.
• Exclusive MinuteCast® – hyperlocal precipitation type/intensity forecast, plus start/end times for rain/snow, next 4 hours, pinpointed to street address or GPS in 210 countries/territories.
• RealFeel® Temperature — most accurate "feels like" description, based on 10+ factors (sunshine intensity, wind, humidity, air density).
• RealFeel Shade™ — exclusive sun vs. shade "feels like" difference.
• Independently verified as the most accurate source for hurricane trackers, forecasts, and weather warnings, outperforming the National Hurricane Center and all other known sources.
• Live radar + exclusive AccuLightning™ for precise, real-time lightning strike tracking. AccuLumen Brightness Index™ — day brightness characterization for outdoor planning and UV protection.
• WinterCast® — detailed snow/ice storm radar and forecasting, min/max snowfall in inches per storm.
UPGRADE TO PREMIUM
• Upgrade to Premium+ to access more detailed extended forecasts, often more advanced alerts, and menus to customize your preferences — in an ad-free experience designed to help you stay better informed and better prepared. 
• NEW: Premium+ Family Plan — protect everyone in your household with up to six individual profiles for localized weather alerts, personalized experiences, and the proven Superior Accuracy™ built into Premium+ plans.
• AccuWeather Alerts™ — severe weather warnings and alerts, often with the most advanced notice 10-Day Hourly Forecast Graphics (HourCast™) Longer Range Forecasts — 90-day daily, 10-day HourCast™
• Premium Widgets and compatibility with iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV
• Customizable health/activity views (allergies, asthma, migraine, etc.)

bluejetty:00175070:ios.summary:

Explore i
bluejetty:00175070:ios.description:
iPacemaker Device is an independent, multibrand technical and educational reference for electrophysiologists, hospital device technicians, and medical-device company specialists working with cardiac implantable electronic devices.
Explore information on more than 7,000 pacemakers, ICDs, CRT devices, cardiac monitors, and leads from 60 manufacturers.
TECHNICAL DATA
Review device specifications, physical characteristics, dimensions, diagnostic features, and programming parameters.
CONNECTOR HEADERS
Examine connector layouts, port types, lead configurations, and documented tool specifications. Find device records with compatible connector-header characteristics and explore CSP configurations.
MANUFACTURER ADVISORIES
Access technical notes and safety communications included in the database and organized by product.
MRI DOCUMENTATION
Explore manufacturer-published MRI conditions for hypothetical device-and-lead combinations. This educational reference does not determine MRI eligibility for an individual patient or implanted system.
ALGORITHMS
Review more than 70 manufacturer-specific algorithms organized by manufacturer and technical or clinical scope.
ANALYTICS
Explore descriptive charts based on information contained in the dataset, including device longevity and survival data. Analytics do not predict the performance of an individual implanted device or recommend device selection.
COMPARE
Review specifications, programming options, longevity charts, and survival curves across multiple device records without generating treatment or device recommendations.
Some content and features require a subscription.
iPacemaker Device is intended solely for professional education and technical reference. It is not intended for diagnosis, patient-specific assessment, treatment selection, device programming, MRI eligibility, or emergency use. Always consult current manufacturer documentation and applicable clinical and institutional protocols.
iPacemaker is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any cardiac-device manufacturer. Company names, product names, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

bluejetty:00069150:ios.description:
AI Machine Modeled tones player on the go
• Play, practice and record anywhere with your TONEX Tone Models on iPhone and iPad
• Standalone universal app and plug-in compatible with AUv3 host apps
• Enjoy the exact same tone and sound-shaping tools as on Mac/PC
• Browse, search and download additional Tone Models from TONEX in ToneNET
• Edit and save presets on your iPhone or iPad
• Free to download with 20 premium must-have and 20 à-la-carte Tone Models
• Connect to one of our iRig interfaces for the ultimate mobile experience
Your dream rig always with you
TONEX lets you experience breakthrough AI Machine Modeling™ Tone Models anywhere. Play, practice and record on the go using the most authentic and hyper-realistic gear models ever made. This free app lets you access your Premium Tone Model library anywhere with seamless sync, for a limitless supply of inspiration.
More tone, more playing, more fun! TONEX puts the world’s most iconic guitar and bass gear right in your pocket with realism like you never imagined.
Plug into the experience
TONEX offers the most hyper-realistic guitar and bass tones ever thanks to IK’s advanced AI Machine Modeling™. Feel the warmth and dynamic response of real amps and pedals right on your iPhone or iPad as never before.
Connect one of our mobile interfaces to practice and jam along with your favorite songs or record guitar and bass tracks with ease when inspiration strikes.
Standalone or inside your favorite recording apps
TONEX works as a standalone iPhone and iPad app, but also supports AUv3 to work as a plug-in inside top AU host apps like GarageBand, Cubasis 3, Auria Pro and many more.
Powerful tone shaping
Tweak your tone to perfection using a built-in compressor, pre- and post-amp EQ, noise gate and beautiful stereo reverbs using IK’s latest award-winning algorithms.
Built-in VIR™ cabinet technology lets you place and adjust microphones with stunning accuracy, and all your edits with TONEX can be saved as presets.
A limitless library of gear and tone
Explore user-created Tone Models in the new TONEX section of ToneNET, IK’s online tone-sharing platform.
You can instantly search, filter, demo and download a massive range of Premium and user-generated Tone Models.
Any user or paid Tone Model you download is yours to keep forever and use with TONEX app, TONEX Mac/PC and inside AmpliTube 5 with seamless integration of Premium Tone Models between all your devices. For subscriptions, user or paid Tone Models work exclusively with TONEX app while your subscription is active.
Access your real gear anywhere
Since TONEX works across all platforms, you can easily use TONEX Mac/PC to model your own gear and bring it anywhere. 
Model your own gear, post Tone Models on ToneNET and then download them to your mobile device. Tweak settings on a plane, jam in a hotel room, record at a remote studio, the TONEX brings your signature sound along for the experience with the same ultra-accurate Tone Models as the desktop version.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.ikmultimedia.com/privacy

Welcome to RIDETRIBE – Where the beat moves you, the rhythm drives you and the Tribe pushes you!
RIDE TRIBE is more than just an indoor cycling studio – it`s a movement where we ride to the rhythm of resilience, innovation, dedication, and empowerment. Together, we embrace challenges, overcome obstacles, and grow stronger with every pedal stroke. Our community thrives on unwavering support and shared commitment, empowering every individual to take charge of their health, achieve their goals, and transform their life—one beat, one ride, and one breakthrough at a time. 
Why RIDETRIBE?
• Community-Driven Experience: Ride alongside a tribe that supports, encourages, and celebrates your journey.

Join the movement. Find your rhythm. Ride with your tribe.
Download RIDETRIBE today and take your ride to the next level!

bluejetty:00149501:ios.summary: Through HealthTap, you get to do what doctors do best; use your expertise and compassion to help people get the care they deserve. With the HealthTap for Doctors app, you can keep making a difference in people's lives even while you're on t
bluejetty:00149501:ios.description:
Through HealthTap, you get to do what doctors do best; use your expertise and compassion to help people get the care they deserve. With the HealthTap for Doctors app, you can keep making a difference in people's lives even while you're on the go. And, if you're in the HealthTap Medical Group and treating patients, our app allows you to conduct urgent care or primary care video visits with patients wherever you are.
HOW IT WORKS
HELP PEOPLE by providing informational answers to health questions from our community of members and review your colleagues' answers.
JOIN THE HEALTHTAP MEDICAL GROUP so you can increase your income through providing high-quality, compassionate virtual primary & urgent care.
PROVIDE PRIMARY CARE AND/OR URGENT CARE to patients via video visits. Complete each visit with a personalized treatment plan, including prescriptions, specialist recommendations, and lab tests, when appropriate.
TEXT WITH YOUR PRIMARY CARE PATIENTS to improve patient experiences and help build and maintain great doctor-patient relationships.
ELIMINATE THE WAITING ROOM by scheduling primary care appointment times that work best for your patients and by giving them quick access to urgent care requests 365 days a year.
FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS — providing great care — by taking advantage of intuitive, time-saving features, such as the app’s task management dashboards and doctor-friendly design.
WHAT DOCTORS ARE SAYING
“HealthTap provides an invaluable service, and I’m proud to be part of it.” - Dr. Veres
“HealthTap is a great experience!! It is absolutely awesome to be able to help people on such a global level. That’s what we all went to medical school for, to help people, and HealthTap gives us a great forum to do just that, on such an amazing level.” - Dr. Ferranti
“When I share the mission statement and vision of HealthTap to other doctors, it has been transformative offline! I’ve had doctors come up, hug me, and thank me for introducing them to HealthTap at the medical school where I teach” - Dr. Iwata

bluejetty:00127005:ios.description:
A compass is an instrument used to determine direction.
This app helps you find your bearings while hiking, traveling, or when visibility is limited due to fog.
The compass app determines the cardinal directions (north, south, east, and west) using the Earth's magnetic field.
This compass app displays GPS altitude.
It also shows the bearing (azimuth) at the top of the screen.
The application allows you to share your current location with others and view your position on a map.
To view the aurora, use this compass app to find north in the Northern Hemisphere and south in the Southern Hemisphere.
This compass app displays the tilt of the compass and helps indicate accurate directions.
You can view today’s sunrise and sunset times. Select a date on the calendar to calculate the sunrise and sunset times for that date.

bluejetty:00037112:ios.summary:
We believe that every home search is a conversation.
HomeSpotter is beautiful, mobile-first home search, with built-in chat that makes collaboration fast, easy and fun.
We strive to provide an experience that’s easier and better for consu
bluejetty:00037112:ios.description:
We believe that every home search is a conversation.
HomeSpotter is beautiful, mobile-first home search, with built-in chat that makes collaboration fast, easy and fun.
We strive to provide an experience that’s easier and better for consumers and their agents. And we believe it can be done in a way that benefits the broker and MLS, too.
Agents and consumers have, for too long, had to copy, paste, email, and text property links all over the place as they went through their home search.
This didn't make much sense to us.
So, our idea: combine a great mobile property search experience with a familiar text message like interface so that working and communicating with others through a home search was simple. 
Imagine texting property photo slideshows, not just links; enabling multiple conversations between your friends and family; even enabling chat between two agents that have full access to agent-only listing information. 
Share, save, comment, chat ... messaging meets home search. 100% mobile, 100% better than the old way. That's what the next evolution of HomeSpotter is all about.
----
HomeSpotter works with many MLSs around North America - MLSs like California Regional MLS (CRMLS), NorthwestMLS (NWMLS), NorthstarMLS, Triangle MLS, Real Estate Board of Greater Vancouver (REBGV), Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB), RealtyMobi, Heartland MLS, HiCentral / Honolulu Board of Realtors, Spokane Association of REALTORs, MetroList Services, BAREIS, Realtors Association of the Palm Beaches (RAPB / BeachesMLS), Saskatoon Region Association of Realtors, Association of Regina Realtors, Greater El Paso Association of Realtors, RMLS, Bay East Association of REALTORs, Contra Costa Association of REALTORs, East Bay Regional Data (EBRDI), MLS of Hilton Head Island, Southern Oregon MLS, Garden State MLS (GSMLS), and many others.

bluejetty:00141482:ios.description:
Speech Jammer will record your voice and replay it back to you at an adjustable delay. This is known as Delayed Auditory Feedback (DAF) and results in difficulty speaking. You just put on your headphones, turn up the volume and read the sentences. The more you spontaneously and continuously talk with the Speech Jammer, the harder talking becomes.
Speech Jammer Features
● Adjustable delay to impair speech
● Tongue twisters to make it even more difficult
● Ability to record Speech Jammer sessions
● Share recordings with your friends
● Simple and easy-to-use layout
Speech Jammer works best with noise cancelling headphones and headphones with the microphone built-in.

Ever wonder how you’d look with a bold new hair color? PerfectHairColor is designed especially for those with naturally dark hair who dream of transforming their look with vivid, natural, and eye‐catching colors. Using our breakthrough technology, even jet-black hair can be effortlessly and realistically transformed into over 200 dazzling shades—from soft pastels to vivid, vibrant tones.
Instant Transformation at Your Fingertips
Simply take a photo with your device or select an image from your gallery, and with a smooth swipe, watch as your hair comes to life in new colors within seconds. Our intuitive interface ensures that changing your hair color is as easy as it is fun—no complicated steps required.
Unmatched Realism and Customization
PerfectHairColor delivers super-realistic hair color simulations that other apps just can’t match. Fine-tune your look with customizable settings such as color intensity, smoothing, and translucency controls. Whether you’re exploring a dramatic change or just experimenting with subtle highlights, you’re in complete control.
Share Your New Look
Join a community of trendsetters! PerfectHairColor makes it effortless to share your before-and-after photos on social media. Inspire your friends and followers with your unique style and get feedback in real time.
Why Choose PerfectHairColor?
Exclusive Focus on Dark Hair: Specifically engineered to solve the challenges of dyeing naturally dark hair, delivering results that look natural and vibrant.
200+ Colors at Your Disposal: Expand your style possibilities with a vast palette that lets you experiment with every imaginable combination.
Simplicity Meets Precision: Enjoy an interface designed for instant results without sacrificing the detailed control that discerning users crave.
Transform your look, boost your confidence, and have fun exploring a world of color—all with PerfectHairColor. Start your virtual hair makeover today and see the bright side of life!

PerfectHairColor Premium subscription options:
===========================
PerfectHairColor Premium monthly - $4.99 per month
Your PerfectHairColor Premium subscription will automatically renew 24-hours prior to the end of each term (month or year correspondingly) and your card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renewal at any time in your iTunes account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused period of the term.

bluejetty:00133685:ios.description:
Looking for a way to get a better night's sleep? Look no further than our app, Green Noise for Sleep! Our app is designed to help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer with a wide range of soothing nature sounds, sleep meditation and bedtime stories. Whether you prefer the sound of raindrops on a tin roof, the gentle rustle of leaves in a forest, or the calming sound of a babbling brook, we have you covered.
Features includes:
 • Mix and match different sounds to create the perfect soundscape for your sleeping environment
 • Timer function allows you to set the app to turn off automatically after a set amount of time
 • Enjoy longer content with Sleep Meditation, Bedtime stories and Self-Hypnosis
 • Fade out feature gradually decreases the volume of the sounds, so you can fall asleep gradually and peacefully
 • Mark your favorite mix for easy access
Sleep has never been easier with Green Noise for Sleep! The sounds of nature can help you block out the noise of the world and create a peaceful, calming environment that promotes deep, restful sleep. Choose from a variety of white noise, rain, thunder, and other natural sounds to find the perfect combination for you. So why wait? Download Sleep Nature Sounds today and start sleeping better tonight!
Sound List : 
 • Water Category : Waterfall, Waves crashing, Mountain River, Rainy Mood, Rain Heavy, Relaxing Rain, Walking in shallow water, Small Water Stream, Large Waves, Rain Medium, Rain on Lake...
 • Animal Category : Seagulls, Tree Frog sound, Melody of Bird, Dog Barking, Bird Ambiance, Jungle Birds-, Cicadas, Sea lions, Snake Pit, Horse Walk...
 • Weather Category : Thunder with rain, Wind Blowing, Wind Storm Heavy, Thunderstorm Rain, Wind Blizzard, Thunder Cracks, Thunderstorm Active, Thunder Rumbling, Artic Wind...
 • Landscape Category : Spring Forest, Windy Beach, Forest Night Time, Silence of Stone, Fireplace, Australia Coast, Thailand Market Evening, Tokyo Fish Market, New York Street...
 • Fire Category : Bonfire, Fireplace, Wood Fire...
---

UAE Cinema Showtimes provides movie showtimes and online booking for cinemas across the United Arab Emirates. Trusted by UAE's cinema-goers for over 10 years, it is definitely the only all-in-one app you are going to need. We have got you fully covered by the UAE's best, most comprehensive, elegant and easy to use cinema app.

This application shows timings from:
- Novo Cinemas
- Vox Cinemas
- Reel Cinemas
- Cineroyal
- CinemaCity
- Oscar Cinemas
- Star Cinemas
- Roxy Cinemas
and many more.
Main features of the app includes: 
- Showtimes and seat bookings for up to three days
- All kind of information about the movie such as cast, plot, movie ratings, runtime and more in-depth details.
- High quality HD trailers.
- Elegant and beautiful design.
- Filter movies by language or genre
- Find your nearest cinemas easily by selecting "Cinemas Near Me" options.
- Push notifications for new movie releases.
- Easily set or change your preferred emirate for more convenience.
- Add cinemas to favorites. Your favorited cinemas will show at top in listings.
- Tap on map icon on cinema list to get it's exact location.
- Share cinema showtimes with your friends on Facebook, Twitter or whats app
- Get a sneak peak of movies and their release dates which are coming soon to UAE.
Your continuous feedback over last 5 years has helped us make this application better and subsequently the number one cinema app of UAE. Please keep your feedback coming. Tap on "About" tab within the app to contact us.

Trusted by UAE's cinema-goers for over 10 years, it is definitely the only all-in-one app you are going to need. We have got you fully covered by the UAE's best, most comprehensive, elegant and easy to use cinema app.

No need to download dozens of apps for each cinema or browse through different website to check showtimes and book movie tickets. This single app covers over 50 cinemas in United Arab Emirates across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Al Ain, Ajman, Ras Al Khaima, Fujairah.

This application shows timings from:
- Novo Cinemas
- Vox Cinemas
- Reel Cinemas
- Cineroyal
- CinemaCity
- Oscar Cinemas
- Star Cinemas
- Roxy Cinemas
and many more.

Main features of the app includes: 
- Showtimes and seat bookings for up to three days
- All kind of information about the movie such as cast, plot, movie ratings, runtime and more in-depth details.
- High quality HD trailers.
- Elegant and beautiful design.
- Filter movies by language or genre
- Find your nearest cinemas easily by selecting "Cinemas Near Me" options.
- Push notifications for new movie releases.
- Easily set or change your preferred emirate for more convenience.
- Add cinemas to favorites. Your favorited cinemas will show at top in listings.
- Tap on map icon on cinema list to get it's exact location.
- Share cinema showtimes with your friends on Facebook, Twitter or whats app
- Get a sneak peak of movies and their release dates which are coming soon to UAE.

Your continuous feedback over last 5 years has helped us make this application better and subsequently the number one cinema app of UAE. Please keep your feedback coming. Tap on "About" tab within the app to contact us.

bluejetty:00028015:ios.description:
Reimagine by MyHeritage: Scan. Improve. Create. Share!
Reimagine is a photo editing app designed to help you preserve and enhance the image quality of those precious memories. With a range of AI photo editing features, Reimagine makes it easy to organize, store, and share your family photos like never before.
Reimagine app photo editing features:
• Photo Scanning
• Store and Share images
• Photo Enhancer - unblur pictures & improve photo quality
• Photo Repair - repairs damaged images with scratches and tears 
• Colorize photos - colorize black and white pics and color restore faded photos
• Animate your photos 
Scan Photos & Photo Editing
One of the key elements of Reimagine is the photo scanner feature. Scan photos and entire photo albums easily with just a few taps, and the app automatically crops and saves them as individual photos. You can utilize the photo scanner ability to add your old photos to the app. Once you scan the photos, you can add details like names, dates, and places to your images to make them easier to find and organize. 
Store and Share Your Family Photos
Reimagine's photo storage feature allows you to keep all your pictures in one place, and you can share the original and the enhanced photos with friends and family.
Photo Enhancer & Photo Repair
Have old, low-resolution, or blurry photos that you want to improve? Reimagine's photo enhancer feature can help. Using advanced AI technology, Reimagine can enhance the image quality of old photos, repair damaged images. With the photo enhancer you can improve the resolution of the images, and restore old photos to their original glory.
Colorize Photos
Do you have old pictures that you wish you could see in color? Reimagine's colorization feature can bring those old photos to life. You can colorize black and white pics and improve the image colorization of old faded photos, and you'll be able to see your family history in a whole new way. 
Animate Photos 
Reimagine's photo animation feature is a game-changer in the world of photo editing. Using AI technology, you can animate your family photos! With just a few 
taps, you can create a short video with different gestures, to see the people in your photos smile, dance, blow a kiss, and more! Experience your family photos like never before.
Terms of Use: https://www.myheritage.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.myheritage.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00089058:ios.name: Orlando Theme Park Day
bluejetty:00089058:ios.summary: Your handheld guide and planning tool for all of the Walt Disney World® Resort, Universal Orlando® Resort and SeaWorld® Orlando theme parks. Do more and wait less with preset and customized touring plans, wait times and easy access to all t
bluejetty:00089058:ios.description:
Your handheld guide and planning tool for all of the Walt Disney World® Resort, Universal Orlando® Resort and SeaWorld® Orlando theme parks. Do more and wait less with preset and customized touring plans, wait times and easy access to all the details of your favorite attractions. Use the directional compass and interactive maps to navigate each park, view wait times and execute your touring plan.
Key Features:
▶ Interactive map with directional compass for easy park navigation
▶ See your location in the park
▶ Accurate Wait Times
▶ Recommended Park Plans to experience the most popular rides with the lowest waits
▶ My Park plans customized by you
▶ Share plans with friends and family even if they don't have the app
▶ When to Visit Recommendations
▶ Daily Park Hours
▶ Extra Magic Hours
▶ Today’s Wait Time Curves
▶ Height Restrictions
▶ View Favorites
▶ Restaurant Recommendations
****Named “Best App for Taking on Walt Disney World” by Fox News!****
How will Undercover Tourist’s iPhone app help me BEFORE my trip? 
Recommended Plans
▶ Save up to 4 hours a day by following our recommended plans for each park.
▶ See more and wait less with our recommended order of rides and attractions.
▶ View current wait times for each attraction on your plan in list.
▶ Share your plan with others right from the app!
Customized Plans
▶ Select any Disney, Universal or SeaWorld parks to create a new plan or modify our recommended plans to fit your needs.
▶ Add a personalized note or reminder throughout the day.
▶ Share your plan with others right from the app!
Favorites
▶ Create one account and sync between the app and UndercoverTourist.com.
▶ Tap the heart icon to save an attraction to your favorites list for quick viewing.
What about DURING my trip?
Interactive Park Maps
▶ Use the directional compass to know exactly where you are in the park and what attractions are close by
▶ Sort by “Near Me” to find the closest attractions
▶ View current wait times on map to see the park at a glance 
▶ View and execute your touring plan in map view as you navigate the park
Park Plans
▶ Keep your group in sync by following along with our preset touring plans or your own custom plan
▶ Check off attractions as you ride them.
▶ Navigate to the next attraction using the directional compass in map view.
Planning Tools
▶ Be right on time with park opening hours
▶ Know which park has Extra Magic Hours 
▶ Use our recommended “When to Visit” guide within Wait Times for more flexibility (great for late arrivers and families who sleep in!)

Navigate effortlessly and explore with confidence using Compass Simple – the powerful yet easy-to-use compass application designed for outdoor enthusiasts and adventurers.

* Location Information: Get precise latitude and longitude coordinates to accurately pinpoint your location.
* Sunset/Sunrise Times: Plan your outdoor activities effectively with real-time sunset and sunrise times.
* Flashlight Functionality: Illuminate your path with the integrated flashlight that can be turned on/off directly from the app.
* Water Level Tool: Utilize the water level tool for various leveling tasks.
* Compass Orientation on Map: View compass orientation on a rotating map, providing seamless navigation as you move.
Additional Features:
* User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive design for easy navigation and simple operation.
* Customization Options: Personalize settings such as units of measurement and compass styles.
* Accuracy and Reliability: Ensure precise readings and dependable performance for your adventures.
* Offline Functionality: Works in areas with limited or no internet connectivity for reliable use in remote locations.
* Battery Efficiency: Optimized for minimal battery consumption to prolong device usage during outdoor excursions.
* Regular Updates: Receive periodic updates to enhance performance and add new features.
Experience the freedom of exploration with Compass Simple – your ultimate navigation companion for all your outdoor adventures!

bluejetty:00073103:ios.name: Violin Tuner - Simple Tuner
bluejetty:00073103:ios.summary: Give every G D A E string a confident start. Violin Tuner turns a sustained bowed or plucked note into clear pitch guidance: note, octave, frequency and a needle for fine adjustments. Its pitch tracker follows your note through some backgro
bluejetty:00073103:ios.description:
Give every G D A E string a confident start. Violin Tuner turns a sustained bowed or plucked note into clear pitch guidance: note, octave, frequency and a needle for fine adjustments. Its pitch tracker follows your note through some background noise while avoiding a new reading when sound is too uncertain.
Your G D A E strings
Violin Tuner pairs microphone pitch detection with recorded reference sounds for standard G, D, A and E tuning. Use the instrument display to keep your open strings in view while you work through them one at a time.
- Read the detected note, octave and frequency.
- See whether the pitch is sharp or flat.
- Tap a string button to hear its reference sound.
- Compare the sound by ear and check your adjustment visually.
Precision you can see
Violin Tuner shows the note, octave and frequency in hertz. Its cent-based needle helps you move from “almost there” to in tune with small, accurate adjustments. When the sound is too uncertain, the detector waits for a clearer note instead of guessing. Get the best of both approaches: follow the needle or tap a recorded reference and tune by ear.
Set your reference pitch
Choose an A4 reference between 430 and 450 Hz for pitch detection, including 440 and 442 Hz. Violin Tuner remembers this setting so you can return to your chosen reference. The recorded string sounds remain fixed; changing A4 adjusts the tuning calculation, not the audio recordings.
Chromatic note detection
Switch to chromatic mode to follow notes outside the four standard open strings. Watch the note name and needle while sustaining a clear tone. This can support a pitch check during individual practice without adding a complicated practice routine.
Start with a clear sound
Allow microphone access and let one bowed or plucked note settle before making another adjustment. For your most accurate reading, let one string ring clearly near the microphone. If surrounding noise drowns out your violin, move closer or find a quieter spot. Violin Tuner gives students, fiddle players and returning musicians a focused way to prepare their strings.
Built on tuner experience
Our tuner apps have helped millions of users. Violin Tuner brings that experience to a focused violin tuning check.

bluejetty:00166981:ios.description:
Discover the World with GeoFindr - Pinpoint Any Photo’s Location Instantly
Ever found a stunning photo and wondered where it was taken? With GeoFindr, the answer is just a tap away! Whether it’s a breathtaking landscape, a historical landmark, or a hidden gem, GeoFindr uses advanced image analysis to find the precise geographical location of any photo you upload. Perfect for travelers, photographers, and curious minds alike, GeoFindr takes the guesswork out of photo exploration.
Get Started for Free!
GeoFindr allows you to discover the location of 1 photo per day for free. For unlimited photo localizations and access to premium features, you can upgrade through an in-app purchase.
How Does It Work?
Simply upload a photo, and GeoFindr will analyze it using cutting-edge technology to determine its location. In seconds, you'll get accurate GPS coordinates, a detailed map view, and even suggestions for nearby points of interest. It's like having a personal guide for every photo you discover.
Key Features (Free):
1 free photo localization per day, including general location and possible matches.
Premium Features (Available through in-app purchase):
Unlimited photo localizations per day.
Access exact GPS coordinates for pinpoint accuracy.
View detailed map integrations with nearby landmarks and attractions.
Get multiple possible matches ranked by probability.
Who is GeoFindr For?
Travel Enthusiasts: Revisit your favorite travel moments by finding the exact locations of your photos.
Photographers: Discover new shooting locations or find out where a particular photo was taken.
History Buffs: Explore the geographical context of historical photos and uncover the stories behind them.
Social Media Influencers: Impress your followers with detailed location tags and descriptions for every photo you share.
Curious Minds: If you love solving mysteries, GeoFindr is the perfect tool for uncovering the world’s hidden spots.
Why Choose GeoFindr?
Accuracy: Our advanced image recognition technology ensures you get the most accurate results, often down to the exact spot where the photo was taken.
Speed: Get results in seconds, so you can spend more time exploring and less time searching.
Privacy: Your photos are safe with us. GeoFindr uses state-of-the-art security to ensure your data remains private.
Support: Our dedicated support team is here to help with any questions or issues, ensuring you get the most out of GeoFindr.
Regular Updates and Improvements
We're committed to making GeoFindr the best it can be. With regular updates, we continuously enhance the app’s features, speed, and accuracy, ensuring you have the best experience possible.
Download GeoFindr Now
Ready to uncover the secrets behind your photos? Download GeoFindr today and start your journey of discovery. The world is just a tap away!

bluejetty:00026375:ios.description:
LumaFusion: The Ultimate Storytelling Experience for Video Editing
Welcome to the App Store’s “App of the Year” for 2021 and the recipient of the Editors’ Choice Award! The gold standard for storytellers worldwide. Offering a fluid, intuitive, touch-screen editing experience.
PROFESSIONAL EDITING MADE EASY
• Six video/audio or graphic tracks: Create multiple layer edits with smooth handling of 4K ProRes and HDR media.
• Six Additional audio tracks: Build your soundscape.
• The ultimate Timeline: Fluent editing using the world’s most flexible track-based AND magnetic timeline.
• Loads of transitions: Keep your story moving.
• External Monitor Preview: View on a big screen.
• Markers, tags and notes: Stay organized.
• Voiceover: Record VO while playing your movie.
LAYERED EFFECTS AND COLOR CORRECTION
• Green screen, luma, and chroma keys: For creative compositing.
• Lock & Load Video Stabilizer: Steady your footage.
• Powerful color correction: Create your own look. 
• Video Waveform, vector and histogram scopes.
• LUTs: Import and apply multiple .cube or .3dl LUTs.

bluejetty:00074279:ios.name: Topo Maps Canada
bluejetty:00074279:ios.summary:
Download Natural Resources Canada topographic maps and use them offline, with no account and no subscription.
Topo Maps Canada is built for people who go where cell service doesn't: hikers, backpackers, hunters, anglers, canoeists, snowmob
bluejetty:00074279:ios.description:
Download Natural Resources Canada topographic maps and use them offline, with no account and no subscription.
Topo Maps Canada is built for people who go where cell service doesn't: hikers, backpackers, hunters, anglers, canoeists, snowmobilers, mountain bikers, geocachers, and anyone who wants a real topographic map in their pocket.
MAPS
Choose from three Natural Resources Canada map styles: Canada Base Map with hillshading, Canada Base Map unshaded, or classic Toporama topographic sheets.
OFFLINE
Tap the map squares you want and download them before you leave. Downloaded maps work with no Internet connection and use no cell data in the field.
TRAILS AND POINTS OF INTEREST BUILT IN
Every map download includes the trails, summits, lakes, campsites, and other named places in that area from OpenStreetMap, so you can search them by name while you're offline.
TRAIL RECORDING
Record where you go. Recorded trails show your path on the map with distance, elapsed time, and average speed. Recording stops automatically when you start driving, and any drive at the start or end of a trail is trimmed off.
ELEVATION PROFILES
Every recorded or imported trail gets an elevation profile with distance labels and color-coded grade shading. Drag along the chart to see the matching point on the map, its elevation, and the time you passed it.
FLAGS
Mark your current location or any spot on the map. Flags record coordinates and elevation, and you can add notes and organize them by color: geocaches, trailheads, summits, camps, and so on.
NAVIGATION
Pick a flag and follow the direction arrow, driven by your compass heading, with the distance remaining. Handy for geocaching and for finding your way back to camp or the car.
LOCATION
See where you are on the map, your elevation, speed, and the accuracy of the GPS fix.
MEASURE
Trace a route on the map to measure its distance, then save it as a trail to follow later.
IMPORT AND SHARE
Import trails and waypoints from GPX files and geocache LOC files. Share your flags and trails by email, Messages, or AirDrop as standard GPX files that work with any GPS unit or mapping software. Back up your maps, flags and trails to a computer over Wi-Fi, and restore them on a new phone.
Designed for iPhone and iPad.
Note: Continued use of GPS in the background can noticeably reduce battery life.

bluejetty:00100299:ios.description:
Arrows Out - Color Escape: A Puzzle Adventure!
Welcome to Arrows Out - Color Escape! This is a captivating puzzle game that masterfully blends arrow sorting, path planning, and spatial escape. Your goal is simple: clear the board of all colorful arrows!
How to Play:
Tap to Move: Tap any arrow, and it will shoot off in its facing direction until it hits a wall or another arrow.
Clear Path Required: An arrow can only move and ultimately escape if its path is clear ahead!
Strategic Sorting: You must cleverly plan the tapping order. Use one arrow's movement to create a path for another, triggering satisfying chain reactions.
Clear the Board: Use your logic to help all the vibrant arrows escape one by one, leaving the board empty!
Features & Challenges:
Mind-Bending Puzzles: Simple rules hide deep, strategic challenges. One wrong move can block your path!
Vibrant & Colorful: Enjoy a visually pleasing experience with colorful arrows and various thematic levels.
Logic & Pathfinding: It's not just arrow matching; it's the ultimate test of your spatial logic and foresight.
Easy to Learn: Intuitive tap controls make it the perfect casual puzzle game for all ages to enjoy anytime.
Hundreds of Levels: Progress from simple to complex through hundreds of carefully designed stages. The difficulty curve will keep you hooked!
Key Keywords: Arrows Puzzle, Sorting Game, Path Planning, Logic Puzzle, Tap to Move, Escape Game, Colorful Arrows, Casual Game, Brain Teaser, Easy to Play, Levels, Strategy Puzzle, Chain Reaction, Clear the Board, Single Player, Brain Training, Time Killer, Blocking Movement
