bluejetty:00073333:ios.description:
Experience real tranquility with Zen Color, the first coloring game inspired by Zen. Our team is dedicated to providing you with the ultimate relaxing and fulfilling gaming experience. Let go of your worries, forget your stress, and finally put your mind at ease by immersing yourself in the world of Zen coloring.
Escape from the daily grind and chaos of life. Open up Zen Color anytime, anywhere, and transport yourself to a place where you can:
* Imagine sipping a cup of coffee in the morning, the birds chirping just outside the window, watching golden sunbeams filtering through the trees.
* Enjoy a tranquil tea break on the perfect afternoon, where everything feels peaceful and just right.
* Transport yourself to a Japanese Zen courtyard, feeling as one with everything around you as you watch the steaming teapot by your side.
…
Zen Color invites you to breathe life into these realistic pictures and rediscover the long-lost peace and beauty in your heart. With every tap of the color number, Zen Color brings tranquility and relaxation to your fingertips.
ZEN COLOR FEATURES
INCREDIBLE CALM & RELAXATION
* Explore unique Zen-inspired pictures that help clear the fog and focus your mind while giving you a boost of positive energy.
* Find your groove and get into the flow while coloring by numbers with relaxing 60bpm background music.
* Immerse yourself in the beauty and tranquility of nature, leaving your worries behind to let you unwind.
* Sooth anxieties and have fun with the Flow Experience during the coloring process, which includes categories like Calm, Focus, Zen, Affection, Happiness, and more.
A LARGE SELECTION of MASTERFUL PAINTINGS
* Each picture is carefully crafted by highly talented artists hailing from all corneres of the globe, ensuring content consisting of only the best quality.
* Choose from a vast selection of pictures so you can find the perfect painting to suit your style.
* Discover scenes such as brilliant natural landscapes, animals of all shapes and sizes, cozy lifestyles, your favorite pets, and more in Zen Color.
* Mandalas and geometric patterns can help you find inner peace and harmony, sating your artistic appetite while allowing you to stay focused and spiritually fulfilled.
ALSO FEATURING
* A distinctive eye-friendly dark mode designed for comfortable coloring at night.
* Outstanding app stability, excellent data security, and a user-friendly interface for an exceptional user experience.
Zen Color offers everyone’s inner artist a relaxing and peaceful coloring experience in this fast-paced and noisy world. If you're looking to take a break and find inner peace by doing some coloring, look no further than Zen Color. It's the perfect choice when you want to unwind and take some time for yourself. This amazing coloring game can help you reclaim those quiet moments in life for yourself once and for all!
Take a 10-minute break to discover inner peace, fulfillment, love, and happiness. It's time to embark on a calm and relaxed journey with Zen Color.
Contact us at support@oakevergames.com

Privacy: https://oakevergames.com/pp.html

bluejetty:00182558:ios.description:
Discover the most complete Sudoku experience on the App Store. Sudoku by Joseph offers 12 unique puzzle variants in one beautifully designed app - trusted by players for over 15 years with a 4.66-star rating from 2,400+ reviews.
THREE FREE VARIANTS TO ENJOY:
- Classic Sudoku - The timeless 9x9 number puzzle
- Jigsaw Sudoku - Irregular regions replace the standard boxes
- Killer Sudoku - Cage sums meet Sudoku logic
NINE PREMIUM VARIANTS FOR TRUE ENTHUSIASTS:
- 16x16 Sudoku - Super-sized grid for an extra challenge
- Twodoku - Two overlapping Sudoku grids
- Tripledoku - Three interlocking puzzles
- Gattai-3 - Three grids sharing regions
- Sohei - Four grids in a cross pattern
- Samurai - Five overlapping grids
- Cross Sudoku - A cross-shaped multi-grid puzzle
- Flower Sudoku - Five grids in a flower arrangement
- Kazaguruma - A pinwheel of four grids
FEATURES THAT MAKE THE DIFFERENCE:
- Daily Challenge - A new puzzle every day to keep your streak alive
- Multiple difficulty levels - From beginner-friendly to fiendishly hard
- 13 stunning themes - Customize your experience with light and dark modes
- Customizable fonts - Choose the look that suits you
- Full statistics - Track your progress and improvement
- Game Center - Compare your achievements with friends
- Ad-free with Premium - No interruptions, ever
- Works offline - Play anywhere, anytime
- Privacy-focused - We respect your data
Crafted by an indie developer with a passion for puzzles, Sudoku by Joseph is the app that grows with you. Start with Classic, Jigsaw, or Killer for free, then unlock all 12 variants with a premium subscription.
Premium Subscription:
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription

bluejetty:00120811:ios.description:
Journey to the world's most beautiful destinations and fish for real in paradise! 
Jump into paradise blue and experience the ultimate 3D fishing adventure!
Know nothing about fishing? It's okay! You'll be able to catch the Blue Pointer with just a tap!
Download Ace Fishing now to travel all over the world and fish at the most famous fishing spots!
1. Fishing Made Easy
- Get hooked on fishing with simple, one-touch controls! 
- Who says fishing is boring? Just 3 seconds is all it takes before heart-pounding action!
- Complete the tutorial and practice in the Practice Room to master the skills and even get rewards!
2. Jaw-dropping 3D Graphics
- Interact with catches so life-like they could fly off your screen!
- Perfectly recreated physics of fishing means you'll be able to feel the excitement of fishing at your fingertips!
3. It doesn't get any more real than this!
- Fishing rods customizable with fishing lines of varying length and tension strength!
- Hang in there- tire out the fish through epic struggles!
- Fish movements and characteristics captured with stunning realism!
- Complicated mechanisms made easy to bring the most realistic fishing experience to mobile gaming! 
4. Travel the World
- Hundreds of exotic fish native to different areas! Venture through the entire map to catch them all! 
5. Global Rankings
- Reel in the biggest fish and break records! Compete in fishing tournaments held by the hour and go head-to-head against users from around the globe! 
- Prepare the lure for the target fish through Lure Crafting System to rank higher!
- Your records are automatically saved every time you fish, so you can aim to break them! 
6. More to Enjoy!
- Equip Accessories on your rod for more power! Use the Pearl Powders to Power-up your Accessories!
- Utilize the special Fever Mode! Fever Mode will increase your stats to the MAX so you can catch the fish you've always dreamed of!
7. Shh! It's a Secret!
- A special League Ranking to show off your skills is coming soon!

None

- Photos: "Allow" is required to upload in-game profile images from Photos.
- ID for Advertisers : It will help us to provide you a more personalized experience, relevant content, and ads.
※ Please note that you can still enjoy the service excluding features related to the above without giving access permissions.
▶ How to remove access permissions
You can always change access permission settings whenever you'd like.
- Device Settings> Select the corresponding app> Choose either to enable/disable access

bluejetty:00119988:ios.description:
Digiicampus — Your Institution, Digitally Connected
Your campus has a physical presence. Digiicampus brings its digital twin to life.
Digiicampus creates a unified digital experience for your entire institution — connecting students, faculty, administrators, staff, parents and alumni with the people, processes, services and information they need, wherever they are.
From academics and administration to communication, campus services and institutional intelligence, Digiicampus brings the everyday experience of your institution together in one place.
One digital experience for your entire institution
With Digiicampus, users can access the services and information relevant to their role — while institutions get a connected digital layer across the campus.
For students
Stay connected with everything that matters across your academic and campus journey.
- View your timetable and academic calendar
- Access courses, learning resources and academic information
- Check examinations, grades and progress
- Manage fees and payments
- Access campus services
- Stay updated with announcements and events
- Participate in communities, clubs and campus activities
- Raise grievances and service requests
- Access transport, library, help desk and other institutional services
For faculty
Bring teaching, academic processes and student engagement together.
- Manage courses and academic activities
- Access timetables and academic calendars
- Manage examinations, grades and student progress
- Communicate with students
- Participate in faculty communities and institutional workflows
- Access relevant campus services and information
For administrators and staff
Run more of the institution from one connected digital layer.
- Manage admissions, fees and payments
- Maintain institutional and user records
- Manage infrastructure, venues and institutional calendars
- Automate routine workflows
- Manage campus services and requests
- Monitor feedback, grievances and service delivery
- Access institutional data and analytics
Digiicampus connects the different parts of an institution so they can work as one.
Campus Administration
Admissions, fees, payments, records, infrastructure, placements, venues, calendars and institutional processes.
Academics & Learning
Curriculum, courses, timetables, examinations, grades, progress, e-portfolios, learning resources and academic communication.
Workflow Automation
Digitise routine processes, reduce manual intervention and create workflows across institutional functions.
Campus Collaboration & Engagement
Communities, clubs, events, mentoring, surveys, polls, messaging, grievances, gate passes, transport, library, IT and help-desk services.
Institutional Intelligence
Turn institutional data into actionable insights across admissions, fees, placements, feedback, academic performance and campus services.
The Digital Twin of Your Institution
A modern institution is more than its buildings and systems. It is the people, processes, interactions, services and decisions that make the campus work.
Digiicampus brings these elements together digitally — creating a connected layer that reflects how your institution operates and gives every stakeholder a more seamless way to experience it.
One institution.
One connected digital experience.
Digiicampus.
This app is available to users registered with Digiicampus client institutions.
If you are having trouble registering or logging in, please contact Digiicampus Support at support@digiicampus.com.

bluejetty:00120074:ios.description:
Learn Japanese in context - READING, LISTENING, SPEAKING and JLPT
With more than 10 fresh news articles daily, you can practice at your own level, from N5 beginner to N1 advanced. Improve your reading skills, expand your vocabulary, and understand Japanese the way natives use it. 
Why choose Todaii Japanese to learn Japanese?
* Major update:
Todaii Japanese launches the new “Tomo Chat” – Practice speak Japanese with AI
Outstanding features:
- Chat with AI about real, context-rich news content. This allows learners to practice language reflexes in realistic situations, stay updated on social topics, and develop flexible language thinking - something traditional learning topics often lack.
- Summary of errors and suggestions for correction.
Reading practice - Learn Japanese through real content
- Improve Japanese reading skills with content selected from levels N5 to N1
- Topics include Japanese culture, daily life, technology, entertainment, and more.
- Integrated 1-touch lookup right in the reading, helping you deeply understand the semantics of words and sentences when needed.
- Practice with Quiz to help consolidate skills and memorize lesson content
- Practice reading and pronunciation of each word, each sentence
A.I. Pronunciation Scoring - Improve your pronunciation, speak Japanese confidently
- Recognize and analyze your pronunciation of each word using A.I. technology
- Compare with native pronunciation to detect mistakes
- Provide accurate scores after each practice to track progress
Practice real-life conversations - Learn to speak Japanese naturally
- 72 conversations, helping you quickly learn basic communication in Japanese used daily.
- Learn Japanese grammar with each conversation.
- Designed for learners who want to learn to speak Japanese with confidence.
Japanese Dictionary - Easy lookup and learn Japanese vocabulary
- Smart, fast, and accurate dictionary similar to top Japanese dictionary apps
- Look up vocabulary, idioms, sentence structures, and grammar breakdowns.
- All features are designed to help you learn Japanese vocabulary and grammar naturally.
JLPT N5-N1 mock test - Learn Japanese for exam success
- Full mock tests to help you prepare for the JLPT exam in July and December.
- Detailed explanations of answers help you understand and improve your weaknesses.
- 356 JLPT N5-N1 reading practice exercises
Listening practice - Learn Japanese by listening to native video
- Practice listening skills through hot videos and podcasts, with transcripts to help you understand each sentence.
- Audio with reading exercises to practice listening skills with high-quality voices
- Easily adjust playback speed, suitable for each learner's level
- Attractive videos and podcasts, help you practice listening skills, supplement vocabulary and grammar in real contexts.
- Detailed transcripts included, easy to follow lesson content.
Vocabulary - Learn and remember Japanese words faster
- Vocabulary curated and summarized from real reading passages.
- Easy-to-use Flashcards to memorize new words.
- Full JLPT N5-N1 vocabulary list for targeted learning.
Application for:
- People who want to learn Japanese from scratch or improve existing skills.
- Self-learners who want to study Japanese effectively at home.
- Learners preparing for the JLPT N5-N1 exams.
- Anyone looking to enhance their Japanese reading, listening, and speaking abilities.
Whether you're just starting or already have some experience, Todaii Japanese is your trusted app to learn Japanese in a fun, structured, and effective way
Let Todaii Japanese be your companion on your journey to learn Japanese and connect deeply with the language and culture of Japan!
For feedback or questions, contact us at: todai.easylife@gmail.com
 Your support helps us make Todaii Japanese better every day.

Join millions of players in one of the most competitive multiplayer soccer games ever created.  Experience the thrill of the fast-paced multiplayer online matches!
Compete against other players in real-time in your league and play to claim your place at the top of the ladder.
    *Challenge your friends in real-time!
Get social by connecting your social media accounts and play the most exciting football game with your friends, show them who is the best! You can also establish your own team and gain different rewards as you win matches!
    *Rumble Through Competitive Soccer Leagues with your team!
Compete in 5 different soccer leagues and do your best to make it to the very top of the ladder. Join a team or create your own, either way, you’re much powerful with your team! Join the competition each week where you have a chance to challenge other teams all around the world. More team you beat, more chance to rise from Bronze League to Diamond League! Fight your way through real opponents and challenging soccer matches. You can’t know who the winner before the match will be is over.
   *Unique Gameplay
Soccer is all about kicking the ball and scoring goals, right? Experience soccer in a way you have never experienced before. Kick, strike and score using your hero. Use your feet, head, and superpowers to score goals. Head Ball 2 offers simplistic gameplay that can be quickly transformed into action-packed and exciting games. Hit the ball, hit your opponent, use headers, superpowers or outwit your opponent by juking them. Everything is permitted, as long as you win! No match will be the same as the previous in the most exciting soccer game! Connect with your friends via Facebook and challenge them to show who is the better soccer player.
    *Take Control of Your Football Career
Progress through the unique career mode to unlock special bonuses, characters, and accessories. As you progress, rewards become increasingly difficult to obtain, do you have what it takes?
     *Upgrade Your Character to Become a Champion!
Stand out from the crowd by choosing from hundreds of accessories to find your unique combination. Improve your characters’ skills to dominate the field. Progress to unlock new characters and cosmetic rewards and upgrade your favorite characters.
    *Spice Things Up with Different Superpowers!
Unlock 18 different superpowers and use them at the right moment to catch your opponent off guard. Your opponents can counter you with superpowers as well!
     *Gather Fans and Unlock New Stadiums
Increase your fanbase by gaining supporters after each win. Unlock new stadiums to fit your ever-growing supporters. Journey through 10 different stadiums as you walk towards glory!
It’s more fun with Daily Missions!
Come back and fulfill different missions to get the big reward every day.
Features;
-Online soccer games against real players all across the world.

Join millions of players in one of the most competitive multiplayer soccer games ever created.  Experience the thrill of the fast-paced multiplayer online matches!
Compete against other players in real-time in your league and play to claim your place at the top of the ladder.

    *Challenge your friends in real-time!
Get social by connecting your social media accounts and play the most exciting football game with your friends, show them who is the best! You can also establish your own team and gain different rewards as you win matches!

    *Rumble Through Competitive Soccer Leagues with your team!
Compete in 5 different soccer leagues and do your best to make it to the very top of the ladder. Join a team or create your own, either way, you’re much powerful with your team! Join the competition each week where you have a chance to challenge other teams all around the world. More team you beat, more chance to rise from Bronze League to Diamond League! Fight your way through real opponents and challenging soccer matches. You can’t know who the winner before the match will be is over.

   *Unique Gameplay
Soccer is all about kicking the ball and scoring goals, right? Experience soccer in a way you have never experienced before. Kick, strike and score using your hero. Use your feet, head, and superpowers to score goals. Head Ball 2 offers simplistic gameplay that can be quickly transformed into action-packed and exciting games. Hit the ball, hit your opponent, use headers, superpowers or outwit your opponent by juking them. Everything is permitted, as long as you win! No match will be the same as the previous in the most exciting soccer game! Connect with your friends via Facebook and challenge them to show who is the better soccer player.

    *Take Control of Your Football Career
Progress through the unique career mode to unlock special bonuses, characters, and accessories. As you progress, rewards become increasingly difficult to obtain, do you have what it takes?

Unlock 18 different superpowers and use them at the right moment to catch your opponent off guard. Your opponents can counter you with superpowers as well!

bluejetty:00077306:ios.description:
Canals.UK is a useful companion for anyone who uses the canals; boating or walking!
Navigate the 2,000 miles of UK canals. The App shows locks, bridges, aqueducts, tunnels, mooring and facilities and much more, along our canal network.
The FREE version includes:
• All the UK canals mapped with locks, bridges and facilities.
• Shows: Mile markers, Boatyards, CRT Notices, Fish & Chips, Launderettes, Canal side Pubs, local convenience stores.
• A list of all canals in a useful linear diagram which will show you where you are on a specific canal and update your location if tracking is on.
• Canal & River Trust Notices of any navigation restrictions.
• Useful phone numbers and links to websites.
• My Boat - keep relevant details about your boat.
• Get estimated boat speed, location and sunrise/sunset times.
• Notifications
Upgrade ‘Go Pro’ with in-App purchase includes:
• Nearby: find useful points or interest that are near your current location
• Daily Boat Log to record any diary details to show you are a continuous boater!
• Create your own Points of Interest (POI) and plot them on the map e.g. your favourite mooring spots, where to pick blackberries or favourite pub.
• Canal Rings: shows the major canal rings that you can journey along.
• Route Planner: plan a canal route and get an estimate of how long it will take.
• Boat Tracker - track your boat position even when the App is not running (obviously the iPhone/iPad needs to be on).
• TV Aerial Finder - find the location of the best reception from nearby Freeview TV masts
• Show All CRT Notices on the Map
• Show GOV.UK Stream Levels on the Map
• Show CRT Stream Warnings on the Map
• Show CRT Winter Moorings
• Cruise mode to show nearest point, next location, time and distance to next mooring, lock, bridge, waterpoint, winding hole; current speed and GPS location

bluejetty:00132293:ios.description:
This great block puzzle game offers an exciting, relaxing and entertaining experience for players of all ages.
The goal of the game is place blocks in the 10x10 board and fill the lines. Drag and drop blocks onto the board to complete clearing multiple rows or columns at once. Match the lines and enjoy the shiny and satisfying animations. Blast as many wood blocks as you can at once with a relaxing experience.
Players to use their strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to make more combo. Score in every block blasting. Make the combos, double score and reach the highest score.
Try to clear the entire board from blocks with smart moves and get the extra scores. There is no time limit, no need to play fast. In every move think well, make the right decision!
As you progress, the blocks become more harder to match, requiring players to think more and plan their moves carefully. Create your own playing strategy and pass your best point. It's Easy to learn but hard to master!
It's an exciting and challenging wood puzzle that you'll be addicted to in no time!
How to Play:
- Drag blocks onto the board to place them in the grid.
- Fill a line to clear blocks from the board.
- Clear multiple row or column to earn Combo points!
- Blast the wood blocks and beat your best score!
- Have a nice puzzles with wooden pieces.

• Minor back and shoulder pain*
• Minor medical concerns

*Adult patients only

bluejetty:00138139:ios.description:
At Premier Health & Fitness Center, we're with you on your health & fitness journey. We provide unmatched service, innovative fitness programs and wellness treatments designed to help members and guests do their personal best - through performance, endurance, restoration and well-being. With 55,000 sq. ft. to offer the best programs, free weights, cardio equipment, a dedicated cycling studio, mind/body studio, main fitness studio, indoor walking track, indoor basketball court and two heated pools. Members can rejuvenate in our luxury locker rooms, equipped with Sauna and Steam Rooms. 
The PremierTLH mobile app is the one application you will need to register for classes, check in to the club, track your fitness goals and be notified of Premier's general communications. Through push-notifications, members will be notified of club holiday hours, weather cancellations and more! 
As Tallahassee's only locally owned and operated facility of our size, members have endless options to help them meet their health and fitness goals. Experience why Premier has been voted the "Best of Tallahassee" year after year. 
PremierTLH app uses the Health app that is pre-installed on your iPhone to sync nutrients and workouts data. Because of this, the app will ask you to grant read and write access to your nutrients and workouts data.

bluejetty:00072192:ios.description:
◉ Calculate and track your pregnancy due date with beautiful widgets and customizations. 
◉ Get informed on what to expect week by week and stay inspired with motherhood quotes.
You have just found out that you are pregnant. It’s such a joyful moment filled with excitement and love. That thrilling feeling in your stomach is hard to explain. It’s one of the most amazing moments you’ll experience in your life.
After the initial thrill slightly calms down, you understandably want to prepare, track pregnancy, and enhance the excitement by having a baby due date countdown on your iPhone. For that and a lot more now you have the Baby Countdown app.
CALCULATE & TRACK
‣ Enter the name of the baby and the due date.
‣ The app will create a beautiful pregnancy countdown for you with photos.
COUNTDOWN WIDGETS
‣ Choose from different due date widget templates that suit your taste and style.
‣ Customize the widget background color, text color, and date format for even better personalization.
‣ Change the app’s theme from light to dark.
WHAT TO EXPECT WEEK BY WEEK
‣ See what to expect related to your pregnancy in the current week.
‣ See what to expect in your pregnancy in any future week or the 40 pregnancy weeks.
‣ Get informed about your fetus size each week.

Welcome to Crosslet, a jazzy blend of crosswords and anagrams, from the creator of the award-winning game 'Wordathlon'.
Immerse yourself in a unique word puzzle experience where every letter counts! Crosslet challenges you to fill a grid where each letter forms part of a word both horizontally and vertically.

 --- --- --- ---
| S | H | O | P |
 --- --- --- ---
| T | I | R | E |
 --- --- --- ---
| O | V | E | R |
 --- --- --- ---
| P | E | S | T |
 --- --- --- ---

- Start with an empty grid and a handful of letters.
- Strategically create words to fill the grid in both directions.
- Every correct guess fills a row or column.
- Every incorrect guess reveals a grid letter.

- Engaging Gameplay: Test your vocabulary and mental skills.
- Thousands of Levels: Enjoy varying difficulties to keep you challenged.
- Unlockable Characters: Collect quirky animals to keep you company.
- Hints & Helps: Stuck? Use hints to guide you.
Whether you're a casual player looking for a relaxing pastime or a word aficionado seeking a serious challenge, Crosslet is the perfect game for you.
Download now and enjoy a brand new type of word puzzle!

bluejetty:00022602:ios.name: Weight Loss Simple Tracker App
bluejetty:00022602:ios.summary:
Weight Loss (free) is made by a developer who’s successful in losing over 13kg (30 pounds) in just 2 months. This app is a weight tracker for those who want to lose weight. It's simple to use and does exactly what it needs to do.
— Featu
bluejetty:00022602:ios.description:
Weight Loss (free) is made by a developer who’s successful in losing over 13kg (30 pounds) in just 2 months. This app is a weight tracker for those who want to lose weight. It's simple to use and does exactly what it needs to do.
— Features —
・ Record your weight/body fat percentage once or twice daily
・ Edit previous entries via calendar
・ Calculate your BMI automatically
・ Your avatar changes along with your BMI level
・ Weight entry reminder
・ Daily Notes
・ Graphs (Weight, Body Fat Percentage, BMI, Steps, Muscle Mass Percentage)
・ Passcode lock (for your privacy)
・ Sync "steps" from Apple Health App (*only available for the iPhone version, or the iPad version on iPadOS 17 and above.)
・ Data for calories burned is shown in the chart for step count.
— Premium Features —
Currently, we're offering the following:
・ Ad-Free
・ Color & Theme changer
・ Data Backup
・ Additional Avatars
・ Display Goal Avatar
・ Total Weight Lost
・ Apple Health Integration (weight and body fat percentage)
*We'll be adding more Premium features in the future
[Price]
・Current Premium subscription prices are $29.99/year and $3.99/month
・Prices are in US dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice
・Payment will be charged to your Apple Account
[Trial Period]
・We offer a free trial for a limited time at the start of a subscription
・Free Trial Offer not available to users who have already tried Premium
・If you don’t choose to purchase Premium, you need to turn off auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the trial period by going to the settings app on your device.
[Auto-Renewal]
・In order to stop your Premium subscription, you need to cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
・Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
[How to manage/cancel your subscription]
1. Open the Settings app
2. Tap your name
3. Tap Subscriptions
4. Tap the subscription that you want to manage
5. Tap Cancel Subscription (if you cancel, your subscription will stop at the end of the current billing cycle.)
[Premium on multiple devices]
・Premium is connected to a Weight Loss user account (email address). In order to use Premium on multiple devices, please do the following:
(On this device):
1. Go to Weight Loss Settings > Back Up > Sign Up or Log In, and then purchase Premium. Or if you already purchased Premium without going through the "sign up" process, please sign up.
(On another device)
2. Make sure your Apple Account is the same on both devices
 (* You can check your Apple Account via iOS Settings)
3. Go to Weight Loss Settings > Back Up > Log In with the same Weight Loss user account that you used to sign up with in step 1.
*In case your Apple Account varies or you have an expired subscription, you need to purchase Premium again.
[Privacy Policy & Terms of Use]
https://www.weightlossapp.me/s/privacy-and-terms
— Apple Health app —
With the user's permission, this app will read steps and distance from the Apple Health app in order to display a chart for steps. (*only available for the iPhone version, or the iPad version on iPadOS 17+.)
You can also sync smart scale data automatically via Apple Health.
— Units —
You can select these units:
Weight
- Kilograms
- Pounds
- Stone&Pounds
Height
- Centimeters
- Feet&Inches
Energy (*only available for the iPhone version, or the iPad version on iPadOS 17 and above.)
- Calories
- Kilojoules
— Social Media —
X (Twitter)
https://x.com/WeightLossAppme
Instagram
https://www.instagram.com/weightlossapp.me
— Mission —
Our mission is to work towards removing obesity from the world. 
— Support —
If you need some help or want to give us your feedback, we'd be happy to hear! Please visit the link below and describe your issue or share your thoughts: 
Weight Loss Help Center
https://bit.ly/WLSupportForm
#weightloss #track #tracking #tracker #weight #health #healthy #diet #ai

bluejetty:00144827:ios.summary:

Load your rou
bluejetty:00144827:ios.description:
Epic Ride Weather forecasts the conditions for your entire ride, based on your route, start time and pace. See the wind, rain, temperature, and air quality you'll encounter along the way, at the time you'll actually be there.
Load your route, set your start time and pace, and see the wind, rain, temperature, and air quality you'll encounter along the way.
Official weather supplier to Team Visma | Lease a Bike, used for race strategy at the Tour de France, Giro d'Italia, and Vuelta a España.
Use Epic Ride Weather to:
• Choose the best time of day to ride
• See where you'll get a headwind, tailwind, or crosswind
• Know when and where rain is likely
• Pick the right kit before you leave
• Plan long rides and multi-day tours around changing conditions
WEATHER ALONG YOUR ROUTE
Weather can change a lot over four hours and 100 km (60 miles). A city forecast can't tell you about the headwind or a 10 degree temperature drop by the time you crest the climb at 11 am.
Epic Ride Weather combines your route and expected pace to forecast temperature, feels-like temperature, wind, precipitation, and more, at the time you'll reach each part of your route.
UNDERSTAND THE WIND
See wind speed and direction along your route, relative to the way you're riding. Know where the headwind starts, where you'll get a tailwind, and which way to ride the loop.
FIND THE BEST TIME TO RIDE
Compare start times throughout the day. Two hours can be the difference between a soaking and a dry ride, or between a strong headwind and a calm evening.
AIR QUALITY ALONG YOUR ROUTE
See the Air Quality Index along your route, with details on individual pollutants. See where air quality is worst and when conditions improve, especially when wildfire smoke is changing with the wind.
USE THE ROUTES YOU ALREADY HAVE
Connect to Strava, Ride with GPS, Komoot, Garmin Connect, Trailforks, MapMyRide, Plotaroute, and Runkeeper, or open a GPX, FIT, or TCX file.
You can also forecast Strava Segments to see which of your favorites have the wind behind you today.
Professional teams can connect directly to VeloViewer Race Hub.
BUILT FOR CYCLISTS
Road, gravel, mountain, bikepacking, commuting, racing: anything where you're outside long enough for the weather to change.
Epic Ride Weather is free to download and includes a 30-day trial with 1,000 forecasts, enough for around 30 to 40 rides of 100 km (60 miles).
Continued use requires a monthly or annual subscription. You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Terms of use: https://www.epicrideweather.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00128726:ios.description:
Memories is a cozy and beautifully designed couple app and anniversary tracker that helps you count love days, track long distance relationship milestones, and Never miss a moment that matters in your relationship.
Whether it is your wedding day, D-Day, love day, anniversary, birthday, vacation, or holiday, this app lets you count down upcoming events or count up from meaningful dates, all in one place. It also shows how many days have passed since your important moments.
SPECIAL FEATURES
Love Days Counter & Relationship Tracker
- Enter your special date, and the app will automatically calculate how many days you’ve been together
- Track milestones like 100 days, 1 year anniversary, and more
- Perfect love days counter for couples
Countdown and Count Up Events
- Countdown to upcoming anniversaries or important events
- Count up from special days in the past
- Supports Gregorian & Lunar calendar
Couple Space For You
- Create and decorate your own adorable home with your partner
- Raise adorable pets together and complete tasks to earn coins.
- Send messages, leave sticky notes, and share feelings to express love.
- Upload photos and capture your love story together.
Personalized Anniversary
- Celebrate your love by tracking how long you've been together.
- Customize your couple's names, avatars, and backgrounds for their special anniversary.
- Share your anniversary with friends using beautifully styled photos.
HomeScreen & LockScreen Widget
- Personalize your screen with adorable couple widgets.
- You can create multiple aesthetic widgets on your Home Screen & Lock Screen to glance at events.
- You can freely create couple widgets where you can modify fonts, theme colors, and background photos.
Smart Reminders
- Set your anniversary to repeat daily, weekly, monthly or yearly.
- Get reminders before on or after the date, so you'll never miss any important day again.
Automatic Organization
- Automatically sorting events by creation date, number of days or calendar date helps you focus on upcoming anniversaries.
- Pin important days to the top.
Backup and Sync
- Auto backup and restore your app data on iPhone & iPad devices by iCloud.
- Share backup files via AirDrop between iOS devices.
Mood Diary & Love Journal
- Write your private diary with photos, text and emojis.
- Record your mood with cute emotion emojis on Plutchik's Wheel of Emotions.
- With password lock and Face ID, your diary is kept just for you, creating a safe and private space.
Memories has everything you need to grow and celebrate your relationship.
A small couple space to keep your love, your memories, and your time together.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
- You can subscribe for unlimited access to all functions within Memories.
- Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Payment will be charged from your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
- Manage your subscription and disable auto renewal anytime in your iTunes Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://encofire.com/memories/privacy.html
User Agreement: https://encofire.com/memories/terms.html
Contact us: memorywidget@126.com

bluejetty:00172344:ios.summary:

• Manage files on your clou
bluejetty:00172344:ios.description:
All File Manger - Solid Explorer is a file management app inspired by the old school file commander applications. It will help you:
• Easily manage files in dual pane layout
• Protect files with strong encryption
• Manage files on your cloud storage or NAS
• Backup apps and files to any desired destination
• Explore your device
All File Manger - Solid Explorer lets you navigate to files stored on your device and automatically organizes them into collections. You can view, delete, move, rename or share any files. It also allows you to quickly find the files you need through indexed search with filters.
• Keep your files safe
All File Manger - Solid Explorer can protect selected files with strong AES encryption and put them in a secure folder, which contents are unreadable for other apps. The file manager will ask for password or fingerprint confirmation when you browse the folder. Even if you uninstall All File Manger - Solid Explorer, the files stay on your device and are still protected.
• Analyze Storage
Although this file manager doesn’t feature a dedicated storage analyzer, you can find out which files take up most of space by going to folder properties of internal storage or SD card. You will find the information about the percentage of space each folder takes and the list of biggest files. You can also use search with a file size filter.
• Organize remote files
All File Manger - Solid Explorer supports major network protocols and cloud providers to let you organize multiple remote file locations in one place. You can easily transfer files between cloud locations/servers just by dragging them from one panel to another.
◆ Major feature list:
• Files management - main storage, other store from PC
• Cloud storage - easily connect and manage files on Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox
• File encryption - password and fingerprint protection
• Archives - support for ZIP, 7ZIP, RAR and TAR files
• Indexed search - quickly find files on your device
• Analyze storage - manage files taking too much space on your device
• Organized collections - files categorized in Downloads, Recent,Photos, Videos, Music, Documents and Apps
• Internal image viewer, music player and text editor - for easier browsing on remote storages
• Batch rename - with support for naming patterns
• FTP Server to Share File - for accessing your local files from PC
• Themes and icon sets - rich customization options.
This app include Subscribe All File Manager Pro Monthly at $1.99 and All File Manager Pro Yearly at $9.99 to use ads free versions of the app for a Month and user can cancel it anytime.
– Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/liam-sammy-pp
– Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/liam-sammy-tos
If you are looking for a file manager app that has simple and sleek interface with full features, All File Explorer would be the best choice.

bluejetty:00180544:ios.summary: MusicBuddy is a powerful music album management app that gives you access to your entire music catalog, anywhere. Using MusicBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any album in your library, share your favorite albums, and keep
bluejetty:00180544:ios.description:
MusicBuddy is a powerful music album management app that gives you access to your entire music catalog, anywhere. Using MusicBuddy is fun and easy, allowing you to quickly find any album in your library, share your favorite albums, and keep track of borrowed and lent albums.
FREE VERSION
- MusicBuddy has all the features of MusicBuddy Pro with a 50 album limit. 
- MusicBuddy can be upgraded via In-App Purchase for unlimited album storage.
KEY FEATURES
• Adding Your Albums
Add your albums using the following options:
- Scan barcode (via iPhone camera or Bluetooth handheld scanner)
- Enter UPC/EAN-13
- Search online by keyword
- Add manually
- Import from CSV file
• Organizing Your Albums
Place your albums where they belong:
- My Albums — albums you own
- Wish List — albums you wish to own
- Borrowed — albums you borrowed from others
- Previously Owned — albums you no longer own
• Syncing Your Library
Sync your library across multiple devices using iCloud or Dropbox sync.
MORE TO LOVE
• Universal app — pay once and use MusicBuddy on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Silicon Mac.
• Personalize — use categories and tags, mark favorites, add personal notes, and much more.
• Appearance — choose either list or grid view to best match your needs.
• Custom Filters — filter your library by multiple criteria.
• Advanced Sorting — apply multi-level data sorting.
• Loans — instantly track albums that are currently loaned out.
• Multiple selection — apply batch operations using multiple selection.
• Quick find — instantly find albums by entering search keywords or scanning their barcodes.
• Export — quickly export your library into CSV, PDF, or HTML formats.
• Print — easily print selected albums to AirPrint-enabled printers.
• Backup — create backups to any cloud service.
• Activity History — view the full history of your loaning activities.
• Duplicates — quickly detect duplicates and easily remove them.
• Markdown Formatting — style your notes with headings, lists, bold, italics, links, and more.
• Privacy — your library is saved locally and privately on your device.
• And so much more!
FEEDBACK
We love staying in touch with our users and we look forward to hearing from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
support@kimicoapps.com 
or visit: http://www.kimicoapps.com/support.html
Follow us on Facebook:
http://www.facebook.com/KimicoLtd

bluejetty:00120059:ios.name: Drivers Ed: DMV Permit Test
bluejetty:00120059:ios.summary: Studying for a permit test in the United States? Pass your DMV Driving Test the first time! With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever yo
bluejetty:00120059:ios.description:
Studying for a permit test in the United States? Pass your DMV Driving Test the first time! With this application you will make progress more quickly than with any other traditional method, as you can take the tests wherever and whenever you want, without the need to be connected: at the bus stop, in a bar, in the classroom, at work or at the dentist’s waiting room…! 
The application is divided into the following sections:
- MOCK DMV TEST
Mock test simulates the real test format. When you finish the test you will see your score and review all the questions.
- PRACTICE TEST BY TOPICS
Test your knowledge by practicing by topics. Select one or more topics to practice.
- DRIVER'S MANUALS (ALL 50 STATES)
You can download your state’s Driver's Manual to your device anytime! After the first download, the manual is saved on your device so you don’t have to wait for the download again. The manuals are official DMV publications.
- PROGRESS MONITOR
The application saves the result of each question answered and a history of failures and successes to offer the most advanced system of all the statistics.   In this section you can see two types of charts: 
- Graphic Mock test: Shows your progress on the number of fails you have been done in test simulations.
- Graphics by topic: Shows a bar graph with the percentage completed for each category. 
*** APPLICATION FEATURES ***
+ Download your state’s Driver's Manual so you can read and study any time.
+ Intelligent learning system: The questions are selected using an algorithm taking into account your latest scores and the questions that you need to practice more.
+ Track and monitor your progress. Analyse your performance and find out when you have reached test standard.
+ Directly from the app, you can share your successes on Facebook.
+ Modern and very easy to use interface.
Note: the DMV (Department of Motor Vehicles) is also known in various states as the BMV, DDS, DOL, DOT, DPS, DVS, HSMV, MVD, MVDL, MVS, OMV, and RMV.

Join the American Cancer Society’s fight against cancer!
At the American Cancer Society, we're on a mission to free the world from cancer. Until we do, we'll be funding and conducting research, sharing expert information, supporting patie
bluejetty:00180694:ios.description:
Join the American Cancer Society’s fight against cancer!
At the American Cancer Society, we're on a mission to free the world from cancer. Until we do, we'll be funding and conducting research, sharing expert information, supporting patients, and spreading the word about prevention. All so you can live longer — and better.
The FUNdraising App
The American Cancer Society FUNdraising app puts the FUN in fundraising! It enables Relay For Life© and Making Strides Against Breast Cancer participants to easily register for events and accept donations on-the-go.
Use the FUNdraising app to:
Register for your local Relay For Life or Making Strides Against Breast Cancer events
Accept in-person credit card and check donations with state-of-the-art scanning technologies and bank-grade security features
Create a Facebook Fundraiser
Share your fundraiser directly to your social and professional contacts and networks
Solicit donations via PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo
Send donation receipts and thank you notes
Create and update your personal event fundraising page
Track your personal, team, and event fundraising progress
Monitor your fundraising progress to goal
View your earned personal and team badges
Fundraise for the American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network (ACS CAN)
Note that you must be a registered participant of one of our events to use this app. Register for Relay For Life and Making Strides Against Breast Cancer directly from the app. Verified participants of ResearcHERS, Real Men Wear Pink, and DetermiNation events can also accept donations using the app.
Relay For Life
For more than 35 years, communities across the world have come together to honor and remember loved ones and take action for lifesaving change. Relayers fundraise for a future free from cancer. We’re asking you to join the movement and sign up to save lives. Visit RelayForLife.org for more information.
Making Strides Against Cancer
From large-scale traditional walks to unique local experiences and celebrations, the American Cancer Society's Making Strides Against Breast Cancer has united communities, companies, and individuals across the country in the fight to end breast cancer for more than two decades – and we have no intention of ever slowing down. Visit MakingStridesWalk.org for more information.

bluejetty:00037264:ios.description:
Game Tracker is the ultimate app for every gamer. Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, it helps you organize your video game collection, track your playtime, and manage your backlog like never before.
Building a game library is exciting, but keeping it organized can be a challenge. Game Tracker makes it simple. Search for any title, add it to your collection, and let the app fill in the details like genre, publisher, platform, and more. Browse your library by genre, publisher, or any criteria you choose.
Game Tracker is free to download. Add up to 5 games and create 1 custom Space at no cost. Unlock unlimited games and Spaces across all your devices with a Pro subscription (monthly, annual, or lifetime).
Here's what makes Game Tracker your go-to gaming companion:
SYNC ACROSS ALL DEVICES
Add a game on your iPhone and see it instantly on your iPad and Mac. Your entire collection and progress stay perfectly in sync, no matter which device you use.
CUSTOM SPACES
Create personalized Spaces to organize your games your way. Group them by genre, platform, completion status, or any system that works for you.
SMART LISTS
Set up Smart Lists that automatically filter and update your collection. Want to see all your unfinished RPGs or recently added titles? Smart Lists handle it effortlessly.
TIME TRACKING AND TIME TO BEAT
Log your play sessions with the built-in timer and see exactly how long each game takes to complete. Compare your playtime against average completion times to see how you measure up.
GAME STATISTICS
Get a clear picture of your gaming habits. View your total playtime, number of completed games, and more with detailed stats and insights.
DEEP iOS AND macOS INTEGRATION
Track your playtime in real time with Live Activity right on your Lock Screen. Use widgets and Control Center shortcuts to start your timer instantly. Take advantage of Shortcuts and Siri to control Game Tracker hands-free.
YOUR PRIVACY COMES FIRST
Game Tracker does not collect your personal data or track your activity. Your gaming life stays private, always.
Whether you are chasing 100% completion, managing a massive backlog, or simply want a better way to organize your games, Game Tracker is the app you need. Download it today and take your gaming to the next level!

bluejetty:00179069:ios.name: Donut Punks: Online Epic Brawl
bluejetty:00179069:ios.summary: AAAHHH! You’re surrounded by zombies, but you are not one of them! Which means that it’s time to kick those boring monsters out of your life: there are no rules or restrictions, only fun, hardcore fun and tons of donuts dropped by your enem
bluejetty:00179069:ios.description:
AAAHHH! You’re surrounded by zombies, but you are not one of them! Which means that it’s time to kick those boring monsters out of your life: there are no rules or restrictions, only fun, hardcore fun and tons of donuts dropped by your enemies.
Fight the dreary zombies, but watch out—you’re not the only survivor. Other players also dream about donuts, which means they are already preparing to use perks against you! Don’t hold back, deploy a perk yourself and watch the zombies devour all your opponents.
Donut Punks is a MOBA for the most cunning. It’s an action adventure shooter that will make you a PvP and PvE genius. Crush them bungling zombies and reveal your inner potential!
Charge into action-filled battles:
• Play real-time PvP and PvE battles with friends. Crush zombies, collect donuts and defeat opponents with cunning. Watch out—they want to take your trophies!
• A gang of crazy characters is waiting. Choose any, learn unique skills and work out your own tactic!
• Zombies are dumb but vicious. Each has their own secret attacks, and some drop unique loot!
• Launch a multiplayer Donut Hunt. There are four of you, but it’s every man for himself. Shoot the most zombies to collect donuts.
• Start your own ColleXion. Play a coop doubles match and fill the collectors full of donuts ahead of the opposing team.
• Experience the power of Hardcore! Test your nerves by shooting your way out of a battle with the angriest zombies on the planet.
Real-time coop battles with friends are cool and all, but don’t forget to up your game:
• Check out Donut Pass. Perseverance in multiplayer battles will bring you special bonuses. Log in to Donut Pass more often and don’t forget to get all of the season’s rewards.
• Collect Trophies. Win to unlock new characters and new modes.
• Customize! We have skins that’ll blow your mind and expand your consciousness.
And remember: you are not a zombie as long as you’re cool, fresh and reckless. Luck you!
This unique shooter is available online for free, but some in-game items are sold for real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, set a password for purchases in the device settings.
Support: support@donut.games
Privacy Policy: donut.games/privacy
Term of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Strengthen your account protection with Auth Authenticator, the fast, reliable, and secure Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) app trusted by thousands of users. Generate time-based one-time passwords (TOTP) and keep your online accounts safe from unauthorized access.
Whether you're securing your Google, Facebook, Instagram, Microsoft, Amazon, or other important accounts, Auth Authenticator offers an easy, secure, and convenient way to manage all your 2FA codes.

* iCloud Encrypted Backup
 Securely store your 2FA accounts with automatic iCloud backup. Recover your codes anytime, even if you lose or change your device.
* Apple Watch Support
 View your verification codes right from your Apple Watch — instant access without pulling out your phone.
* Multi-Device Sync
  Seamlessly sync your 2FA accounts across multiple Apple devices, ensuring you’re always connected.
* Offline Access Anywhere 
Generate one-time passwords even when offline or traveling — no internet connection required.
* Quick & Easy Setup 
Add accounts via QR code scan or manual key entry in seconds.

 Keep your codes safe with Face ID, Touch ID, or a secure PIN.
* Works with All Popular Platforms Compatible with Google, Facebook, Instagram, Microsoft, Amazon, Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub, Dropbox, and any app or service supporting TOTP 2FA.
* Time-Based One-Time Password (TOTP) Security
 Industry-standard TOTP algorithm ensures your codes refresh automatically every 30 seconds for strong, reliable protection.
* No Ads, Fully Private
 Ad-free, privacy-first design — your information stays with you.
Why risk your accounts? Get Auth Authenticator today — the trusted, feature-packed 2FA app with iCloud Backup, Apple Watch support, and multi-device sync.

bluejetty:00174510:ios.description:
Your device can create secure 2FA (two-factor authentication) tokens for your internet accounts using the Authenticator app. The Authenticator app is a straightforward and free tool for Authenticator that creates time-based one-time passwords (TOTP). The Authenticator app adds an extra layer of security to your account, assisting you in preventing hackers from accessing it. You may save all of your keys in the cloud and access them whenever you need to with the 2FA Backup solution. Installing the Authenticator app on your new device will grant you access to your Keys in the event that you lose or damage your phone. You have the option of manually entering your secret key or scanning a QR Code for convenience.
FEATURES:
- Secure your Accounts
Scan QR code or enter manually to add accounts.
- Protect your passwords
Manage & Storage your account passwords.
- Offline
Authenticator generates secure codes even offline, this will allow you to authenticate securely even when your device is in airplane mode.
- Encrypted Backup:
Backup & Sync your 2FA accounts with iCloud.
With a PREMIUM subscription get Full Features of the Authenticator app:
- Secure & Private:
To make sure that only you have access to your data, all information stored in Authenticator is always encrypted, even when it is kept on iCloud.
- Encrypted Backup:
If you lose your device or decide to switch to a new one, you can always create a safely encrypted backup in Authenticator.
- Across All Devices Synchronization:
With Authenticator, all of your tokens will sync automatically across all Apple devices.
- Faster access with Apple Watch or Touch ID:
For easier access, use Apple Watch or Touch ID to unlock Authenticator.
- A two-factor authentication system:
By requiring both a standard password and a Time-based One-time Password, 2FA increases the security of the account twofold (TOTP). On the user's device, the Authenticator App creates a TOTP.
- Backup -2FAS
We're working on a remote backup service feature that will let you store service keys in a safe Authenticator Backup based on the cloud and retrieve them in the event that your phone is lost. You will be able to create codes using this capability on many devices (cross-device sharing).
- Use Touch ID or Face ID to authorize
Create one-time tokens needed to log in to your online accounts by using Touch ID or Face ID to verify your identity with the application.
- Sync across devices
Once set up with an online account, the application functions well on a variety of mobile devices and enables simultaneous logins from several devices.
- No password was saved.
The program creates Time-based One-time Passwords (TOTP), which are then kept locally on the user's phone without access to the internet. With this technique, login security is significantly increased.
- All Popular Accounts:
In addition to thousands of other service providers, we support the most well-known ones including Facebook, Coinbase, Amazon, Gmail, Instagram, and Roblox. We also accept tokens with 8 digits.
"Authenticator App helps you to secure all your online accounts.

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can turn off auto-renew up to 24 hours before your next subscription payment is due via your App Store settings page. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00048159:android.description:
Super Adventure : Jungle Adventures is classic retro platform game style. This game bring back memories of old school arcade games with numerous adventure. World of this game contains well designed levels, various enemies, bosses, simple gameplay, nice graphics and soothing music and sounds.
On beautiful sunny day Ted and his girlfriend were eating apples together and enjoying life and suddenly "Evil Dinosaur Monster" appeared from deep jungle out of no where. That evil moster captured Ted's girlfriend and ran away in deep jungle world. Ted is on Super Adventure to rescue his girlfriend by defeating Dinosaur Monster and teach him a lesson.
To bring Ted's girlfriend back he needs your help. Run and jump through the deep jungle adventures, avoid traps, clear all enemies in your way and defeat all bosses. Super Adventure : Jungle Adventures will give you classic feel throughout the game with side scrolling view.
Super Adventures : Jungle Adventures Features:
+ Beautiful high-resolution graphics 
+ Awesome gameplay similar to retro classic game
+ Easy and intuitive controls with on-screen retro controller
+ Hidden bonus bricks and blocks with strawberry, flower and shield
+ Destroyable bricks, blocks and moving platform
+ Hidden bonus levels with lots of classic and modern coins
+ Additional collectibles, coins, shields and more
+7 beautiful worlds with 140 well designed levels
+ Underground and water worlds, swim, jump and run
+ Over 20 enemies and obstacles
+ 12 boss fights: angry scorpio, spider, big bee and golem
+ Store with additional items and rewards: unlock worlds before finish other worlds
+ Unlock free coins, buy items to make mike and max stronger
+ Classic retro platform game style
+ Suitable for all ages
How to play Super Adventures : Jungle Adventure :
+ Eat mushroom and flower to become stronger and defeat all monsters.
+ Tap Left / Right to move.
+ Jump to crash the enemy.
+ Eat flower to shoot enemy.
+ Collect all coins and bonus items to get more points and buy additional items in store.
Download Super Adventures : Jungle Adventures now! It is a fun game super adventures for every one!
Enjoy your childhood memories now!

bluejetty:00017119:ios.description:
Introducing Showcase Subscribe by Showcase Cinemas, the ultimate movie ticket subscription program that keeps all movie-lovers in mind. Transform your movie-going experience with our exclusive subscription service designed for both individuals and groups, ensuring the cinematic experience is accessible to all. Our subscription options provide an unmatched value, allowing members to see countless movies for a fixed, monthly rate without any blackout dates. Enjoy the freedom to watch films in premium formats like 3D, XPlus, and IMAX, and indulge with a 20% discount on in-theater snacks and beverages.
Download the Showcase Subscribe app to unlock a realm of perks: advanced ticket bookings, discounts on dining in our theaters, Starpass member rewards, and much more. Need to pause your plan? It’s hassle-free, offering you flexibility when life gets busy.
Key Highlights:
· Flexible Subscription Plans: Tailor your subscription to fit your cinematic preferences, whether you’re flying solo or prefer to watch with a group.
· Advance Ticket Reservations: Ensure you never miss opening night with the convenience of booking your tickets in advance, including select Event Cinema titles for a curated experience.
· Savings on In-Theater Dining: Enjoy a 20% discount on a wide range of delectable food and beverage options, enhancing every movie outing.
· Easy Planning and Tracking: Keep track of your movie plans and reservations with ease, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience.
· Stay Updated: Be the first to know about the latest film releases and exclusive cinema news, keeping you ahead of the movie game.
At the heart of Showcase Subscribe is our commitment to transforming your moviegoing experience. With a focus on flexibility, affordability, and the sheer joy of movie-watching, we offer:
· Tailored Subscription Options: Our plans are designed to accommodate both individual moviegoers and groups, ensuring everyone can partake in the cinematic adventure. Our pricing structure is designed to be wallet-friendly, allowing for countless movie experiences at an affordable monthly cost.

bluejetty:00031634:ios.description:
Note: This replaces the existing MyChart app for Duke patients. If you previously accessed your account on the MyChart app, please discontinue use and download this new, Duke-specific app to access your account. 
At Duke Health, your well-being is at the center of everything we do. The My Duke Health App makes it easy to stay connected with Duke Health and offers you access to the health information of you and your family whenever you want it. With the My Duke Health app, you can conveniently manage your health information and: 
• See urgent care wait times 
• Find a Duke doctor
• Access Duke’s approved health resource library 
• Easily access Duke Virtual Urgent Care offerings 
• Find location based resources like parking and hotels
• Stay connected with Duke Health news, blogs, and social media 
Through the My Duke Health app, log in to: 
• Conduct video visits 
• Review test results, medications, immunization history, and more 
• Communicate with your care team 
• Schedule and manage appointments 
• View visit summaries and doctors’ notes from past visits and hospital stays 
• View and pay medical bills 
• Access your family’s health information through proxy access 
• Securely share your medical record online
• Connect patient accounts from other hospitals or clinics 
• Connect your account to Apple HealthKit to share health-related data from mobile devices 
You will need to have an active account to use all the features of the My Duke Health app. If you do not have an existing Duke MyChart account, you can register on our website: https://www.dukemychart.org/home/accesscheck.asp 
To learn more about My Duke Health, see our FAQs: https://www.dukemychart.org/home/Authentication/Login?mode=stdfile&option=faq

bluejetty:00036136:ios.description:
Silent Shadows, Deadly Shots – Become the Ultimate Sniper shooter
Gear up, Legend Sniper, it's a critical mission! An operative with multiple challenges is awaiting your expertise. Oh no, another critical task just came up – a high-profile target requiring precise elimination. Now in sniper games 3d, identify, aim, and execute your targets swiftly, complete the mission, and get the reward.
Equip yourself with modern snipers. Engage yourself in gun shooting missions, Become the true hero in the world of snipers!
Exciting Features Legend Sniper Games - Gun Game
Weapons Collection: 7 unique sniper rifles. Stinger, Barrett, SVD, M24, Mecha, Skull G550 and Jagura. Before selecting a gun, view the details like gun range, clip size, fire rate, damage, and zoom.
Target Lock: Tap on enemy pointers to lock them as targets, face them head-on, and kill them.
Slow-motion shots: Gun strike shots give you an exhilarating 3d gun shooting games experience.
Helicopter Mission: While riding a helicopter, you'll use your air strike abilities to shoot and stop criminals.
Diverse Locations: Visit different places around the cities and take on special missions in different surroundings in this thrilling sniper game.
Intuitive Controls: Feel like a professional sniper shooter with simple and smooth shooting gun games controls.
Low Mb Size: Efficient storage utilization, and smoother gameplay even on devices with limited storage capacity.
Daily Rewards: Collect daily gifts to unlock more items of 3d sniper games offline.
Enjoy Every Mode – Legend Sniper Gun Games Adventure
Career - Sniper Shooter Games
Eliminate targets in many cities around the world. Use your rooftop snipers skills to shoot at a target that is wanted, which may be an armed criminal, rescue an innocent hostage, a thief, a dealing gangster a guy planning a bomb attack, or any other dangerous offender.
The objective is given to you before starting the gun strike weapon shooter mission, kill the target. 90+ Level, each upcoming level will be more challenging than the previous one.
Gunship Strike
Feel the excitement of an air strike strategic mission. Get on a helicopter to find and stop enemies attacking, or do a rescue operation to save the market, help the police, or a trapped group. Your task is clearly defined in gun strike mission. 20 Stages, No time limit. Complete the Level, and get the gifts.

bluejetty:00076107:ios.description:
Our dating app "123 Date Me" features the best of most important options for a modern online dating app and even more. You can browse singles near you or anywhere in the world. You can filter profiles by their status to see only active members. You can play "Match game" to rate members quickly by photos. You can answer questions about love and relationship and find members sharing your values.
Our profiles are very detailed and we encourage users to fill them as much as possible. We have there not just information about the look and search criteria, but also hobbies, day regime, car, pets, food preferences, etc. Matching things are marked with color, so you can easily see what you both have in common and chat about it.
We believe that trust is very important, so we review manually all photos and texts and take other measures to make sure you will be talking to real people. We also offer members to verify their profiles (for free) in 4 steps, such profiles are marked with a special badge and get priority.
App name is talking for itself - we try to help you find a date as easy as 1, 2, 3. So, all you have to do now is to download the application :)

bluejetty:00122699:ios.description:
This app is designed for corporate cardholders in the Nordics (formerly Eurocard) and for international companies using AirPlus Corporate through our Cross Border Issuing solutions.
With the AirPlus app you have full control of your balance, purchases and receipts. You will find features for smarter management of expenses. You can for example, scan and save your paper receipts with the app.
• Scan paper receipts and match them with the transaction.
• Easy import of PDF receipts.
• Block and order a new card if it has been lost or stolen.
• Choose and view your PIN code.
• Pause and unpause your card anytime.
• Convert currencies on business trips or on purchases from abroad.
• With ”Installment payment” you can get a quick view of what the monthly cost would be with partial payments on a larger purchase with your AirPlus card.
• Insurance guides helps you sort out if your insurance covers delayed baggage and flights.
Please note: This app is not intended for legacy AirPlus cardholders. They should continue to use the AirPlus Mobile App.

bluejetty:00037872:ios.name: Yulu - top eBike sharing app
bluejetty:00037872:ios.summary:
Yulu - Safe, Sanitised & Solo Mobility Solution | Eco-friendly
Yulu is India’s leading micro-mobility service provider, which offers unique vehicles for the daily commute. Starting as a mission to eliminate traffic congestion in India, Yul
bluejetty:00037872:ios.description:
Yulu - Safe, Sanitised & Solo Mobility Solution | Eco-friendly
Yulu is India’s leading micro-mobility service provider, which offers unique vehicles for the daily commute. Starting as a mission to eliminate traffic congestion in India, Yulu provides the safest commute solution through a user-friendly mobile app to enable shared, solo and sustainable commuting.
Yulu zones are located at all the appropriate locations (including metro stations, bus stands, office spaces, residential areas, corporate offices, etc) to make those first and last-miles smooth, affordable, and convenient!
Wondering how you can get on this mission with us? It’s as easy as riding a Yulu!
Download the Yulu App & pay a one-time security deposit
Now, locate a Yulu or Yulu zone nearest to you
Unlock the bike by scanning the QR located on the bike panel
And that’s it, enjoy your smooth & easy Yulu ride!
You can pause your ride by simply clicking the “Pause” button on the app & resume by clicking “Resume”
To end your ride, park the bike at a Yulu zone, lock it and hit “End Ride” on the app
Yulu doesn’t require a driver’s license but, we strongly recommend abiding by all traffic laws!
Key Features of Yulu:
- Smart, Dockless Bikes -> Electric vehicles that are fully automated powered by IoT technology
- Prioritizing Safety -> All Yulu vehicles are frequently disinfected & sanitized by WHO recommended chemicals to ensure safety on the go. Our field staff wears masks and gloves while handling each vehicle.
- Last Sanitized Stamp -> Every Yulu has a “Last Sanitized” stamp on the app that informs you about when that bike was last disinfected.
- Healthy & Eco-friendly -> Yulus leave behind zero carbon emission to keep the environment healthy. What’s more? Yulu Move keeps a track of the number of calories you burn to keep you healthy!
- Easily Accessible -> Yulu zones are placed at all appropriate locations (including metro stations, bus stands, office spaces, residential areas, corporate offices, etc)
- Highly Affordable -> Our pricing is very nominal as we charge not for the distance covered but for the time you rent it for! Ride at just Rs.1.50 per minute in Bengaluru and Mumbai. *Detailed pricing on the app
- Convenient Payment -> All payments are 100% digital, so you don’t have to look for any change in your pockets. International payment also accepted
- Super Saver Packs -> We’ve curated daily, weekly, and monthly Saver Packs so you can save more on your daily rides!
- Over-night Keep -> Like Yuluing? Take it home for the night! Keep your Yulu at home after 6 pm at affordable charges.
Cities we’re moving towards sustainability:
Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Bhubaneswar
Connect with us at:
www.instagram.com/yulubike/
www.facebook.com/yulumobility/
www.linkedin.com/company/yulu/
https://twitter.com/YuluBike

bluejetty:00039484:ios.description:
تم تطوير صحتي من قبل وزارة الصحة في المملكة العربية السعودية تماشياً مع رؤيتها لتسهيل الوصول للرعاية الصحية وتحسين جودتها وزيادة الوعي الصحي في المجتمع.
- تعد صحتي منصة وطنية لصحة سكان المملكة من مواطنين ومقيمين من خلال توفير المعلومات الصحية والخدمات ذات الصلة لأكثر من 24 مليون مستفيد.
- تهدف منصة صحتي إلى تمكين الأفراد من الحصول على معلوماتهم الصحية وتلقي الخدمات الطبية الإلكترونية التي تقدمها المؤسسات الصحية المختلفة في المملكة.
ضمن استراتيجية الوزارة لتسهيل الوصول للرعاية الصحية وتحسين جودتها جرى العمل على دمج جميع التطبيقات في القطاع الصحي. وتم حتى الان دمج كلا من موعد وتطمن وصحة ورصد وبطاقة التأمين من مجلس الضمان. والعمل مستمر لإكمال الربط مع باقي الخدمات في المنظومة الصحية.
- بعض هذه الخدمات تشمل:
مواعيد فحص كوفيد 19: بأكثر من 24 مليون موعد
لقاح كوفيد 19: تم تقديم أكثر من 51 مليون جرعة لقاح
المواعيد: تم حجز أكثر من 3.8 مليون موعد ما بين حضوري وافتراضي
التقارير الطبية (مثل الإجازات المرضية): تم إصدار أكثر من 9.5 مليون تقرير إجازة مرضي
استشارة فورية: تقديم أكثر من 1.5 مليون استشارة
تعزيز نمط الحياة الصحي والوعي: تسجيل أكثر من 2 مليون فرد في حملة المشي وأكثر من 700 ألف في مبادرة اعرف أرقامك لتسجيل المؤشرات الحيوية.
بالإضافة إلى تقديم خدمات أخرى:
المحفظة الصحية
وصفات الأدوية
خدمة طبيبي
لقاحات الأطفال
البحث عن الأدوية (رصد)
Sehhaty is provided by the Ministry of Health in Saudi Arabia, in line with its vision to increase access to care, improve standards of healthcare and increase health awareness in the community.
It is the National Population Health Platform for all citizens’ and residents’ health information and related services in Saudi Arabia with over 24 million user registered.
It aims to enable individuals to obtain their health information and receive medical e-services provided by different health organizations in the Kingdom.
Within the Ministry's strategy to facilitate access to health care and improve, its quality, great achievements have been accomplished to integrate all applications in the health sector. So far; Mawid, Tetamman, Sehha app., RSD and insurance card from the Council of Health Insurance have been merged. Work is ongoing to complete to merge with the rest of the services in the health systems.
Some of these services include:
COVID-19 Tests appointments: With +24 Million appointment
COVID-19 Vaccine: +51 Million vaccine dosage administered
Appointments: +3.8 Million physician and virtual appointments booked
Medical Reporting (e.g. Sick leave): +9.5 million Sick leave report issued
Real-time consultation: +1.5 million consultation
Promoting healthy lifestyle and awareness: +2 Million Registered individuals in the walking campaign and +700K in Know Your Numbers Initiative for capturing health related vital signs.
In addition to other services:
Health Wallet
Medication Prescriptions
My Doctor Service
Children Vaccine
Drug Search (RSD)
Sehhaty app needs access to your HealthApp via HealthKit and CareKit to share your walking activities and the number of steps

bluejetty:00114763:ios.description:
Yarn Escape: The Ultimate 3D Wool Sort Puzzle Game
Step into the colorful world of Yarn Escape! Are you ready to untangle the ultimate wool sort puzzle? Experience the most satisfying 3D puzzle game where you must unravel yarn to clear your mind and sharpen your logic. If you love a good color sort challenge, this cozy adventure is designed just for you.
How to Play this Yarn Game Each level presents a complex knitted model trapped in a mess of threads. Your task? Sort the vibrant wool into the correct places to free them. Use the unique 360 rotation feature to inspect the 3D knots from every angle and find the best way to unravel wool. It sounds simple, but space is limited! You’ll need strategy to untangle every thread and keep everything organized.
Exciting Game Features
- Master the 360 Rotation: Move around each knitted model to find the perfect path to unravel yarn.
- Relaxing Wool Sort: Enjoy soft textures and cozy designs. It’s more than just a game; it’s an asmr experience for your brain.
- Challenging 3D Puzzles: Start with an easy wool sort, but prepare for tricky knitted challenges that require real skill.
- Untangle & Unravel: Use special boosters to unravel wool from tight spots and escape the yarn maze.
Why You’ll Love Yarn Escape
- Brain Training: A perfect wool sort puzzle that combines relaxation with logic.
- Cozy Aesthetic: Beautifully designed knitted objects and satisfying thread movements.
- Play Your Way: Short bursts of color sort or long yarn puzzle game sessions-it’s up to you.
Unwind & Escape Download Yarn Escape: Color Wool Sort now! Untangle your mind, master the wool sort, and discover how far your yarn journey can take you. Can you solve every knitted model and become the ultimate 3D sorting master?

bluejetty:00161879:ios.summary:
