Blockly is a visual drag-and-drop programming tool developed b
bluejetty:00015046:ios.description:
PLEASE NOTE: This app requires a Wonder Workshop robot (Dash or Dot) to play. To find out more, please visit our website: https://www.makewonder.com. This app is FREE to play.
Blockly is a visual drag-and-drop programming tool developed by Google that allows children to snap together commands like puzzle pieces. This app includes dozes of coding challenges for kids to tackle. They can also invent their own creations using Blockly to program Dash & Dot! 
Learn concepts like sequencing, events, loops, algorithms, operations, and variables through self-directed play and guided challenges. A series of puzzles teach the concepts of coding through playful storylines, allowing kids to learn and explore all on their own. 
Kids can confidently embark on their own coding adventures with their newfound knowledge, a dash of creativity, and robot buddy - Dash. For ages 6 and up.
As seen on the New York Times, USA TODAY, WIRED, Engadget, BBC, and more.
“Thoroughly absorbing.” - New York Times
“Both kids begged me to take out the robots and start playing with them again.” - Business Insider
“Wonder Workshop's notion that kids need to learn twenty-first century skills (and can have fun doing it) flips the industry paradigm on its head, putting kids first.” - James Oppenheim
"They are designed to encourage kids to explore and be curious while also learning problem solving." - VentureBeat
HOW TO PLAY
- Connect Dash and/or Dot to the Blockly app using Bluetooth Smart/4
- Start with a sample project or start your own projects from scratch
- Navigate Dash through a maze or around the room, using object detection to avoid walls
- Dash knows when it's being picked up and moved. Program Dash to sound the alarm when there is a disturbance!
- Program Dash to do synchronized dance moves with lights, motion, and sounds
If you have any questions or suggestions, we would love to hear from you! Contact us at any time at https://help.makewonder.com. 
ABOUT WONDER WORKSHOP
Wonder Workshop, an award-winning creator of educational toys and applications for children, was founded in 2012 by three parents on a mission to make learning to code meaningful and fun for children. Through open-ended play and learning experiences, we hope to instill a sense of wonder while helping kids develop their creative problem solving skills. We play test with children throughout our product and app development process to make sure our experiences are frustration free and fun. 
Wonder Workshop takes children's privacy very seriously. Our apps do not include any third-party advertising or collect any personal information. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
Privacy Policy:
https://www.makewonder.com/privacy
Terms of Service:
https://www.makewonder.com/TOS
Make Wonder:
https://www.makewonder.com/make-wonder

bluejetty:00178826:ios.name: Idle Golf Club Manager Tycoon
bluejetty:00178826:ios.summary:
Will you be able to manage a whole golf club, build your golf empire and become the biggest golf tycoon in the world?!
Become rich as an idle golfing capitalist and build and grow your golf course from one small hole to a thriving golf clu
bluejetty:00178826:ios.description:
Will you be able to manage a whole golf club, build your golf empire and become the biggest golf tycoon in the world?!
Become rich as an idle golfing capitalist and build and grow your golf course from one small hole to a thriving golf club with happy members enjoying the best golf of their lives. If you like sports games, golf games or management and simulation games, then this is going to be the most enjoyable game with many updates, courses and features to come.
As a golf club tycoon, transform your small patch of land into a green and luscious golf course with hundreds of members playing at your prestigious golf club. Attract the best players in the world to tournaments.
EXPAND YOUR GOLF COURSE
You start off with just one golf hole, but there are 18 holes in total to unlock as you expand your world, see your golf club grow and your golf players will love being part of your growing empire. Be a real tiger and an ambitious manager of this thriving golf club. Each hole can be upgraded with trees, bunkers, flowers and plants, better tees, ball cleaners, trash cans, lakes, rivers and more. It’s up to you to manage your golf course to make it the prettiest golf club in the world.
GOLF BUGGIES
As you manage your golf club to become a golfing millionaire, you’re building a big golf course. And there’s only one way to get around in style - with your own golf buggy of course! So make sure you’ve got enough golf buggies for your club members as, without a buggy, you can’t get on the course. Plus you can get players around quicker and you know what that means...you get richer quicker!
PUTTING GREEN
As they say, “distance for show, putting for dough”. Well here’s your chance to practice your golf shots on the putting green. Can you hold your nerve and hole the putts on the golf putting green? Don’t clash with your golf rivals until you’ve battled your way on the putting green before you take to the golf course. You can also manage your putting green with benches, trash cans, bushes and lots of holes. In the hole!!
RUN TOURNAMENTS
Having golf club members is great, but the way to really become a golf club tycoon is to run tournaments where you attract the best pro players from around the world. And that means you’ll earn money and get rich with TV companies wanting to film the hot golfing battles and clashes on the golf course. You’ll also attract fans to watch the game and so you’ll need stands, restrooms, TV crews and more.
SPORTS LOUNGE
Once you’ve finished 18 holes on the golf course, you deserve to relax with your other golfing friends in the sports lounge. You can expand the number of tables and chairs you have to entertain the other golf club members. Get comfy seating but also ensure you manage your lounge properly with drinks and snacks, potted plants, TVs to watch the best golf tournaments in the world, snack machines, trophy cabinet (where you can place your golf battle trophies!), plus good speakers for the best music.
PRO SHOP
No idle golf tycoon would miss out on the chance to make money and cash to become rich, with their own pro shop or golf shop. There are so many ways to become a capitalist millionaire in your shop. With golf clothes, golf clubs, golf bags, golf balls, videos, posters, standing displays and more. This golf pro shop is made to be managed to become a rich golf club tycoon!
PREMIUM UPGRADES
As your members start to demand more from their golf club and golf course, you’ll need to upgrade your course with things like fountains, topiary sculptures, maple trees and more. It will be worth you investing in these premium items as you’ll become an even richer tycoon and attract higher-paying members. Yes!
LOTS MORE TO COME!
We hope you enjoy playing our Idle Golf Club Tycoon game. We look forward to updating the game with many more features, holes, courses, tournaments, plus expanding your golfing world to give you the players the chance to become rich as a millionaire tycoon!

bluejetty:00021814:ios.name: The Christmas Gift List
bluejetty:00021814:ios.summary: The Christmas Gift List is an absolute must-have for the upcoming holiday season! This handy app offers everything you will ever need to create a list of people whom you can’t leave without gifts, make a list of gifts you are going to buy a
bluejetty:00021814:ios.description:
The Christmas Gift List is an absolute must-have for the upcoming holiday season! This handy app offers everything you will ever need to create a list of people whom you can’t leave without gifts, make a list of gifts you are going to buy and keep your Christmas budget under control. The program lets you add people from your Contacts with a couple of taps and efficiently plan your spending for all of them. The Christmas Gift List offers best-in-class budgeting and analysis tools that are a breeze to use! 
The app features convenient data visualization and sorting tools, which makes it super-easy to find all people without a present or people that you don’t have a gift idea for. For better understanding of your current progress towards making everyone happy, the app visualizes your gift shopping statistics in the form of charts. Finally, you can do your Christmas planning on any of your iOS devices – thanks to the integrated support of iCloud, all Christmas List data are synchronized between devices even if devices have different Apple IDs.
Don’t forget anyone, keep your spending under control, and make sure everyone gets exactly what they dreamt of – The Christmas Gift List will help you make this a snap!
Program features: 
• Add people from Contacts
• Track Budgeting and Analytics to get all the information you need
• Sort people by groups: Family, Friends, Co-workers, etc.
• Track gifts by status: Idea, Need to Make, Need to Buy, Made, Bought, Shipping, Received, Wrapped, Sent, Presented
• Sort gifts by stores 
• Use 14 filters to quickly find the information you need 
• Collect gift ideas to easily use them later 
• Photos of people and gifts 
• Countdown until Christmas or New Year 
• Optional password protection 
• Support for Touch ID and Face ID
• Countdown widgets for Lock Screen and Home Screen
Pro version features:
• Sync Christmas lists across iOS devices via iCloud
• Sync data across devices with the same or different Apple IDs
• Archive lists for past years
• Add people and gifts from past years
• Export list to PDF for printing or sharing
• Configure PDF: organize list by people or gifts, configure columns, apply filters
• No banners, no ads

bluejetty:00065350:ios.summary: The Bank Independent Sync Mobile App brings the branch to you, allowing you to view your balances and recent transactions, transfer money between accounts, pay bills, deposit checks, and even locate the nearest sales office or ATM. It is f
bluejetty:00065350:ios.description:
The Bank Independent Sync Mobile App brings the branch to you, allowing you to view your balances and recent transactions, transfer money between accounts, pay bills, deposit checks, and even locate the nearest sales office or ATM. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Customization: Set up your dashboard exactly the way you need it.
Mobile Deposit: Deposit checks anytime, anywhere, right from your phone or tablet.
Debit Card Control: Temporarily turn your card off or back on, or quickly report it lost or stolen.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for transactions and balances.
Add Tags, Notes, & Images: Enhance transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Bank Independent Customer Service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features Touch ID and Face ID login options, in addition to a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Sync Mobile App, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with your existing Online Banking credentials. If you don't have credentials yet, tap "First time user? Enroll now". After you successfully log in to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00124189:ios.name: Rogue Dungeon RPG
bluejetty:00124189:ios.summary:
Exciting, strategic Action-RPG - roguelike dungeon crawler. No ads. Tap your way through the levels until the challenge is too great, boost yourself with the prestige system and try again stronger than ever.
Totally optional in-app purchas
bluejetty:00124189:ios.description:
Exciting, strategic Action-RPG - roguelike dungeon crawler. No ads. Tap your way through the levels until the challenge is too great, boost yourself with the prestige system and try again stronger than ever.
Totally optional in-app purchases. Level up and gain over 110 unique passive skills that interact in powerful ways! Hardcore: permanent death. Progression: unlock persistent bonuses and items with each run of the dungeon.
Collect magical and legendary items and relics. Power up your relics after death.
Inspired by classic PC action role-playing games, this roguelike RPG uses randomly generated maps, permanent character death, randomized item drops and more for unlimited replayability.
Regular updates are ongoing!
Instructions:
Touch anywhere to move
Touch and hold on nearby enemies to attack
Double-tap to use your special attack
Tap on items, chests, shrines and other things to interact
Collect shards to power up your relics!
Collect gemstones to resurrect after death!
Advance your character by discovering powerful items and relics. Gain levels for yourself and your relics. Choose from four ferocious classes - Warrior, Rogue, Mage and Monk
This game collects basic usage data but does not collect any personally identifying information.

BE WARNED. This game has no tutorial - part of the challenge is figuring out how to play. It's hard, but keep trying, and you'll master it. Good luck!
In this infamous roguelike narrative card game, play as a seeker after unholy mysteries in a 1920s-themed setting of hidden gods and secret histories. Become a scholar of the unseen arts. Craft tools and summon spirits. Indoctrinate innocents. Seize your place as the herald of a new age.
Cultist Simulator was first released on PC and has more than 200,000 players all over the world. Now we’re bringing the cosmic mysteries of Cultist Simulator to mobile.
• Challenging roguelike gameplay - There is never only one history.
Cultist Simulator doesn’t hold your hand. Experiment, expire and transcend death with a story-driven legacy system. Over time you’ll learn enough to wrestle the game to its knees.
• Intense, immersive narrative – Combine cards to tell your own story.
A hefty novel’s worth of choice-based storytelling, from the creator of Fallen London and Sunless Sea. There are many paths through this game of ambition, appetite and abomination, and many ways your tale can end.
• A rich Lovecraftian world – Corrupt your friends and consume your enemies.
Search your dreams for sanity-twisting rituals. Translate grimoires and glean their lore. Penetrate the realm of the Hours and win a place in their service. Cultist Simulator brings the peripheral horror of Lovecraft’s tales to an entirely new setting.
Expand your knowledge with the DLCs: New Legacies, New Ascensions, New Mechanics...
• The Dancer - Join the Bacchanal
• The Priest - Knock, and Ye Shall Be Opened
• The Ghoul - Taste of the graveyard's fruit
• The Exile - Some there are who will not yield

bluejetty:00076735:ios.description:
Ready to speak Levantine Arabic with confidence? 
Learn Levantine Arabic is your all-in-one platform, offering a structured lesson program fully integrated with a robust offline dictionary and phrasebook. Whether you're a beginner or seasoned learner advancing your skills, this app has everything you need to accelerate your learning and reach fluency faster.
Our lessons cover all essential topics and grammar fundamentals, carefully organised by levels, so you can start learning exactly where you need to, and progress at your own pace.
• Learn the Levantine Dialect Widely Understood Across the Region
We focus on a standardised form of Levantine Arabic that’s easily understood in Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, and Jordan - commonly known as the 'white dialect'. This makes it ideal whether you're traveling, connecting with locals, or immersing yourself in the rich cultures of the Levant.
• Take your learning with you
With both the dictionary and phrasebook available offline, you can confidently take your learning on the go, no matter where your journey takes you.
• Dictionary
- 700+ verbs categorized by form (I–X), with details on verb form, detailed tense conjugations, participles, and verbal nouns
- 1000+ nouns sorted into helpful categories for easy learning
- 300+ function words (conjunctions, prepositions, and adverbs)
- 400+ adjectives, covering moods, time, places, food, people, and more
Search in both English and Arabic, or browse by category
Bookmark your favourite words for easy review
• Phrasebook:
Access thousands of useful phrases, neatly organised by category
Audio support: Tap any phrase to hear it spoken in authentic Levantine Arabic
Transliteration: Perfect for beginners who haven’t mastered reading Arabic yet
Search for any phrase or word quickly and easily
Customisable Phrases: Modify phrases to fit your unique situation, making everyday interactions effortless.
Save & Manage Phrases: Bookmark words and phrases for personalized learning, and access them anytime under the “More” tab.
So why Choose Learn Levantine Arabic? This app isn’t just a dictionary or lesson hub – it’s a fully immersive learning experience. From detailed verb conjugations to practical phrases with audio, we’ve packed everything you need to get fluent in Levantine Arabic into one intuitive platform. Start your journey today and unlock the full potential of learning the Levantine dialect.
Contact & Support
If you encounter any issues or have questions, feel free to contact us directly at mail@learnlevantine.com
Subscription Terms of Use
For details on our subscription terms, please visit: https://learnlevantine.com/legal/terms
For privacy terms, please visit: https://learnlevantine.com/legal/privacy

* Reduce screen time and improve your focus

* Completely free for most use cases
* No account creation or shady VPNs
Burnout Buddy is stronger than your iPhone's native Screen Time controls. Designed specifically with social media addiction and unhealthy work habits in mind, it offers a wider variety of blocking mechanisms and allows you to be extremely specific regarding how access to a specific group of apps and websites should be restricted. If you already use Burnout Buddy, keep an eye out for updates that add even more blocking mechanisms and customization points!

* Block indefinitely
* Schedule-based blocking
* Usage-based blocking
* Location-based blocking (via Siri)
* Focus Mode-based blocking (via Siri)
* Siri-based Blocking: Build your own custom blocking conditions by integrating BB with Siri and the Shortcuts app!
* Multiple Conditions: Configure multiple blocking conditions for a single group of content for maximum control of your habits.
* Multiple Configurations: Want to block a certain group of apps under certain conditions but also another group under other conditions? No problem!
* Strict Mode: Have the bad habit of "cheating" app blockers by snoozing them? Strict Mode bans you from updating/deleting schemas when they're active.
* Starter Schemas: Plug-and-play configurations that cover the most common reasons people use Burnout Buddy for.
* Widgets
• Custom App Icons
* Block Uninstall
* Block Screen Customization
• Push Notifications
• • •
Try Burnout Buddy for free and start taking control of your digital habits today.
Want to know more and see what's coming next? Check out BB at https://burnoutbuddy.io!
Questions or feedback? You can reach out to us on Twitter at @BurnoutBuddy.

Apps like social media use powerful psychological tricks to make you unable to stay away from them for too long. Burnout Buddy blocks these apps when you don't want to use them to help you break free and heal their impact on your mental health.

* Fight social media addiction
* Reduce screen time and improve your focus
* Multiple blocking mechanisms
* Completely free for most use cases
* No account creation or shady VPNs

Burnout Buddy is stronger than your iPhone's native Screen Time controls. Designed specifically with social media addiction and unhealthy work habits in mind, it offers a wider variety of blocking mechanisms and allows you to be extremely specific regarding how access to a specific group of apps and websites should be restricted. If you already use Burnout Buddy, keep an eye out for updates that add even more blocking mechanisms and customization points!

MAIN FEATURES

* Block indefinitely
* Schedule-based blocking
* Usage-based blocking
* Location-based blocking (via Siri)
* Focus Mode-based blocking (via Siri)
* Siri-based Blocking: Build your own custom blocking conditions by integrating BB with Siri and the Shortcuts app!
* Multiple Conditions: Configure multiple blocking conditions for a single group of content for maximum control of your habits.
* Multiple Configurations: Want to block a certain group of apps under certain conditions but also another group under other conditions? No problem!
* Strict Mode: Have the bad habit of "cheating" app blockers by snoozing them? Strict Mode bans you from updating/deleting schemas when they're active.
* Starter Schemas: Plug-and-play configurations that cover the most common reasons people use Burnout Buddy for.
* Widgets
• Custom App Icons
* Block Uninstall
* Block Screen Customization
• Push Notifications

• • •

Try Burnout Buddy for free and start taking control of your digital habits today.

Want to know more and see what's coming next? Check out BB at https://burnoutbuddy.io!
Questions or feedback? You can reach out to us on Twitter at @BurnoutBuddy.

bluejetty:00046387:ios.description:
New phone. New York. Real players.
Diamond District: Trade Tycoon runs inside GemOS - a fully simulated operating system set in New York's diamond district. Launch apps. Check widgets. Customize your homescreen. Every app inside GemOS is its own world, with its own economy and real players behind it.
The market runs 24/7. It doesn't wait for you.
■ MINE THE SOURCE - Own operations across three regions. Hire workers, manage contracts, pull diamonds, emeralds, and sapphires out of the ground.
■ HUNT RARE GEMS - Process raw stones into revealed gems. Color, clarity, cut, origin, treatment, carat weight. The rarest combinations carry odds beyond 1 in a trillion. Most will never surface in the lifetime of the universe.
■ DESIGN LUXURY JEWELRY - Freeform crafting with real synergy scoring. Your best work gets featured in Gloss Magazine.
■ TRADE ON WINSTON RESERVE - Stocks tied to real in-game activity. Short before earnings. Collect dividends funded by actual player fees.
■ TRADE ON DBAY - The player-powered marketplace. Buy and sell gems, jewelry, and papers with real users in real time.
■ CLIMB THE HALL OF TAPE - Every trade is public. The best ones get immortalized. Your name on the board means something.
■ RUN YOUR OWN LENDING OPERATION - Set your own terms through LoanShark.
■ BUILD REPUTATION - Every trade, contract, and article published adds to a score that controls your access.
■ WRITE THE NEWS - Earn a press pass. Publish on DD News. Shareholders vote on what runs.
■ MAKE IT YOURS - Customize your GemOS homescreen with widgets, icon packs, and layouts. Premium themes available via in-app purchase.
■ COMPOUND YOUR EDGE - Mining feeds crafting. Crafting feeds the marketplace. Fees fund dividends. The players who last build loops, not just trades.

bluejetty:00017417:ios.name: Web Video Cast | Browser to TV
bluejetty:00017417:ios.summary:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.
SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES
Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allow
bluejetty:00017417:ios.description:
Web Video Caster® allows you to watch on your TV videos from your favorite websites including movies, TV shows, live streams of news, sports.
SUPPORTED STREAMING DEVICES
Web Video Caster® supports the most popular streaming devices, allowing your TV to stream videos directly from the web.
• Google Cast (Chromecast, Android TV, Chromecast built-in)
• DLNA devices like Xbox, Samsung TVs, LG TVs, etc. 
• Roku, Roku stick and Roku TVs
• Apple TV 4
• Fire TV and Fire TV stick
• PlayStation 4 - by using its web browser
• Most web browsers by visiting http://cast2tv.app (PS4, Smart TVs, other consoles and set top boxes)
*If you experience a compatibility issues, contact us and include the brand and model number.
SUPPORTED MEDIA
• HLS live streams in M3U8 format (Chromecast, most DLNA devices lack support for it)
• Authenticated videos including movies and TV shows
• MP4 videos
• Live news and sports
• Any HTML5 videos*
*Your streaming device must be capable of decoding the video you are playing. Web Video Caster doesn't perform any video/audio decoding or transcoding.
HOW IT WORKS
Web Video Cast™ is a browser, which allows you to stream videos of movies, TV shows, and other media from the internet to a streaming device or smart tv. Web Video Caster grabs the video URL inside the web page, sends it to the streaming device (i.e. Chromecast or DLNA device), and then plays the video directly from the content provider. This ultimately saves your mobile device’s battery. It also detects subtitles on the web page. Web Video Cast™ does not host these videos. This is not a mirroring app.
GET STARTED
Follow these simple step-by-step instructions to start streaming:
1. Find a video online that you want to watch.
2. Make sure this video can play on mobile browsers without Flash.
3. Connect to your streaming device.
4. Play the video as you normally would. Or, click the play button on the toolbar.
PREMIUM FEATURES**
• No in-app advertising
• Most visited sites
• Bookmarks
• Set homepage
**This functionality does not apply universally to all streaming devices. 
LIMITATIONS & DISCLOSURES
As with all apps, there are some limitations we are aware of and want you to know about up front.
• We are in no way associated with any web media providers and we do not have control over the content they provide.
• Web Video Caster does not support nor play Flash or FLV videos.
• The app does not support tab casting, like the Chromecast extension for the PC web browser.
• We cannot do anything to fix issues that arise on the server side (media content provider) such as failure to play or buffering, which is especially common during heavy load times and weekends.
SHARE YOUR FEEDBACK
We are committed to open communication with our users. Please contact us first with any questions or support issues before leaving a review. We will respond and address your concern promptly. Contact us through our website http://www.webvideocaster.com/contactForm

bluejetty:00165722:ios.description:
Saga turns the goal you care about into a plan you can follow. Workouts fit your schedule and equipment, and each session you log makes the plan more yours.
Expert programming, on demand

Own the journey

Train before you pay
• Start your first plan with 3 free workouts
• Upgrade for unlimited access, monthly or annual with a 7-day free trial
• Manage your subscription anytime in the App Store
Your plan is ready today. Every workout makes it better.

bluejetty:00114747:android.description:
Dive into the vibrant world of Pour Color Crew, where art and logic blend into one mesmerizing experience! Your mission is to pour colorful liquids between bottles, sorting each hue with precision while matching little characters to their perfect drink. With every successful pour, you’ll unlock satisfaction through order, color harmony, and strategy. It’s a calming yet challenging game designed to relax your mind and sharpen your observation and reasoning skills. Can you bring perfect color balance to every bottle?
Game Features
1.Tap to pour and sort vibrant liquids between bottles.
2.Match colors to ensure every bottle is perfectly pure.
3.Train your logic and strategy while enjoying stunning color visuals.

bluejetty:00015872:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00015872:ios.description:
One new word every day — with its meaning in your language.
Master vocabulary in Italian, English, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese and Korean, and read every definition in the language you know best — 18 supported. No subscription, no ads, no account, ever.
4.5/5 from 551 reviews on the App Store.
WHAT'S NEW
• Japanese and Korean — over 1,000 words each, with the reading under every word: kana and romanization for Japanese (はなびえ · hanabie), romanization for Korean (kkotsaemchuwi)
• Listen with your device's voice — Japanese is read from the kana, so it doesn't stumble over kanji
• Enrich your own language — already speak one of the eight? Choose it to meet rarer, more refined words, explained in that same language
• Widgets and Apple Watch show the reading too
• Daily streak — open the app every day to keep your streak alive
• Weekly quiz — test yourself on the words you've seen
• Shareable cards — send a beautiful image of any word to friends
• Friendly onboarding — pick your languages in seconds on first launch
A FRESH WORD EVERY DAY
• A new word every morning, with a clear definition and an example you can read in 30 seconds
• A growing collection of 13,000+ words across eight languages, many with synonyms
• Choose exactly which languages you want to focus on — change anytime
• Listen to the pronunciation in any supported language
• Save favorites to build your own custom vocabulary list
UNDERSTAND IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Every single word is explained in 18 languages — pick the one you think in
• English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Turkish, Polish, Dutch, Danish, Finnish, Swedish and Norwegian
• Perfect when you're learning a new language but still reason in your own
• Set your main language to put the words that matter to you first
DESIGNED FOR EFFORTLESS LEARNING
• Swipe through words with simple gestures
• Reset the random order whenever you want a different sequence
• Sort alphabetically, by length, by recency, or shuffled
• Powerful search across the full collection
• Comfortable light and dark modes
ALWAYS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
• Apple Watch app — read the word straight from your wrist
• Home screen widget keeps today's word a glance away
• Lock screen widget shows the word without unlocking the phone
• Quick access from anywhere on your device
SMART REMINDERS
• Gentle daily notifications keep your learning on track
• Choose the time that fits your routine
• Fully functional offline — the dictionary is bundled
• Find your favorites from your device's search screen
PRIVACY BY DEFAULT
• No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no third-party SDKs
• Apple's "App Privacy" label confirms it: no data collected
• Works completely offline — your data never leaves the device
CRAFTED WITH CARE
• Silky-smooth experience with fast loading and fluid transitions
• Gentle on your battery, with a minimal storage footprint
• Beautifully designed for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
Made in Italy by an indie developer.
Questions? hello@marcotini.com — https://word.marcotini.com

bluejetty:00014929:ios.name: iDfish
bluejetty:00014929:ios.summary:
iDfish - AI Fish Identification & Fishing Regulations
Identify your catch instantly using advanced on-device AI. Fish smarter, faster, and legally - even without an internet connection.
AI Photo Identification - Works Offline
iDfish feat
bluejetty:00014929:ios.description:
iDfish - AI Fish Identification & Fishing Regulations
Identify your catch instantly using advanced on-device AI. Fish smarter, faster, and legally - even without an internet connection.
AI Photo Identification - Works Offline
iDfish features advanced AI photo recognition that analyses a photo of your catch to assist with fast and accurate species identification. Trained on thousands of high-quality, real-world images, the AI recognises natural variations in colour, shape, and size as fish and other marine species appear when freshly caught.
This feature runs entirely on your device and does not require an internet connection, making it reliable wherever you fish.
Once identified, instantly access:
 • Legal size limits (where applicable)
 • Protection and release requirements
 • Eating quality information
All in under 60 seconds, helping maximise survival when fish are returned to the water.
Trusted Fishing Data in the Field
iDfish provides reliable and consistent fishing information designed specifically for real-world fishing conditions. Whether you use AI photo recognition or manual browsing, the app helps you quickly confirm:
 • Species identification
 • Size and possession limits
 • Protection status and closures
 • Eating quality and handling advice
The World’s Largest Line-Caught Fish Database with Regulation Information
iDfish contains the largest database of line-caught fish species with regulation information available on any mobile application.
All images are:
 • High-quality and high-resolution
 • Photographed as fish appear freshly caught
 • Free from tank photos, underwater shots, dead fish, or illustrations
Because fish can vary significantly due to stress, environment, or age, iDfish includes multiple colour phases and species comparison tools, making accurate identification fast and practical.
Works Completely Offline
iDfish works offline in the field, including AI photo recognition. Any trip data you record will automatically sync to your account when an internet connection becomes available.
Note: Due to the size of the image database, a Wi-Fi connection is required for the initial download from the App Store. You are also required to create an account and log in before offline use is available.
iDfish Yearly Subscription
A yearly subscription ensures your fishing data stays current and compliant.
Subscription Details
 • $9.99 per year, automatically renewed unless cancelled
 • First month free for new users
 • Payment charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation
Subscription Includes
 • Ongoing updates to fish images and species data
 • Current size limits and regulations
 • Regional closures and protection updates
 • Daily almanac data
Automatic Renewal
 • Subscription renews unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before expiry
 • Renewal charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the period
 • Manage subscriptions in your account settings
 • No cancellation during an active subscription period
Terms and conditions:
http://idfish.com.au/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00095864:ios.name: MyNetDiary PlateAI - AI Coach
bluejetty:00095864:ios.summary:
On a GLP-1? Protect lean muscle and hit your protein goals with accurate nutrition tracking, dose logging, and Meal Scan that logs your plate in seconds.
MyNetDiary PlateAI app is a diet tracker with a built-in AI Coach and GLP-1 Companion
bluejetty:00095864:ios.description:
On a GLP-1? Protect lean muscle and hit your protein goals with accurate nutrition tracking, dose logging, and Meal Scan that logs your plate in seconds.
MyNetDiary PlateAI app is a diet tracker with a built-in AI Coach and GLP-1 Companion. It learns what you eat, gives you daily guidance, and logs meals for you — photograph your plate, scan a barcode, or just say what you had. 
Built by the team behind MyNetDiary - 20 years of nutrition expertise, 31 million users, and a staff-verified database of over 2 million foods. We didn't start from scratch. We took everything that works and rebuilt the experience around AI.
GLP-1 COMPANION
It's a dedicated tracking system built for people on Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, Zepbound, and other semaglutide or tirzepatide medications. 
• Medication tracker with reminders so you never miss a dose.
• Protein-first dashboard that keeps muscle protection front and center.
• Fiber and hydration tracking — GLP-1 side effects hit harder when you skip them.
• Symptom logging to spot patterns and share with your doctor.
• GLP-1 recipes and meal plans built around high protein and easy digestion.
• Trend charts for weight, protein, hydration, and symptoms in one place.
• GLP-1 specific AI coaching that adjusts advice for medication users.
HOW LOGGING WORKS
Take a photo of your plate. Meal Scan identifies what's there and logs the calories, protein, and macros. No searching, no scrolling through results.
Don't want to type at all? Tell PlateAI what you had. "Two eggs, toast with butter, black coffee." Done.
Eating out? Scan the restaurant menu. PlateAI reads it and tells you which dishes fit your targets.
Or just use the barcode scanner - over 2 million verified foods, no guessing.
HOW AI COACH WORKS
AI Coach isn't a chatbot that gives generic advice. It reads your food diary every day and responds to what you actually ate. Skipped protein at lunch? It notices. Went over on calories but hit your fiber goal? It tells you that too.
Other apps bolt AI onto a food diary. PlateAI was built around it - 20 years of nutrition expertise baked into every response. It's the difference between tracking what you ate and actually changing how you eat. And it's the reason most people pick PlateAI over a regular calorie tracker.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Track macros plus 108 nutrients — vitamins, minerals, omegas, amino acids — with daily breakdowns.
• Apple Watch and widgets for quick logging and progress checks on the go.
• Fitness app sync for automatic exercise, steps, and weight.
• Diet Autopilot adjusts your calorie and macro targets automatically as your body changes.
• Autologging: set your regular meals once — pick the foods, amounts, days, and mealtimes — and PlateAI logs them automatically. Zero effort for meals that don't change.
• Intermittent fasting timer with multiple protocols.
• Progress charts, weight trends, customizable dashboard, and reminders.
• Meal planner and grocery lists.
• Inspiring community groups with Registered Dietitian support.
• Recipe import from the web with full nutrient counts.
• 600+ recipes and diet plans by Registered Dietitians: High-Protein, Mediterranean, Low-Carb, Keto, Vegetarian, and more.
WHO IT'S FOR
People who want to lose weight but don't want logging to feel like homework. If you've tried calorie trackers before and stopped because they were too slow or too tedious, this is the one that fixes that.
Website: https://www.plateai.com
Privacy Policy: www.mynetdiary.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: www.mynetdiary.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00140591:ios.name: Apple News
bluejetty:00140591:ios.summary: Apple News brings you the world’s best journalism, all in one place. Top stories curated by editors, personalized for you; local news sources from all 50 US states plus London and the seven largest cities in Canada; in-depth sports analysis
bluejetty:00140591:ios.description:
Apple News brings you the world’s best journalism, all in one place. Top stories curated by editors, personalized for you; local news sources from all 50 US states plus London and the seven largest cities in Canada; in-depth sports analysis with scores and highlights, and more.
CURATED & PERSONALIZED
Apple News delivers Top Stories curated by editors to provide late-breaking headlines and in-depth journalism from the world’s best newspapers, magazines and digital publications. The more you read, the more personalized your news feed gets.
YOUR LOCAL NEWS
Get comprehensive local coverage of current events, sports, real estate, dining, weather, and more from a diverse list of publishers, right in your Today feed. News+ delivers even more local coverage.
IN-DEPTH SPORTS COVERAGE
Follow your favorite teams and leagues to get highlights, live scores, schedules, standings, and stats. Plus, get the latest stories from top sports publishers, including The Athletic with a News+ subscription.
STORIES YOU NEED TO HEAR
Tune in weekdays to Apple News Today, a free podcast hosted by Shumita Basu covering the day's top stories, and on weekends to Apple News In Conversation for stories that impact our lives. News+ subscribers can also listen to narrated versions of some of the week’s most impactful stories.
COMMITTED TO YOUR PRIVACY
Apple News only uses on-device intelligence to recommend stories and doesn’t access your information without your permission. We never share personal data with others or allow advertisers to track you.
An Apple News+ subscription delivers even more, with access to 400+ premium publications, 70,000+ recipes presented in a beautiful easy-to-cook format, exclusive daily puzzles, Offline Mode, and Family Sharing for up to six.
TOP RECIPES AND EXPERT COOKING TIPS
Access 70,000+ recipes, expert tips, and more from trusted culinary titles like Bon Appétit, Food & Wine, and Cook's Illustrated. Enjoy full-screen Cook Mode, save your favorite recipes, and explore curated collections.
PUZZLES
Enjoy a suite of exclusive daily puzzles, including Emoji Game, crossword and crossword mini, Quartiles, and sudoku.
COVER-TO-COVER PREMIUM ACCESS
Enjoy full coverage from 400+ premium magazines and leading newspapers, including People, Vanity Fair, The Atlantic, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and more.
THE BEST STORIES ONLINE, OFFLINE
A News+ subscription enables Offline Mode, which automatically downloads stories, recipes, puzzles, audio, and more so they're available on the train, on the plane and on the go.
The availability of Apple News and News+ features and related content varies depending on the country, region, and device from which you attempt to access them.
If you subscribe to Apple News+, payment will be charged to your Apple Account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. See https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/en-ww for the Privacy Policy. Apple News+ Terms and Conditions can be found at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/us/terms.html.

bluejetty:00071383:ios.description:
Bhagavad Gita is one of the Holy book of Hinduism.
Bhagavath Geetha was originally part of the great Indian Holy book Mahabharata. The Bhagavad Gita, or The Geetha as it is popularly known, is a part of the epic Mahabharatam. The epic describes the war between the Pandavas and the Kauravas on the battlefield of Kuru-kshetra.
Bhagavath gita is the discourse given by Krishna to Arjuna just before the war is about to begin. Krishna is identified as God. His words contain the essence of Vedic wisdom, the keystone of Hinduism.
Bhagavad Gita is knowledge of five basic truths :-
Ishvara – The Supreme Lord
Jiva – The Living Entity
Prakruti – The Material Nature
Kala – Eternal Time
Karma – Activities
Bhagavad-Gita consists of all chapters with slokas. Each Chapter is called a yoga. Yoga is the science of the individual consciousness attaining communion with Ultimate consciousness. So each chapter is a highly specialised yoga revealing path of attaining realisation of the Ultimate Truth.
Eighteen Chapters of Bhagavad Geeta are :- 
ArjunaVishada, Sankhya, Karma, Jnana, Karma Sanyasa, Akshara Bhramaha, Raja Vidhya, Vibhooti, Vishvaroopadarshana, Bhakti, KshetraKshetraVibhagaYoga, 
GunatrayaVibhaga, Purashottama, Divaasura Sampadhvibhaga, ShraddatrayaVibhaga, MokshaSanyasa Yogas
This Bhagavad Gita contains all chapters with slokas and vivarana, Gita saramsam, sri krishnuni jananam, Sri krishna slokas and astotharamulu.
Bhagavad Gita Features:
----------------------------
Share slokas
Track completed slokas
Add slokas to favourites
Share Greeting cards
Generate cards with quotes
Festivals List
English translation with all Bhagvath Geeta SlokasPlay audio.
Bhagavad-gita was injected into the Mahabharata, an action-packed narrative of an important era in ancient Indian politics.Sri Krishna speaks for the benefit of all souls who have forgotten their eternal nature, the ultimate goal of existence, and their eternal relationship with Him.
Jai Shree Krishna !!

bluejetty:00074920:ios.description:
Introduction
Grammar mistakes can compromise the professionalism and clarity of your writing. Even minor errors in punctuation, spelling, or word choice can significantly change the meaning of a sentence. Among many grammar checkers available, our AI Grammar Checker for English stands out as the ultimate tool for precise and reliable grammar correction.
Features
Our free Grammar Checker app is designed to resolve all grammar-related issues in your writing. It goes beyond basic spelling and punctuation corrections, offering advanced features to enhance content quality and readability. Here’s what makes our app unique:
1. Comprehensive Grammar and Tense Checks
Our AI-powered tool identifies and corrects grammar errors, unclear sentences, improper tenses, misplaced punctuation, and incorrect word usage. It ensures your content flows naturally and adheres to proper grammatical standards.
2. Enhances Content Clarity
The app scans your text to provide suggestions for improving clarity, flow, and readability. It suggests alternative words and sentence structures to make your content more polished and engaging.
3. File Upload for Large Documents
Got lengthy content like research papers, theses, or reports? You can directly upload files from your device, and the app will scan them for grammatical corrections quickly and accurately.
4. Unlimited Word Count
There are no restrictions on the number of words you can check. Whether it’s short emails or lengthy documents, our app provides free, unlimited grammar checks for everyone.
5. Track Your Grammar Check History
Revisit your past grammar checks anytime with the app’s history feature. This allows users to keep a record of previously scanned content, making it easier to review and edit documents as needed.
6. Deep Comparison of Errors
Analyze your writing like never before with our detailed comparison tool. It highlights grammatical errors in your original text alongside their corrected versions, offering a clear side-by-side view. This feature helps you better understand your mistakes and improve your writing over time.
How to Use
Improving your grammar is quick and easy. Follow these steps: 
1. Download the app from the App Store. 
2. Paste or upload your content into the app. 
3. Press the "Check Grammar" button to identify errors. 
4. Fix errors based on the app’s suggestions. 
5. Access the history to track past checks or use the comparison tool for in-depth error analysis.
---
Why Choose Our Grammar Checker?
Grammar mistakes can hinder your writing's impact, but they’re easy to overlook. Whether you’re writing professional documents or personal content, our app ensures your grammar is flawless, your sentences are clear, and your text is engaging. 
With features like unlimited checks, history tracking, and error comparison, our app is a comprehensive solution for all your grammar needs—all for free.

bluejetty:00157055:ios.summary:
Whether you’re a resident, staff member, family or prospective resident, Uniguest Community Apps makes it possible for you to connect with information at your senior living community any time, anywhere.
Here are just some of the features a
bluejetty:00157055:ios.description:
Whether you’re a resident, staff member, family or prospective resident, Uniguest Community Apps makes it possible for you to connect with information at your senior living community any time, anywhere.
Here are just some of the features at your command with Community Apps:
• Activities — A complete, searchable community event schedule. Here residents can sign up for events, staff can easily manage registrations and details, prospects are wowed by distinct offerings, and families feel confident in the services provided.
• Dining — Because aren’t we all wired to be curious about what’s for dinner? Take the guesswork out with a mouthwatering display of daily meal offerings. This is the MOST popular Apps module.
• Directories — An engaged community is an interconnected one. Empower community members to learn about each other, from next door neighbors to staff with searchable Resident and Staff Directories. In just a few taps, anyone can get in touch right from the app.
• Messages & Announcements — Everyone knows when yoga is cancelled. Loved ones show up for Family Day. Motivational messages are swiftly delivered to employees through push notifications. Prospects know when new apartments become available.
• Forms — Residents can easily submit requests, feedback and comments to staff. Staff can easily solicit, gather and review that input in a simple, streamlined manner. Maintenance requests, surveys, feedback and more — do it easily with Forms.
• Employee Handbook — Four words: no more outdated version. With a digital employee handbook, staff always has the most up-to-date handbook at their fingertips.
• Floor Plans & Virtual Tours — Inspire guests and potential residents to visualize life in your community and accommodate far away family members involved in the process just by giving them access to the App.
• Photo Gallery — See the community’s warm environment, unique programs, and amenities for yourself with a photo gallery that captures all they have to offer.
• Our Channel — A simple slideshow of all community events, announcements and dining options, in one place.
• Accessibility Settings — Each user can set their preferences for text size, layout, and more.
• Alexa Integration — Community Apps easily integrates with Alexa so events, announcements and dining are accessible with a simple voice command.
Contact us: team@touchtown.com

bluejetty:00090282:ios.description:
اغاتي: هو تطبيق لحجز سيارات الأجرة في صلاح الدين - العراق
اكتشف تجربة تنقل مريحة وآمنة مع "اغاتي"، التطبيق الذي يتيح لك حجز سيارة أجرة على الفور أو مسبقًا في جميع مدن محافظة صلاح الدين. نقدم خدماتنا في مركز المدينة والأقضية، ونعمل على توسيع نطاق خدماتنا قريبًا لتشمل جميع محافظات العراق.
لماذا تختار "اغاتي"؟
- موثوقية عالية: تطبيق مسجل رسميًا لدى الدوائر الحكومية، مما يضمن خدمة آمنة وموثوقة.
- سائقون محترفون: جميع السائقين مدربون ومسجلون لضمان تجربة توصيل مميزة.
- واجهة سهلة الاستخدام: تصميم بسيط يسهل عليك حجز مشوارك أو توصيل طلباتك بسهولة تامة.
- أسعار تنافسية: خيارات متنوعة تناسب ميزانيتك، مع خدمات تلبي احتياجات التنقل المريح.
- تتبع الرحلة: تابع وصول السائق إلى موقعك واطلع على تفاصيل الرحلة بكل سهولة.
- خيارات دفع مرنة: اختر بين الدفع نقدًا أو عبر المحفظة الإلكترونية، مع استلام ملخص الرحلة عبر البريد الإلكتروني.
كيفية استخدام "اغاتي"؟
- قم بتحميل تطبيق "اغاتي" وسجل الدخول باستخدام اسمك ورقم هاتفك.
- انقر على "طلب" وحدد موقع الانطلاق.
- اختر الخدمة التي تناسب احتياجاتك.
- حدد وجهتك أو حرك الدبوس إلى الموقع المطلوب.
- اضغط لتأكيد الطلب وتابع وصول السائق.

bluejetty:00142046:ios.name: Detective Max: Murder Mystery
bluejetty:00142046:ios.summary:
Can you become a true detective? Can you discover the mystery of the murder in the art studio of Conor High School?
Max Mystery was a regular teenager, except for his love of puzzles, mystery and adventures. His senior year at Conor High S
bluejetty:00142046:ios.description:
Can you become a true detective? Can you discover the mystery of the murder in the art studio of Conor High School?
Max Mystery was a regular teenager, except for his love of puzzles, mystery and adventures. His senior year at Conor High School was coming to an end, and Max was looking forward to the prom, when... His friend, Alex, was found murdered in the school's art studio. Play the adventure game to catch the murderer of a good friend!
- Play new puzzle game offline for free, with no subscription, no energy boots, no registration, no ads.
- Start by examining the crime scene and collecting the first clues. 
- Take a closer look at the suspects. It's worth checking their motive and alibi.
- Open new rooms full of secrets, puzzles and riddles.
- Seek for the clues and hidden objects.
- Find out all the secrets of this adventure and discover the mystery.
- Free the soul of the victim, reveal his story!
- Finally detect the murderer!
Reveal the murder mystery and catch the killer!
What is it
This is a new murder mystery game with a unique storytelling, lots of puzzles and nice art. This is the adventure escape room genre. It is absolutely free with no disturbing ads.
Why would you like it
Millions of fans enjoy playing detective games every day. But it's so hard to find really good ones with lots of tricky interesting puzzles, a deep mystery storytelling, with no ads and for free!
You will definitely enjoy Detective Max Mystery game if you are a fan of escape room games, hidden object games and mystery adventure games. 
What is it about
Detective Max Mystery: High School Murder is the game about a crime happened in Conor High School shortly before the prom. Though Max is just a student, he wishes to reveal the secrets of the murder of his friend, Alex. Max is going to investigate the case, inspecting rooms full of objects, meeting suspects, seeking for clues and solving riddles. What is the motive for the crime? Rivalry, money, revenge or love? The detective will do everything possible to find the murderer and bring justice.
What is the aim of the game
Help Max to find all the clues to detect the murderer! Get prepared to solve multiple riddles, open new rooms, interrogate suspects and look for the clues, while the murderer is trying to puzzle you!
About the developers
We are a company of only 2 enthusiasts with a strong wish to create good interesting games. Jam Games.

bluejetty:00062164:ios.description:
Turn your iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch into your FAVORITE teacher of Dutch.
◆ The most essential words and phrases of the language, each with native speaker audio. 
◆ Master your accent with the Speech Studio. Simply record yourself saying a phrase and then hear your voice next to the teacher’s. You’ll be AMAZED how quickly your foreign accent melts away.
◆ All audio is downloaded to the device and accessible even in airplane mode or without expensive international roaming fees.
◆ Nemo is NOT BUILT AROUND LESSONS at all. It is meant to be picked up and put down throughout the day, whenever you have a few minutes to spare.
◆ Builds a foundation of Dutch empowering you to speak CONFIDENTLY in EVERYDAY CONVERSATIONS. 
◆ NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE of Dutch required.
Nemo® is specially DESIGNED to tap the remarkable power of your mobile device, and your brain, to their fullest. 
PERSONALIZED FOR YOU
Nemo is your personal trainer, tracking your PROGRESS across every single word and phrase.
◆ Practice Dutch the way you'll use it. Nemo is fully customizable.
◆ Nemo immerses you in the sounds of Dutch so you naturally speak with ease.
◆ Dive into WHAT YOU WANT to learn at any time.
◆ You control which words to practice – skip words you don’t want to learn or already know.
◆ Turn on Review Mode to study what you practiced earlier in the day to BOOST your memory retention.
◆ Hear English descriptions of all words, in a flashcard format.
◆ Quiz your mastery of the vocabulary.
◆ Nemo introduces words to you progressively to develop familiarity and reviews them at the right moment so they enter your LONG TERM MEMORY.
TARGET THE MOST COMMON WORDS
Maximize your time investment by targeting the most basic and high frequency words of the language.
Upgrade to the complete version to:
◆ Get off the beaten path or find comfort with DIRECTIONS, TRAVEL and HOTEL phrases.
◆ Decode menus with the most common FOOD words.
◆ Shop and find bargains like an insider with must-know SHOPPING phrases.
◆ Learn words useful for your time in netherlands.
◆ Build your proficiency with the most important verbs and SENTENCE BUILDING BLOCKS in Dutch.
◆ Spark new friendships with COMPLIMENTS and CONVERSATION STARTERS.

bluejetty:00154904:android.name: Otrading:PineScript Crypto Bot
bluejetty:00154904:android.summary:
💜 Otrading — LLM-driven crypto trading bot with native Pine Script live execution
First mobile app that runs Pine Script and executes as live trades. Import TradingView strategies without rewriting—backtest in-app, then connect to exchange
bluejetty:00154904:android.description:
💜 Otrading — LLM-driven crypto trading bot with native Pine Script live execution
First mobile app that runs Pine Script and executes as live trades. Import TradingView strategies without rewriting—backtest in-app, then connect to exchanges for automated execution. Chart to live in one app.
Otrading offers: automated and algo trading, native Pine Script execution, LLM decision support, real-time signals, backtesting, risk management, multi-exchange API. New to crypto, day or swing trader, or using AI to cut emotional bias—backtest-to-live, signal-to-execution in one place.
📌 World’s first: Pine Script direct run and live trading
• Run Pine Script on your phone: Import TradingView code, no migration. Backtest first, then auto trade.
• Chart to exchange: Validate in-app, connect to Binance, Bybit, OKX, HTX, KuCoin, Bitget, Kraken, Gate.io. One app, multiple exchanges—TradingView to Binance/Bybit/OKX, automated.
• For: Pine Script or TradingView; 24/7 automated execution; hands-off operation.
🧠 Core: LLM-aided decisions + systematic execution + risk control
LLM combines price action, technical indicators, and market context for clearer entry, exit, and risk rules—consistent across strategies, less emotional trading. With automation and risk tools: executable algo trading and CTA trend following.
🔒 Security & privacy: Non-custodial, you control access
Funds stay in your exchange accounts. Otrading cannot transfer or withdraw. You create, manage, revoke API keys. Enable exchange 2FA recommended.
📊 Pro-grade markets and charts (spot & futures)
Timeframes 1m to daily, candlestick/line charts, 800+ spot and USDT-margined perpetuals. 100+ indicators: MACD, RSI, Bollinger Bands, ATR, Parabolic SAR, stop loss, take profit, trailing stop—build your analysis and signal logic.
🌍 Market sentiment and macro data
Fear & Greed Index, BTC sentiment, volume, activity, heatmaps, up/down distribution—spot extremes, decide with clarity.
🧪 Strategy backtesting
Backtest on historical candles (incl. Pine Script). Win rate, drawdown, stability. “Backtest then one-tap live”—ideal when moving from TradingView.
🧠 AI token selection
Match strategies to tokens by volatility, liquidity, trend stability. Dynamic pool; less slippage.
⚡ Real-time trading signals
Custom signals (trend breakout, candlestick, CTA pullback). Timeframes, entry/exit, trailing stops. Works with Pine Script and LLM.
🤖 Multi-strategy automated trading (API) — Grid, DCA, futures, multi-exchange
• Types: Pine Script live (world’s first), grid, DCA/scale-in/scale-out, martingale, CTA trend following, LLM bots. One-tap deploy, 24/7.
• Exchanges: Binance, Bybit, OKX, HTX, KuCoin, Bitget, Kraken, Gate.io. 400+ coins (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, SUI, ADA, OP, AVAX). Spot and futures.
• Multiple bots: Run several at once; no cap. Different strategies per pair/timeframe. For multi-exchange, multi-strategy quant/algo traders.
🛡️ Risk management and execution control
Take-profit, stop-loss, trailing stop; diversify across strategies; control API permissions. Manage exposure and drawdown.
👥 Copy trading and community
Follow strategies or signals, sync community setups (copy-trading style), keep full control over account and execution.
👩💼 24/7 support: Telegram and WhatsApp for setup and connectivity.
🚀 Who it’s for
• Pine Script live, TradingView live, run Pine Script on mobile (world’s first).
• Automated crypto, algo app, AI-assisted crypto, futures/spot tools.
• Grid/DCA bots, CTA automation, risk controls—swing and quant.
• Multi-exchange, multi-strategy, multi-bot; backtest and risk control—pros.
Download—backtest to live. Supports backtesting, automated execution, multi-exchange.
⚠️ Risk notice: Digital asset prices are highly volatile. Understand risks before use.
Website https://www.otrading.io | Docs https://otrading.gitbook.io/en | YouTube @otradingio | X @otradingio | Telegram @otrading_support | WhatsApp see website | business@otrading.io

bluejetty:00015765:ios.description:
Holiday season is here and it's time to get ready for Christmas! Have tons of fun in Santa's village. Decorate fireplace, draw Christmas cards, bake ginger cookies, dress up, make frozen ice sculptures, rescue Rudolph the reindeer and more!
Santa Claus Care
Santa just woke up from his long sleep. Help him prepare for Christmas and holiday season! Wash and brush his teeth, cut hair and nails, and clean up his ears and nose. You will get a gift from Santa for this good job!
Santa Dress Up
Dress Santa Claus his Christmas Eve journey around the world! Mix and match different Santa’s wardrobe items: shoes, trousers, jackets, hats, glasses and, most importantly, Santa’s beard!
Rudolph Rescue
Oh no, Santa’s favorite reindeer Rudolph is frozen in ice! Rescue Rudolph before it has to travel around the world on Christmas Eve and deliver Christmas presents on time! Melt the frozen ice, clean up and take care of Rudolph, and treat this lovely reindeer with hot tea and honey!
Christmas Cards
It's Christmas craft time! Learn how to draw four gorgeous Christmas greeting cards with Rudolph, Christmas tree, snowman and Santa Claus on it. Test your memory and find two Christmas cards that are the same!
Ice Sculpture
Make the most beautiful sculptures of ice! Grab your ice tools and turn giant ice cubes into stunning ice sculptures: frozen deer and romantic swan.
Fireplace Decoration
Free your imagination and create the most beautiful Christmas fireplace! Add your favorite decorations: funny stockings, candles, candy canes, glass ornaments, garlands, cute paintings and more!
Dress Up
Dress up in fashionable and cute festive clothing: adorable winter dress, colorful leggings, soft sweater and warm jacket. Choose from cute bunny eye masks, hair accessories, earmuffs, hats, gloves and winter boots. Dress up for Holidays and celebrate Christmas in style!
Gingerbread Cookies
Ginger cookies have the sweetest smell of Christmas! Bake delicious shaped gingerbread cookies and decorate them with your favorite icing and toppings!
Christmas Tree Decoration
Create your own perfect Christmas tree! Add snowflakes, angels, candies, gingerbread cookies, garlands, lights and other Christmas decorations!
Snowman Builder
What can be more fun in winter than playing with snow! Choose from different size snowballs to build your own snowman. Dress up you snowman with rocks, coal, carrot, sticks, hats, clothes and shoes!
Santa’s Sleigh
Join Santa in his magical sleigh with reindeer and fly around the world! Tap the screen and hold to go up. Collect letters to Santa, candy canes, stars and sweets as you go!

The highest rated weather app that shows Celsius and Fahrenheit at the same time. No tapping, no toggling, no mental math — both scales, one glance.

ACCURATE DATA

MADE FOR

• Travelers moving between Celsius and Fahrenheit countries
• International workers and remote teams coordinating across regions
• Anyone curious about weather in both scales

bluejetty:00060990:ios.description:
With Center, managing expenses is simple. The CenterCard app, along with CenterCard® Mastercard®, is part of an connected corporate card, business travel, and expense solution that captures spend as it happens and automates the expense process from start to finish. Accelerate month-end close, eliminate manual reconciliation, and stop chasing down receipts. 
A connected corporate card, expense management, and integrated travel solution. Get real-time visibility into all employee spending, automate the traditional expensing experience, and give finance teams the controls and insights needed for optimal decision making. 
Manage corporate cards, corporate travel, and all employee expenses in one place. 
CENTER POWERS SMART BUSINESSES 
Center is designed to simplify the expense process for spenders and give approvers and finance teams real-time visibility into spend. Easily activate your CenterCard, submit and approve expenses, and quickly resolve any disputes or fraud incidents—all within the app.
SWIPE, SNAP, SUBMIT
Swipe CenterCard and use the mobile app to snap photos of receipts and capture details on the go. View, track, and submit your expenses with ease with auto-populated details like vendor, amount, and expense type. Get reimbursed for out-of-pocket expenses quickly and easily.
MANAGE YOUR BUDGET 
See spend limits, reimbursement status, outstanding purchase submissions, and more. Review and approve your team’s expenses with a click. Lock, unlock, and close physical and virtual cards, as well as easily report fraud, adjust limits, and order replacements within the app. 
BOOK CORPORATE TRAVEL 
Need to book a trip? Use the CenterCard app to book flights, hotels and rental cars, all within policy. Select from comprehensive inventory and get self-service itinerary changes and 24/7 omnichannel support. 
Create a personalized travel profile to make booking easier. Include the things that matter like airline or hotel loyalty programs or flight preferences (e.g., nonstop flights or aisle seats). Enable push notifications for flight updates. Center automatically populates the expense form with the travel booking details, including the receipt, so you can simply review and submit.

The legendary game Revenge of Sultans, downloaded more than 20 million times in the Middle East, is back with a brand new version!
Deeply rooted in Arabic culture and history, Revenge of Sultans is a war strategy game that offers players a familiar gaming experience combined with thrilling military conflict.

bluejetty:00023171:ios.name: Google Family Link
bluejetty:00023171:ios.summary: Google Family Link is a parental controls app that helps you keep your family safer online. Every family’s relationship with technology is unique, so we built tools for you to choose the right balance for your family, and help them create h
bluejetty:00023171:ios.description:
Google Family Link is a parental controls app that helps you keep your family safer online. Every family’s relationship with technology is unique, so we built tools for you to choose the right balance for your family, and help them create healthy digital habits. You can use the app to see how your child is spending time on their device, see their device location, manage privacy settings, and more.
With Family Link, you can:
Establish digital ground rules
• Set screen time limits — Find the screen time that works best for your child. Family Link lets you set daily time limits, with school time and downtime schedules for their devices, so you can help your child find a healthy balance.
• Manage your child’s apps — Give your child the flexibility they need when it comes to app usage. Set individual app time limits, and unlimited time for educational or regularly used apps. You can block apps, too.
Manage content filters and security & privacy
• Manage what they see online — Set up parental controls on Google services like Chrome, Play, YouTube, and Search. Family Link allows you to block inappropriate sites, require approval for new apps, manage permissions for apps and websites, and more.
• Secure their account — Family Link gives you access to manage your child’s account and data settings. As a parent, you can help change or reset your child’s password if they forget it, edit their personal information or even delete their account if you feel necessary.*
*Children over the applicable age can manage their own account.
Stay connected on the go
• See where they are — It’s helpful to be able to find your family when they’re on the go. With Family Link, you can locate your children on one map, as long as they’re carrying their device.
• Get notifications and alerts — Family Link delivers critical notifications including when your child arrives or leaves a certain location. You can also ring devices and view the device’s remaining battery life.
Important Information
• Family Link’s tools vary depending on your child’s device. See a list of compatible devices at https://families.google/familylink/device-compatibility/
• While Family Link helps you manage your child’s purchases and downloads from Google Play, they will not need approval to install app updates (including updates that expand permissions), apps you have previously approved, or apps that have been shared in Family Library. In addition, purchase approvals will apply only when your child makes a purchase through Google Play’s billing system and will not apply to purchases made through alternate billing systems. Parents should regularly review their child’s installed apps and app permissions in Family Link.
• You should carefully review the apps on your child’s supervised device and disable those you don’t want them to use. Note that you may not be able to disable some pre-installed apps such as Play, Google, etc.
• To see the location of your child or teen’s device, the device must be powered on, recently active, and connected to the internet through data or wifi.
• Family Link parental controls are only available for supervised Google accounts. With supervised Google Accounts, children get access to Google products like Search, Chrome, and Gmail, and parents can set up basic digital ground rules to supervise them.
• While Family Link provides tools to manage your child’s online experience and keep them safer online, it does not make the internet safe. Family Link can not determine the content on the internet, but it can give parents the opportunity to make decisions about how their child spends time on their device, and determine what path to online safety looks best for your family.

- Swipe across adjacent letters to form a word
- Find all hidden words in the grid
- Complete the full board to finish the level
- Use hints when you get stuck
If you love word search puzzles, hidden words, and relaxing letter games, Fillwords is a fun daily way to challenge your brain.

bluejetty:00100406:ios.description:
A Cozy Haven, Just for You
Welcome to a place where life slows down, colors feel gentle, and every room tells a comforting story.
This is more than a coloring app — it’s your personal retreat, a quiet harbor where warmth, calm, and hope gently return.
Our interior-themed coloring experience is designed especially for those moments when you want to breathe, relax, and feel at home again. From cozy kitchens filled with sunlight, to peaceful bedrooms, charming living rooms, and thoughtfully styled spaces, each illustration invites you into a world of comfort and familiarity.
Here, there is no rush.
No pressure to be perfect.
Just the simple joy of choosing colors and watching a space come alive under your touch.
Find the Room That Feels Like Home
We offer a wide variety of room styles and interior designs — classic, cozy, rustic, elegant, and warm. Whether you love a welcoming fireplace, a bright kitchen, a peaceful reading corner, or a beautifully decorated bedroom, there’s always a space waiting to feel just right for you.
As you color, you may find yourself imagining peaceful mornings, quiet afternoons, and evenings filled with gentle light. These images are meant to comfort, uplift, and remind you of the beauty in everyday life.
Color, Relax, and Feel Warmed From Within
Coloring is more than a pastime — it’s a moment of care you give yourself. Many of our users tell us they feel calmer, lighter, and more positive after finishing a piece. We hope that each completed image leaves you feeling:
- a little more relaxed
- a little more hopeful
- a little more inspired to enjoy life
This is your safe space.
A place to rest your heart.
A gentle reminder that warmth, beauty, and joy are always within reach.
Take your time.
Choose your colors.
And let every finished room wrap you in comfort. 
You deserve a place that feels like home.
Contact us at support@joyfulark.com

Hey there, meet Rephraser – your writing buddy on a whole new level!
Ever wished your words could just flow effortlessly? Well, Rephraser's got your back! It's like having a super smart friend who totally gets what you're trying to say. Whether you're whipping up emails, chatting with friends, or working on important docs, Rephraser is here to make your words pop!
Why Rephraser Rocks:
1. Mix It Up: Stuck on finding the right words? Rephraser suggests cool alternatives, whether it's a full sentence, a phrase, or just a single word. So, your writing sounds fresh and catchy every time!
2. Easy-Peasy AI Text: Allow Paraphrase's AI to work its enchantment, offering you captivating alternatives that ensure your content stands out from the crowd.
3. Your Style, Your Way: Rephraser gets you. Want your message to be chill, formal, or straight to the point? Customize your tone and length, and let Rephraser do its thing. Your words, your style!
4. No Language Barriers: Writing in another language? No worries! Pen down your thoughts in your language, hit Rewrite, and Rephraser will give you polished suggestions in any language. Perfect for all you global communicators out there!
5. Everywhere You Go: Rephraser is like your favorite song – it goes wherever you do! It plays nice with all platforms, making your writing space a creative playground.
So, say hello to Rephraser, where your words find their groove and your ideas shine. 
We're always cooking up updates to make Rephraser even better. Have questions or feedback? We're all ears! Your Wordtune journey is about to get even more fantastic. 
Happy writing!

bluejetty:00099248:ios.description:
Screw Out 3D – Relax, Twist, Solve! 
Looking for a satisfying, smart, and beautifully designed 3D puzzle game — and one you can enjoy offline?
Welcome to Screw Out 3D — the ultimate combination of calming visuals, logical thinking, and screw-turning satisfaction! One of the top no wifi games that helps you unwind anywhere.
What is Screw Out 3D?
Screw Sort is a tactile, relaxing puzzle game where you twist and turn screws, dismantle parts, and sort them into their correct trays. It’s simple to start but surprisingly deep as levels evolve. Each puzzle is a miniature 3D structure filled with bolts, bars, plates, and surprises. Your job? Take it apart with precision — and pleasure.
Whether you're out of signal or just love no internet games, this one delivers.
Key Features
Satisfying screw-unscrewing mechanics – twist, turn, and click with precision
Hundreds of levels – from beginner-friendly to mind-bending
Color and shape sorting challenges – not just screws!
Smooth 3D visuals and calming ASMR sound effects
Easy to play, hard to master – great for all skill levels
Daily challenges and level packs
No timers – play at your own pace
Great for fun games with no wifi and no pressure
A Puzzle Game That Feels Like Fidgeting for Your Brain
Screw Sort isn’t about speed. It’s about flow. Each turn, match, and click is a micro-reward for your senses. Whether on a short break or winding down, this games without wifi experience offers focus and calm.
The gameplay feels like a tactile toy. It improves mindfulness and gently challenges the brain. Just a few levels can help you reset mentally.
Visual Puzzles That Come to Life
Every puzzle is a piece of art. Dismantle objects layer by layer, sort parts by shape or color, and restore order.
Smooth animations and clean interactions make each moment feel satisfying.
Customize trays, unlock screw styles, and face growing challenges as you progress.
Who Is This Game For?
Whether you’re a puzzle lover or someone who enjoys relaxing games — Screw Out 3D is for you. Ideal for:
Fans of 3D puzzles and satisfying visuals
ASMR-style gameplay and sensory fun
Players who enjoy color-matching and tinkering
Those wanting calm, pressure-free brain teasers
People looking for enjoyable games for free
Why You’ll Love It
We designed Screw Out 3D to be both relaxing and rewarding. The levels increase in depth, but the core stays the same: a soothing, tactile loop that makes your brain feel good.
No annoying ads after every level. No pressure. Just clean, focused gameplay. And yes — it’s one of those great games free to play and love.
Start Twisting Today!
Join players around the world discovering the pleasure of screw sorting. Whether you’re home, commuting, or want no wifi options, this is one of the best puzzle games for free.
Download now and enjoy smart, calm gameplay — wherever you are!
