bluejetty:00143541:ios.summary: Bestcycling es una app para entrenar con clases virtuales de ciclismo indoor desde casa o en el gimnasio. Si entrenas con bicicleta estática, haces spinning o quieres mejorar tu rendimiento en ciclismo, encontrarás sesiones guiadas para tod
bluejetty:00143541:ios.description:
Bestcycling es una app para entrenar con clases virtuales de ciclismo indoor desde casa o en el gimnasio. Si entrenas con bicicleta estática, haces spinning o quieres mejorar tu rendimiento en ciclismo, encontrarás sesiones guiadas para todos los niveles, además de fuerza, running, elíptica, yoga, pilates, movilidad, mindfulness y nutrición.
Con Bestcycling puedes entrenar, organizar tu semana, cuidar tu alimentación y seguir tu progreso desde una sola app.
MI PLAN: TU ENTRENAMIENTO ORGANIZADO
Sigue programas guiados paso a paso o crea tu propio programa eligiendo actividades y días. Tu calendario te muestra qué te toca cada día y te permite continuar donde lo dejaste.
NUTRICIÓN
Accede a un plan de nutrición con miles de recetas, registra tus comidas, escanea códigos de barras, crea tus propios alimentos y controla calorías, macronutrientes, ingesta y balance semanal.
SIGUE TU PROGRESO
Consulta clases realizadas, minutos, calorías, racha actual y mejor racha. Descubre cómo repartes tu actividad entre cardio, fuerza y movilidad y sigue datos como FTP, VO2 máx., zonas de pulsaciones, evolución del peso y comparativa de fotos.
CONECTA TUS ENTRENAMIENTOS
Conecta pulsómetros y bicicletas FTMS mediante Bluetooth para utilizar tus datos durante las clases de ciclo indoor. También puedes entrenar con Apple Watch, sincronizar actividad con Apple Salud y Health Connect y enviar tus entrenamientos a Strava.
ENTRENA SIN CONEXIÓN
Descarga tus clases y entrena con tu bicicleta estática, haz fuerza, movilidad o cualquier otra actividad aunque no tengas internet.
COMUNIDAD Y BUSCADOR
Participa en grupos, vídeos y comentarios, recibe menciones y notificaciones y comparte la experiencia con otros usuarios. Encuentra clases, programas y recetas con el nuevo buscador.
ACTIVIDADES EN BESTCYCLING
Bestcycling: clases de ciclismo indoor y spinning para entrenar con bicicleta estática. Sigue tus sesiones por frecuencia cardíaca o potencia y conecta bicicletas FTMS para sacar más partido a cada entrenamiento.
Bestrunning: sesiones guiadas para correr de una forma más entretenida y motivadora, en cinta o al aire libre.
Bestwalking: entrenamiento en elíptica de bajo impacto, accesible y fácil de seguir, acompañado de música e instructores.
Besttraining: fuerza, HIIT, entrenamiento funcional y tonificación, con o sin material, para casa o gimnasio.
Bestbalance: yoga, pilates y movilidad para mejorar flexibilidad, musculatura abdominal, postura y bienestar físico.
Bestmind: sesiones de meditación y mindfulness de 10 a 20 minutos para trabajar el estrés, la atención y el bienestar.
Nutrición: recetas y herramientas para organizar tu alimentación según tus objetivos y preferencias.
CÓMO FUNCIONA
Plan gratuito:
5 clases diferentes cada semana.
Programa de nutrición personalizado con miles de recetas.
Bestmind para entrenar la mente.
Plan Premium:
Acceso a miles de clases de todas las actividades.
Programas de entrenamiento y Mi Plan.
Conectividad Bluetooth con pulsómetros y bicicletas compatibles.
Descarga de clases para entrenar sin conexión.
Gestión de clases y recetas favoritas.
APPLE WATCH
Controla tus entrenamientos desde el Apple Watch, envía el pulso al móvil y añade tus sesiones a Apple Salud.
PRUEBA BESTCYCLING
Cada semana encontrarás clases gratuitas que van cambiando. El programa de nutrición y Bestmind son gratuitos. Para acceder al catálogo Premium, programas, descargas offline y conectividad, puedes suscribirte al Plan Premium. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente al final de cada periodo y puedes desactivar la renovación automática en cualquier momento.
Atención al cliente: info@bestcycling.es
Política de privacidad: http://www.bestcycling.com/pages/politica-de-privacidad
Condiciones de uso: https://www.bestcycling.com/pages/condiciones-de-uso

bluejetty:00128327:ios.description:
Watch Tracker is a revolutionary app for tracking the accuracy of a wristwatch. It's dramatically easier and more accurate than any previous method.
Just tap a button when the time on your watch matches the time displayed by the app, and Watch Tracker does the rest. It synchronizes with an atomic clock, measures and records the difference, and displays graphs of all the data points you've recorded.
- Uses best-fit analysis to accurately calculate how many seconds your watch gains or loses per day
- Displays graphs of rates and variance
- Can track multiple watches simultaneously
- Saves data in CSV files that can be opened with any spreadsheet software
Watch Tracker is made by the developer of tChess (the chess app that was featured in Apple's "Learn" commercial for the iPad) and Learn Chess (the Apple Staff Favorite e-book).

bluejetty:00162036:ios.description:
Make the switch and drive intelligently – with Mobility car sharing. Being mobile has to make sense and be fuss-free. Digital, spontaneous and always close at hand. With a Mobility car subscription, you only “own” your car when you really need it.
Enjoy mobile freedom with Switzerland’s leading vehicle-sharing scheme, which has vehicles for every occasion and subscriptions to suit every requirement. No maintenance. No stress. That’s car sharing. In other words: travel from A to B throughout Switzerland – sustainably, easily and flexibly.
# Our subscriptions in comparison
▶ mobilityEASY – for freedom-lovers
Is freedom more important to you than best-value rates? With mobilityEASY, you only pay when you drive.
▶ mobilityPLUS – for active users
Just 3 day trips a year make mobilityPLUS a better-value option then mobilityEASY.
▶ mobilityMEMBER – for loyal users
With this subscription, you not only gain a share in Mobility with 75’000 other like-minded people, you also benefit from our best terms.
Download the app and find out about our subscriptions.
# Get going in four steps
▶ Step 1: BECOME A CUSTOMER
• Choose the subscription that’s right for you 
• Become a Mobility customer in just a few steps 
• Download the Mobility app 
▶ Step 2: MAKE A RESERVATION
Open the app or the customer portal and proceed as follows: 
• Enter the Mobility station
• Enter the desired duration
• Select the vehicle category, reserve
▶ Step 3: DRIVE OFF
• Go to your reserved vehicle.
• Inspect the vehicle for damage. Report any damage to the vehicle via the Mobility app before you start your journey.
• Unlock the vehicle using the app (via Bluetooth), the Mobility Card or your SwissPass card.
• Off you go!
▶ Step 4: DROP OFF 
• Return the vehicle to the original Mobility station on time. If the fuel level is under 1/3, refuel the vehicle before returning it.
• Lock the vehicle using the app (via Bluetooth), the Mobility Card or your SwissPass card.
• Please observe our fair-play rules.
And? Ready to help shape the mobility of the future? Then download the app, choose a subscription and start driving!

bluejetty:00169322:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00169322:ios.description:
If you have a liking for pixel games and look for a hardcore, old-school fantasy MMORPG experience without auto-battles and auto-navigation, look no further!
Step into the world of Warspear Online, a classic 2D MMORPG with a nostalgic retro charm. Embark on a journey into a vast fantasy world with a story spanning over 15 years, loved by players around the world, playable on any device and available in many languages. Whether you prefer to play solo or team up with friends, this fantasy realm has plenty of fun activities for everyone!
Named Best MMO RPG Game of 2015 by BEST APP EVER AWARDS, Warspear Online is free to download with all updates!
In the land of Arinar, a never-ending War of the Spear rages on. Join one of two powerful Alliances — the Sentinels or the Legion — to explore the vast world, battle dangerous bosses, and band together with your friends! Choose your side and venture forth to fight your enemies head-on with a blend of skill, steel, and sorcery to shift the balance of power and write a new chapter in the Chronicle of Arinar!
Become a new legend of Warspear Online!
- Create a Unique Hero
Choose from 4 factions and 20 classes, customize your character, acquire decorative skins and costumes.
- Level Up in a True RPG
Master over 200 skills – including 5 core and 9 expert – and shape your character through 8 unique talent trees focusing on underwater adventures, NPC guilds, events, and class-specific paths. Discover over 100 relics to modify your core skills and experiment with countless builds tailored to your playstyle.
- Sharpen Your Skills in PvE
Crush strong monsters and bosses in dungeons and in the open world to earn valuable rewards, weapons, and gear.
- Fight in PvP
Defeat other players in Arena PvP fights with 2x2, 3x3, 5x5 modes alongside Temple of Seals, and take part in massive alliance battles.
- Play with Your Friends
Join with fellow adventurers in guilds and parties, guild raids and catacombs await, take part in guild battles for castles, and compete in weekly guild tournaments.
- Master Crafting
Try your hand at 9 crafting professions to create valuable items for yourself or for sale.
- Trade and Communicate
Sell and buy items on the free market, trade and chat with other players.
- Become the Best Player
Earn 200+ personal achievements with unique rewards and rank up in the Top-1000.
- Explore a Vast Open World
Explore 11 islands and an underwater realm, take part in holiday events, and enjoy regular updates with fresh content and features every 2 months.
- Become Part of a Great Story
Complete 1500+ storyline and daily quests to unlock a new chapter in the epic saga of Arinar!
____________
FACE YOUR NIGHTMARES IN UPDATE 13.6!
The Horror Circus is back, ready to welcome lovers of all things spooky! This time, its tents have sprung up in a most unexpected place: the heart of dark and mysterious Grimhollow. A strange incident has cast a shadow over the celebrations in Grimhollow! To get to the bottom of it, you'll need to explore the island, piece together scattered clues from some rather questionable sources, and follow a ghostly trail... Looks like it's time to put your neck on the line again!
____________
Website: http://warspear-online.com
Forum: http://forum.warspear-online.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/warspear
Facebook: https://facebook.com/warspear

Do you really want to pass the G1 Test on your first attempt?
The simplest approach to pass your driving theory exam and obtain your driver's licence in 2026. Ontario G1 Test.

bluejetty:00200067:ios.summary:
FDNY Retirement Planner is a retirement planning and pension estimation tool designed to help FDNY members better understand and plan for retirement.
Enter your member information and explore your estimated pension using tools built around
bluejetty:00200067:ios.description:
FDNY Retirement Planner is a retirement planning and pension estimation tool designed to help FDNY members better understand and plan for retirement.
Enter your member information and explore your estimated pension using tools built around FDNY retirement calculations.
Features include:
• Tier 2 pension calculations
• Tier 3 and Tier 3 Enhanced calculations
• FAS and 3-Year Average builders
• Pension estimates based on your saved information
• Overtime pension goal calculator
• Longevity enhancement calculations
• 1/60ths calculator for eligible Tier 2 members
• Pension options and contribution tools
• Accident Disability Retirement (ADR) calculator
• Pension statement scanning tools
• Retirement AI assistant for exploring pension scenarios
• Reference information for important pension rules and benefits
Your information stays private and organized within the app so you can adjust your numbers and explore different retirement scenarios.
Whether you are approaching retirement or still have years to go, FDNY Retirement Planner gives you a convenient way to understand how changes in service, earnings and other pension factors may affect your retirement estimate.
Important Disclaimer:
FDNY Retirement Planner is an independent informational and estimation tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official application of the FDNY, the City of New York, NYCERS, NYCPPF, or any government agency or pension system. Calculations and information provided by the app are estimates for planning and educational purposes only and should not be considered official pension calculations, financial advice, or a guarantee of benefits. Users should verify retirement information and benefit eligibility with the appropriate pension system or official source before making retirement or financial decisions.

bluejetty:00145070:ios.summary:
TRANSFORM SCREEN TIME INTO CREATIVE LEARNING
Looking for a fun and educational drawing app for toddlers and preschoolers?
Binky Coloring turns every coloring moment into a creative learning experience and a chance for kids’ creative play, h
bluejetty:00145070:ios.description:
TRANSFORM SCREEN TIME INTO CREATIVE LEARNING
Looking for a fun and educational drawing app for toddlers and preschoolers?
Binky Coloring turns every coloring moment into a creative learning experience and a chance for kids’ creative play, helping children explore colors, practice drawing, and develop essential early skills. The app has 150+ pages that will develop creativity, fine motor skills and hand eye coordination of your child.
Perfect for boys and girls ages 2–5!
DEVELOPED WITH EARLY CHILDHOOD EXPERTS
All content in Binky Coloring is created in collaboration with early education specialists.
Coloring is more than filling shapes – it supports real developmental progress:
• Fine motor control
• Upper body and core strength
• Visual perception
• Focus and attention
Binky Coloring guides children step by step as they learn, experiment, and express their imagination.
PERSONALIZED LEARNING EXPERIENCE
Every child is different – and so is their creative path.
Binky Coloring allows children to explore, experiment, and develop at their own pace.
Kids gain fine motor skills, concentration, creativity, self-expression, and a love for artistic play.
WHAT’S INSIDE
Binky Coloring includes a wide range of themed coloring books that keep kids engaged all year long:
• Animals
• Dinosaurs
• Transport
• Halloween
• Robots
• Color by Number
• Dolls
• Alphabet & Numbers
• Christmas
Creative tools included:
• Pencil – precise strokes for careful coloring
• Brush – smooth, wide lines for painting large areas
• Spray – fun textured effects for creativity
• Crayon – soft edges and a classic coloring feel
• Felt-tip pen – bright, bold colors for details
• Chalk – soft, smudgy artistic texture
Plus Magic Painting, which creates beautiful results automatically – perfect for toddlers starting their first drawings.
BENEFITS FOR YOUNG ARTISTS
• Enhances fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination
• Boosts imagination and creativity
• Supports recognition of shapes and colors
• Encourages self-expression
• Builds patience, focus, and concentration
Coloring allows children to express emotions and ideas they may not yet be able to say in words.
WHY FAMILIES LOVE THIS APP
• Intuitive, child-friendly design
• 100% ad-free – no interruptions
• Works offline – ideal for home and travel
• Kid-safe environment with no distractions
• Great for preschool preparation and early learning
LEARNING THROUGH PLAY
Children learn best when they’re having fun.
Whether your child is coloring animals, exploring the alphabet, or trying magic painting, every moment becomes an opportunity to learn and grow.
GET STARTED
Download the app and start exploring a bright and creative world of coloring fun.
You can unlock coloring sets such as:
• Animals Coloring
• Dinosaurs Coloring
• Transport Coloring
• Holiday & Seasonal Coloring
• Alphabet & Numbers
• Color by Number
• Dolls and Robots
– all available individually or as a complete collection.
Some pages are available for free. To enjoy the full collection, parents can unlock all coloring books with a one-time purchase.
PRIVACY POLICY
Your child’s safety and privacy are our top priorities.
Binky Coloring never shows third-party ads or collects personal data.
We fully comply with the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) to ensure a safe and secure experience.
START YOUR CHILD’S COLORING ADVENTURE
Download Binky Coloring today and transform screen time into meaningful, creative learning.
With every coloring experience, children don’t just draw – they learn, develop, and shine.

Welcome to Paired: the app that brings couples closer. Life can be messy, but your relationship doesn’t have to be. Paired helps you build better communication, manage conflict, and deepen your connection in just 5 minutes a day.

- Apple App of the Day, August 2026
- Scientifically proven to increase relationship satisfaction
- Featured in The New York Times, BBC News, Bustle, and more

- Make connection a daily habit: Daily questions allow you to effortlessly dedicate time each day to build strong communication, encourage intimacy, and strengthen your relationship.
- Pair with your partner: Add your answers and then unlock your partners responses to start a discussion, discover more about them and build a deep connection. 
- Celebrate every event, big or small: Use Paired to keep track of the important dates in your relationship, from the big ones like anniversaries and birthdays, to the small, significant moments, like your first kiss or your favorite date night.

bluejetty:00174997:ios.name: La Crosse View
bluejetty:00174997:ios.summary: La Crosse View is the companion app for La Crosse Technology Wi-Fi Weather Stations and Alert & Monitoring Systems. Stay connected to your environment—both outdoors and throughout your home—with real-time data and custom alerts sent directl
bluejetty:00174997:ios.description:
La Crosse View is the companion app for La Crosse Technology Wi-Fi Weather Stations and Alert & Monitoring Systems. Stay connected to your environment—both outdoors and throughout your home—with real-time data and custom alerts sent directly to your mobile devices.
PRIMARY FEATURES 
• Remote Sensor Monitoring 
• Custom Push Notification Alerts 
• Data Graphs for Daily Trends 
• Data Exports for Historical Tracking 
• Personalized App Experience 
[Custom Images, Naming, Device Order] 
• Ability to Share Devices 
• Manage Numerous Locations/Devices with One Account 
• Connects Weather Stations/Gateways to Wi-Fi 
• Controls Forecast Settings Unique to Wi-Fi Weather Stations 
WI-FI WEATHER STATIONS 
La Crosse View allows you to remotely track weather conditions such as temperature, humidity, wind, rain, and more, giving you access to hyperlocal data from sensors right in your backyard. The app is required to connect weather station displays to Wi-Fi, program location settings to receive local Internet weather forecasts on the stations, and set up Data Streams for custom messaging and weather updates. 
ALERT & MONITORING SYSTEMS 
Monitor water detection for basements, sinks, and appliances, temperature throughout your home (or in the freezer), humidity in various spaces, open/closed status of doors and gates, pool conditions, food temps, and more. La Crosse View is required to connect Bridge Gateways (sensor relays) to Wi-Fi, set and receive custom app alerts, and view data remotely, anytime, anywhere.
EASY SETUP & MANAGEMENT 
La Crosse View features a guided walkthrough that ensures Weather Stations and Bridge Gateways sync with your Wi-Fi network, and wireless sensors are easily paired with your app. From there, customize sensor locations with personal images for easy reference, view detailed graphs to study trends over time, manage multiple locations and devices from one application, and share access with family members as needed. Whether you're setting up your first sensor or expanding a system as your needs grow, La Crosse View supports your journey—from first home to dream home.
POPULAR USE CASES 
 Indoor Monitoring 
• Basement temp & humidity 
• Freezer or refrigerator temperature alerts 
• Nursery or bedroom comfort monitoring 
• Wine cellar or storage room conditions 
 Outdoor Monitoring 
• Backyard weather conditions 
• Pool and hot tub temperature 
• Garden and greenhouse environments 
 Appliance & Utility Areas 
• Water heater monitoring 
• Washing machine area leak detection 
• Sump pump area conditions 
• Garage and basement freeze warnings 
 Outbuildings & Unconditioned Spaces 
• Barns and sheds 
• Detached garages 
• Pavilions and event spaces 
• Ice shanties and seasonal shelters 
 Hobby & Specialty Uses 
• BBQ and smoker temperature tracking 
• Musical instrument protection 
• Home brewing climate 
• Pet habitat monitoring 
• Humidor conditions 
• Vehicle storage temperature 
 Entry Points & Security-Adjacent 
• Door and window contact status 
• Cabinets or mailbox open/closed status 
• Gate position monitoring 
• Workshop or storage access 
HARDWARE REQUIREMENTS 
To receive data, the La Crosse View app requires a La Crosse Technology Wi-Fi Weather Station or Bridge Gateway with at least one compatible sensor. Visit www.lacrossetechnology.com/pages/la-crosse-view for more details and to explore available systems and sensors. 
ABOUT LA CROSSE TECHNOLOGY 
Family-owned and operated out of La Crosse, WI, since 1983, we strive to create innovative products that inform, inspire, and enhance everyday life. Harnessing the power of monitoring, time, and weather, with a deep focus on reliability, we assure accurate information and lasting value.

bluejetty:00098583:ios.description:
Welcome to Nubula, the fun and modern way to predict your baby's gender using the celebrated Nub Theory!
Are you eagerly awaiting to know more about your little one? Nubula uses advanced AI to analyze your baby's ultrasound photo, giving you a fun prediction based on scientifically-backed principles. It's simple, instant, and designed for curious parents-to-be like you.
HOW IT WORKS:
Upload a Photo: Select a clear ultrasound photo from your gallery (ideally from 12-14 weeks).
AI Analysis: Our intelligent algorithm examines the "nub" angle in seconds.
Reveal Your Prediction: Get an instant, beautifully presented prediction—is it a boy or a girl?
BEYOND THE PREDICTION:
Confidence Score: Understand the AI's certainty level with a clear percentage.
Detailed Insights: Read the AI's reasoning behind the prediction. Our system provides honest feedback, even when the image is unclear.
Multi-Language Support: Get your results in your native language.
Beautiful & Fun Interface: Enjoy a modern, elegant, and joyful user experience from start to finish.
A SPECIAL MOMENT
Nubula is more than an app; it's a way to create a special, memorable moment in your pregnancy journey. Share the excitement with your family and friends and start dreaming about your baby's future.
Download Nubula now and get your first, exciting clue!
Disclaimer: This application is for entertainment purposes only and is not a medical diagnosis. The predictions are based on the Nub Theory and AI analysis, which are not 100% accurate. Please consult your doctor for a definitive medical diagnosis.

bluejetty:00183857:ios.description:
Your "My Employee Savings" application is changing in order to offer you an enhanced, smoother and more intuitive browsing experience available on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. 
Wherever you are, you can easily access and manage all of your employee savings products: Company Savings Plan (PEE), Mandatory Profit-Sharing Premium, Collective Retirement Savings Plan (PERCO)
Connect simply and securely with your usual username and password. To make it even easier, you can access the application using your fingerprint by activating Touch ID.
1. CHECK THE DETAILS OF YOUR ASSETS
Access your personal site simply and securely, using your usual username and password. View your savings, categorized by product and investment vehicles; forecast the annual availability deadlines of your savings; and estimate gains or losses generated by your investments.
2. TRACK THE PROGRESS OF YOUR TRANSACTIONS AND CHANGES IN YOUR INVESTMENTS
Track the progress of your open transactions or view the details of a completed transaction; View the investment vehicles in which you have invested or can invest, and measure their performance over time.
3. MANAGE YOUR EMPLOYEE SAVINGS
Respond to your mandatory (or optional) profit-sharing premium to send us your investment and payment choices; make a transfer to change the distribution of your assets between different Employee Investment Funds (FCPEs) within your Company Savings Plan (PEE) (or your Collective Retirement Savings Plan (PERCO)). 
4. RECEIVE INFORMATION AND ADVICE ON EMPLOYEE SAVINGS
Receive our publications (reporting, financial market analysis, news and videos); use recommendations from our virtual advisor and our simulation tools to better understand the employee savings schemes and make the right choices in terms of early release. 
5. CONTACT AN ADVISOR
Contact our telephone advisors directly from the application.

bluejetty:00179509:ios.description:
3 million downloads 
Featured as Today's app in many countries and is the perfect app for learning photography.
"Darkr actually taught us how to frame pictures better"
- AppleInsider
Have you ever dreamt of trying an old darkroom, but don't have the equipment nor the time?
Now you can, and without getting wet.
DARKROOM
In a fun and intuitive way you will pick the strip that has the best time and contrast.
And just like a real darkroom, you can make parts of the image brighter and darker by blocking or adding more light to the image.
You will be presented in a very easy way with lots of tutorials on how to use the tools.
The images will only be in black and white (but you may tone them). 
DARKROOM FEATURES
+ Develop either your images from your camera-roll or taken by the Large-Format camera
+ Only Black & White
+ Stripes - As in a real darkroom you'll have to find the best strip. It will be challenging, fun and very powerful
+ Crop / Rotate - Both crop and rotate the image in the same tool
+ Dodge - Make a selected part of the image brighter.
+ Burn - Make a selected part of the image darker
+ Blur - Enhance the background with some beautiful blurriness.
+ Tone - Tone the images with various strength. The toners that can be used are Selenium, Cyanotype and Sepia.
+ Layers - You can add as many effects as you want. Each effect will be treated as a layer that can be edited, deleted and changed its visibility.

• Watch anywhere, anytime
Perfect for busy schedules—stream on the go or enjoy quick episodes whenever you have a moment.

bluejetty:00161701:ios.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE: Only download this app if you or a member of your family are a current member of the GrandPad service.
GrandPad allows you to communicate with your family in a simple, safe and fun way! With this app, you can send photos, video call, and share with everyone in your family.
A companion application to the GrandPad tablet. Keep grandma and grandpa in the social media and communication loop by means of video calling, emailing, and sharing photos/videos. Also, see instant updates from those in your family circle.
Feature Highlights:
- See photos & videos posted by contacts in your trusted friends & family circle.
- Share memories by posting photos & videos for those in your GrandPad contacts to see.
- Contribute to the conversation by commenting back and forth with friends and family on shared posts. Even listen to voice comments left by your loved ones.
- Call, text, email, and make video calls with those in your always up-to-date GrandPad contact list.
- Add up to 4 total participants to a video call, so that more members of your family and loved ones can join.
- Invite new contacts to the family circle using their phone number and/or email address from your device’s contact book.
- Play games at your own pace with turn-based gameplay, or challenge your opponents in real-time matches, even while in a video call! You decide how you want to play. Receive alerts when it's your turn to play, so you never miss a move.
- See what the weather’s like where your friends and family live.
- Keep your profile and contact information up-to-date & stay connected with your closed friends & family circle. Add multiple phone numbers & email addresses to your profile to ensure your loved one knows it’s you when you are trying to contact them.
- Get in touch with our member experience team for any questions you have about GrandPad.
- Get notified for new posts, comments, video calls, and updates from GrandPad.

人间正道是沧桑，谨以此作品向曾经奋斗在秘密战线的无名英雄们致敬！

bluejetty:00026657:ios.description:
Female-founded by creators and for creators, the Tezza photo & video editing app is your one-stop shop for creating beautiful content. Every feature is hand-crafted with you in mind to help you achieve the aesthetic of your dreams. 
We’re honored to be the preferred editing app of today’s top content creators — We hope that you’re next! 
Make your photos & videos pop with our on-trend editing tools, including:
PRESETS
Easily add the perfect filter from 40+ presets made with love by our founder. Ranging in style like vintage vibes, dark and moody, minimal edits, and bright and colorful. 
EFFECTS 
Set your content apart with our vintage-inspired effects. Some favorites are Stop Motion for a vibey slow motion feel, Subtitles for a dreamy vintage cinema feel, and retro film Frames, like Super 8, VHS, 8mm, Kodak, VCR, and more. 
TEMPLATES
We’ve made it easy to create the perfect stories. Pick from 150+ word class designs spanning film, editorial, magazines, 90s, y2k, floral, moodboards, minimal, sketch art, and more. Add text to tell a story, and change template colors to fit your brand. 
OVERLAYS
Add texture and dimension to your photos with overlays like Paper, Dust, Light, Plastic, Shadows, and more.
FEED PLANNER
Curate your perfect feed with our drag and drop feed planner, with the option to add multiple accounts.
BATCH EDITING
Once you’ve dialed in the perfect edit, easily copy and paste that exact edit to as many photos and videos as you want. 
ADJUSTMENTS
Tweak your edits with 14 professional tools, including HSL. Popular favorites include Blur and Grain for an effortless film look. 
Tag us in your photos and videos with @Tezza and #tezza for a chance to be featured.

bluejetty:00033231:ios.description:
StepBloc lets you earn your screen time by doing Push-ups, Squats and other workouts. For example, you need to do 10 push-ups to use instagram for 10 mins. 
Just follow 3 simple steps: 
+Choose the distracting apps.
+Set your goal (Push-ups, Squats, or Steps).
+Move! Apps stay blocked until your goal is hit.
Why should you download StepBloc?
+ Control how much time you spend on distracting apps.
+ Reduce your screen time. 
+ Stay healthy by staying active. 
+ Reclaim your focus. 
Key Features:
+ Steps to unblock: Distracted apps are blocked unless you completed required number of steps. 
+ Push-Ups to unblock: Distracted apps are blocked unless you completed required number of Push-Ups. 
+ Squats to unblock: Distracted apps are blocked unless you completed required number of Squats. 
+ App Blocking Scheduler: Set specific times to block distracting apps, ensuring uninterrupted focus during work, study, or leisure time. 
+ Usage Limits: Define daily usage limits for your distracted apps. 
+ Focus Tracker: Measure your daily focus minutes and block distracting apps until you complete your focus minute target.
+ Insights: Gain valuable insights into your digital habits with detailed analytics and reports.
+ Secure and Private: Rest assured that your data is safe with StepBloc. All of your data stays in the device. 
Take control of your digital distractions, reclaim your focus, and unlock your full potential with StepBloc. Download now and experience the transformative power of mindful device management!
The Monthly Pass
Subscribe to monthly pass to get unlimited access to blocks.
- Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
- Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- When you cancel a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. 
- While cancelling, Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Terms: https://hamsters.tech/stepbloc-t-c
Privacy: https://hamsters.tech/stepbloc-privacy-policy
HealthKit Integration: StepBloc accesses your step count data from HealthKit to incentivize healthy habits. By linking your daily step count with app usage, StepBloc rewards you with app access based on your physical activity level. This integration encourages movement and ensures that you strike a balance between screen time and physical wellness. 
Note: HealthKit data is used only if user decides to use Step Block as the blocking method in app.

bluejetty:00083940:ios.description:
This app is developed by "LIFULL HOME'S" which is one of the biggest real estate
portal sites in Japan.
You can search for real estate properties both for rent and sale with a
smooth interaction.
You can freely set conditions like train lines, stations, cities, or
even distance from the point where you are by GPS.
Additionally, this app gives you information about average market price of each room types of each stations near by you.
With this functionality, you can check average monthly price of properties in a city where you often go shopping, or a city near by your office, for example. You can save pictures you visit and even leave notes for each picture.
This app is powered by our huge database, the biggest one in Japan.
:: Functionalities ::
With this app, you can
- search for apartments, condominiums and houses for both rent and sale, as well as newly-built condominiums, newly-built houses for sale.
- check average monthly price for renting a room nearby you
- call realtors by toll-free number
- search by train lines, cities and distance from where you are.
- check location of a realtor or a property on a map.
- stock favorite properties in a list.
- stock several search conditions, and easily re-search by them.
- view route for a realtor location by launching map application.
- once you login, it's available to check your favorites and histories on multiple device(PC, Mobile Site and Apps).
- check ToDo list from the beginning of searching house to after moving by category such as like contract, moving, and so on.
- save pictures of homes you visit and leave mote for each, automatically organized pictures by homes. (turn on GPS)
We are planning to update constantly. Please keep on watching.
:: About LIFULL HOME'S ::
"LIFULL HOME'S" is a real estate and housing portal site, with databases of over 4 million properties in Japan.
You can contact realtors through "LIFULL HOME'S" about any properties you like.
We are providing variety of services relating to switching houses, from
searching information around stations, cities, to contracting, moving.
:: Notes ::
Properties are only in Japan, so that you can contact realtors in Japanese only.
We will hold our own campaign, but it is not related to Apple Inc. and Apple Japan Inc.

bluejetty:00094922:ios.description:
Inspired by the Beatles’ groundbreaking use of AI on "Now and Then," where they transformed a rough demo into something magical — we thought, why not do the same with our own music? Now you can.
MicSwap Remix is your Music-Powered audio playground; a stem splitter, multitrack recorder, and mic modeler in one sleek app. Instantly separate vocals, drums, bass, and other instruments from any track, even lo-fi demos or voice memos and start remixing with studio-quality clarity.
Layer new recordings, swap mic tones with our signature MicSwap models, and add built-in effects like reverb, delay, and panning. Whether you’re remixing, sampling, creating karaoke tracks, or cleaning up a podcast, MicSwap Remix makes it easy to turn rough recordings into professional mixes.
USE IT TO:
• Remix old demos into polished multitrack recordings 
• Sample vocals, drums, or melodies from any song
• Create karaoke or instrumental versions
• Solo instruments or parts to more easily learn them 
• Record and arrange vocals with pro mic tones
• Isolate voice for podcasts, interviews, or voiceovers
• Clean up rehearsal recordings or live performances
• Make mashups, DJ edits, or custom sound beds
• Split multitracks for collaborative songwriting
• Reimagine classic recordings with modern clarity
• Extract and loop parts for beat making 
KEY FEATURES:
• Stem Separation – Extract vocals, drums, bass, and more in seconds
• Vocal Isolation/Removal – Perfect for remixes, karaoke, voiceovers, and samples
• MicSwap Integration – Instantly change your mic tone with pro mic models
• Multitrack Recording – Record new parts right into your mix
• Studio Effects – Reverb, delay, pan, volume & more per track
• Export to AudioMaster – Instantly master your mix in one tap
• Fast, Pro Results – Create studio-sounding tracks without studio gear
Whether you're a musician, producer, DJ, or content creator, MicSwap Remix gives you the creative power to reimagine your audio — and sound amazing doing it 
We offer 3 subscription plans:
1 Week Unlimited Splitting & Recording
1 Month Unlimited Splitting & Recording
1 Month Unlimited Splitting & Recording

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00076595:ios.description:
World Around Me - WAM is your local search guide. 
World Around Me is a unique way to find useful places around you - such as restaurants, ATMs, pharmacies, groceries, doctors, shops, bus/metro stations and more. WAM uses your phone’s camera to give you a completely new way of exploring a place, anywhere in the world.
When you point the phone's camera in any direction, then you will see overlays of virtual signboards onto the camera view in that direction. Augmented Reality is thus used to enhance the view of your surroundings. This helps you navigate intuitively to places of your interest, using your phone’s camera.
∎ Features
◆ Search for places in 37 categories.
◆ Find all kinds of places around you using keyword search.
◆ Check out directions, phone numbers and more.
◆ Choose between camera, list and map views to navigate.
◆ Rank places around you by distance or importance.
◆ Get the real-time distance to a point of interest. Find out how near you are to a place even as you make your way towards it.
◆ Family & Friends: Share location with friends and family. 
◆ "Book a tour" for selected art galleries, museums and also tourist attractions viewed with text search.
◆ In London see realtime arrival information for Buses, Underground (Tube) and Trams arriving at nearby stops and stations.
◆ In Berlin, Brandenburg, Hamburg in Germany, London in UK search nearby stations for various modes of transportation, including Bus, Train, S-Bahn, Metro, Tram and Ferry. Realtime departure information for all transport types from all nearby stations can also be seen.
∎ Place Categories
◆ Restaurants | Bars | Cafes
◆ Banks | ATMs
◆ Movie Theaters
◆ Museums | Art Galleries
◆ Parks
◆ Gas Stations | EV Chargers | Parking
◆ Metro Stations | Train Stations | Bus Stops | Taxi Stands | Airports
◆ Hospitals | Doctors | Dental Clinics | Pharmacies
◆ Gyms | Spas
◆ Hotels | Campgrounds
◆ Shopping Malls | Grocers | Clothing Stores | Book Stores | Shoe Stores
◆ Churches | Mosques | Temples | Synagogues
◆ Recycling Centers 
∎ Unique and Highly Rated
Used in over 200 countries, WAM is recommended by the BBC, The Guardian and National Geographic. Users love the unique camera view that lets them discover new places in a simple and intuitive way.
We hope you love our app as much as our users and we do! Install it today and let us know what you think.

bluejetty:00147130:ios.description:
Stop scrolling and take back control with Zario—your fun, AI-powered focus app that helps you stay productive without blocking everything.
**18 YEARS OF Scrolling**
That’s how much time an average 30-year-old is expected to spend looking down on their screen. With Zario, you can get over 5 of those years back.
Zario isn’t just another app blocker—it’s your personal focus tool that can literally control access to your distracting apps. Whether you’re breaking free from distractions, boosting productivity, or simply trying to reclaim your time, Zario helps you achieve it all without being overly serious or intrusive.
WHAT SETS ZARIO APART:
- Smart Coaching: Negotiate with Zario AI for extra screen time. The first-ever AI that grants or denies access to distracting apps.
- Better Use of Your Time: Instead of blocking everything, Zario helps you make every moment meaningful by automating screen time management.
- Tough Love When Needed: Personalized pause screens and lighthearted roasts make you rethink mindless scrolling with humor.
REAL RESULTS, BACKED BY SCIENCE:
Zario isn’t just effective—it’s scientifically proven. A groundbreaking study by Maastricht University found that 88.87% of at-risk users significantly reduced their phone usage after just one week with Zario. These aren’t just claims—they’re results supported by cutting-edge research.
See the study here https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/6fjs3https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/6fjs3 
WHAT USERS ARE SAYING:
- “It’s like a personal trainer for my social media habits!” — Mark S.
- “Finally, a productivity app that doesn’t take itself too seriously!” — Carmen M.
- “So honored that my book, Indistractable, inspired this! Keep up the great work.” — Nir Eyal
SUBSCRIPTION & PRIVACY:
After your free trial, subscriptions are billed through your iTunes account.
Your privacy matters. Your data stays on your device - protected by Apple.
View our policy here: https://www.meetzario.com/privacy

Start your journey with Zario today—focus has never been this fun.

Metadata is the modern photo metadata viewer for photographers, creators and visual professionals.
Import an image from Photos or Files and instantly discover the hidden information behind your photos. Explore detailed EXIF data, camera settings, image dimensions, DPI, file size, lens details, location information and more — all displayed in a beautiful interface designed for creative workflows.
Whether you shoot on iPhone, DSLR, mirrorless cameras or create artwork in professional editing apps, Metadata helps you inspect, analyse and better understand your images.
Perfect for:
• Photographers
• Designers
• Content creators
• Social media professionals
• Digital artists
• Print studios
• Creative agencies
FEATURES
• View detailed photo metadata and EXIF information
• Inspect ISO, aperture, exposure, focal length and lens details
• See image dimensions, DPI, colour profile and file size
• View device and location information stored in photos
• Import images from Photos, Files and other apps
• Drag and Drop support for fast professional workflows
• Fast, elegant and modern design
• Optimised for creators and creative professionals

• Extract text directly from photos using on-device text recognition
• Copy and share recognised text instantly
• Access advanced photography metadata and camera information
• Calculate print sizes with the built-in DPI calculator
• Check image dimensions for print and production workflows
From analysing exported artwork to checking professional camera settings before print, Metadata gives creators a powerful way to inspect and understand their images anywhere.

bluejetty:00088587:ios.description:
Motocross Racer for iOS gives you the speed and excitement of realistic off-road motorcycle racing! Its fast pace and responsiveness is unlike any other side scrolling motocross game. Designed for maximum realism, this game gives you an accurate simulation of real-world motorcycle and rider physics. The motorcycles and riders move and react just like the real thing! Race against the game’s 4 built-in opponents (2 at a time), your friends (by sending them your replays), or even against your own replays. Watch replays forward, reverse, or in slow motion when the race is over. Improve your lap times by learning motocross riding techniques like Brake Tapping, Panic Revving, Scrubbing, and Seat Bouncing (done with button combinations). Customizable: Choose rider name & number, motorcycle & rider colors, background scenes, and bike class. Upgrade your dirt bike with IAPs for Speed, Acceleration, and Suspension. Challenge friends and check leaderboards with Game Center.
Features
• 2.5D graphics
• Up to 120 challenging and unique motocross tracks
• 125cc, 250cc, 500cc dirt bikes
• Choose from 4 opponents for each track
• Race against friend's replays (Player vs Player)
• Race against your own replays
• Easy to use controls (with button combos)
• VERY realistic motorcycle physics
• Realistic 2-stroke engine sound
• Choose motorcycle & rider colors
• Choose rider name & dirt bike number
• Choose background scenes 
• Watch replays of the race (slow motion too)
• Game Center support for world ranking
• In-game tutorial for real racing techniques 
• IAPs for Speed, Acceleration, Suspension, Tracks
• Offline Indie mobile game

bluejetty:00062128:ios.name: Deutsch perfekt lernen
bluejetty:00062128:ios.summary: Read, understand and speak German better – with the Deutsch perfekt app. Improve your German at various language levels from A2 onwards. Read interesting features, listen to entertaining audio content and complete related language exercises
bluejetty:00062128:ios.description:
Read, understand and speak German better – with the Deutsch perfekt app. Improve your German at various language levels from A2 onwards. Read interesting features, listen to entertaining audio content and complete related language exercises. Discover something new every month about people, society and life in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Deutsch perfekt combines effective language training with practical knowledge of German-speaking countries.
=================
MAGAZINE
Read journalistic features and interviews about everyday life, work and culture in German-speaking countries at three levels: easy (A2) – intermediate (B1) – advanced (B2–C2). A dictionary function translates unfamiliar words. With a single click, you can listen to audio content to accompany the text. Additional practical learning aids support your learning success.
AUDIO
Explore our audio content featuring exclusive material, spoken by native speakers – including dialogues, interviews and reports. Learn, practise and listen to German while doing something else: on the go, when cooking or exercising. Listen to authentic German as it is spoken in German-speaking countries and improve your vocabulary and pronunciation.
EXERCISES
Do exercises that accompany the magazine and audio content at three levels of difficulty – covering vocabulary, grammar and improving your reading and listening comprehension. Put what you’ve learned into practice and learn new things!
=================
What can the app do?
The Deutsch perfekt app helps you learn German with intuitive user guidance that combines texts, audio clips and exercises. Words that are unfamiliar at your current level are explained directly within the texts. This means you not only understand the texts, but also learn new words with every text. The app translates words that are unfamiliar at your language level into ten different languages.
=================
Can I use the app as a Deutsch perfekt subscriber?
Do you already have a digital Deutsch perfekt subscription via ZEIT SPRACHEN? If so, you can get started straight away: simply download the app and log in using the login details you already have.
Do you have a print subscription to Deutsch perfekt? You can access the content of the Deutsch perfekt app for a small additional fee. To do so, please contact ZEIT SPRACHEN customer service directly at: abo@zeit-sprachen.de or +49 (0) 89/121 407 10.
=================

bluejetty:00159512:ios.name: AVO: Phone Security
bluejetty:00159512:ios.summary:
AVO protects your iPhone from malware sites, phishing links and scams, and tells you when your email shows up in a data breach.
MALWARE & PHISHING PROTECTION (WEB SHIELD)
Web Shield blocks known malware, phishing, scam and tracking sites b
bluejetty:00159512:ios.description:
AVO protects your iPhone from malware sites, phishing links and scams, and tells you when your email shows up in a data breach.
MALWARE & PHISHING PROTECTION (WEB SHIELD)
Web Shield blocks known malware, phishing, scam and tracking sites before they load, in every app and browser. It runs as a secure VPN through AVO's server, which checks each website address against threat lists updated every day, and shows you how many it blocked. A Family filter also blocks adult sites. We never store the sites you visit, and secure (HTTPS) pages stay unreadable to us.
WHY NOT A TRADITIONAL ANTIVIRUS?
iOS doesn't let any app scan your other apps or files, so a classic antivirus or virus scan isn't possible on iPhone. AVO protects you where threats actually reach an iPhone: harmful websites, phishing links, scam messages, weak settings and leaked passwords.
SECURITY CHECKUP & SCORE
A 30-second checkup looks at your iPhone's own settings: iOS updates, passcode, Face ID or Touch ID, Wi-Fi and more. You get a Security Score from 0 to 100 and step-by-step guides for anything worth fixing.
LINK CHECKER & QR SCANNER
Paste a link, scan a QR code or share a link from Safari or Messages. AVO checks it against Google Web Risk and look-alike tricks, and tells you whether it looks safe, suspicious or harmful before you open it.
AI SCAM CHECKER
Got a message about a parcel, a bank or a prize? Paste it in and AVO's AI looks for the usual scam signs, such as false urgency, payment requests and fake links, and explains what it found. Messages are not stored.
EMAIL BREACH CHECK & MONITORING
See if your email appears in known data breaches, what was exposed and what to do next. Email Monitoring checks up to 4 addresses every day and alerts you when a new breach includes one. Breach data from Have I Been Pwned.
WI-FI SCAN
See whether the network you're on is password protected, with tips for staying safe on public Wi-Fi.
FREE AND AVO PRO
The Security Checkup, fix guides and Wi-Fi Scan are free, and you can try a link check, a scam check and an email breach check for free. AVO Pro adds Web Shield, the Family filter, Email Monitoring, the weekly report and unlimited checks.
AVO Pro is available as a yearly subscription (with a free trial where offered), a monthly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.
Privacy Policy: https://aifinitysolutions.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://avomobilesecurity.com/terms

bluejetty:00185889:ios.summary:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Be brilliant in Bejeweled Stars, a match-3 experience like no other
bluejetty:00185889:ios.description:
This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.
Be brilliant in Bejeweled Stars, a match-3 experience like no other! Experience endless fun and unique challenges every day in a beautiful world filled with surprises, explosions, and playful puzzles. Combine sparkling gems to earn rewards, create boosts when you need them most, uncover collectible emojis to express yourself, and even control the game board itself as you play.
 DISCOVER AMAZING CHALLENGES 
 Bejeweled Stars comes to life with exciting twists and distinctive ways to play. Master moving Currents of gems to enhance your matching strategy. Maneuver gem-filled Clouds around the board, causing winning cascades. Rescue floating butterflies before they slip away into the sky.
 EARN, COLLECT, AND SHARE BEJEWELED EMOJIS
 Open chests to reveal exclusive and delightful Bejeweled emojis that let you express your own style and send personal messages. There are hundreds to enjoy as you play!
 CREATE GAME-WINNING BOOSTS
 Collect SkyGems and use them to create special boosts. Use the Star Swapper to blast through difficult spots. Shuffle the game board for new matches with the Scrambler. Deploy the boosts you want, when you want them, and perfect your winning strategy. 
 LIGHT UP THE NIGHT SKY
 Earn shining stars with every level you play. Watch as they fill Constellations in the sky and unlock amazing rewards! 
 BECOME A STAR 
 Looking for some friendly competition? Each level has its own leaderboard, making it easy to track progress in the game, compete with friends, and show off your powerful skills.
 Go to your shiny place in this matching experience that takes you far away from the everyday.
 Important Consumer Information. This app: Requires a persistent Internet connection (network fees may apply). Requires acceptance of EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy and User Agreement. Includes in-game advertising. Collects data through third party analytics technology (see Privacy & Cookie Policy for details). Contains direct links to the Internet and social networking sites intended for an audience over 13.
 User Agreement: http://terms.ea.com
 Privacy and Cookie Policy: http://privacy.ea.com
 Visit http://help.ea.com for assistance or inquiries

【书籍解读】
各领域专业人士，深入浅出，提炼书中重点，让用户轻松领悟一本书。核心书籍解读产品：樊登讲书、非凡精读馆、李蕾讲经典。
省时：平均45分钟*，听懂一本好书
易懂：提炼重点，解读深入浅出
优质：专业选书团队，甄选高分好书
有用：收获实用知识和处世智慧
樊登讲书：轻轻松松，听懂实用新知！
樊登本人主讲的内容板块，以通俗易懂的方式，每周解读一本好书，帮助你轻松领悟书中精华，给工作、生活、学习带来帮助和启发。
非凡精读馆：100+位大咖，书与人都是惊喜！
非凡精读馆的使命，是为每一本书找到最合适的讲书人，非凡汇聚文学、历史、心理、育儿、职场等垂直领域的学者、教授、大咖，基于视野与学养，讲透每一本好书。
李蕾讲经典：专注人文经典，给你爱与力量！
聚焦人文经典领域，内容涵盖世界名著、国风经典、中国现当代经典以及经典人物传记；从女性视角出发进行解读，更加柔软，更加具有心灵的穿透力，被称拥有“人间清醒的女性视角”。
【课程】
帆书旗下基于书籍内容的深度学习版块，联合专业讲师，帮助用户系统化、模块化学习书籍内容，以实现学以致用，内容涵盖人文社科、职场、心灵、家庭、生活等。
【训练营】
训练营是一种拥有社交属性的社群学习模式，内容来源于“帆书”的精品课程和书籍解读，并配套有教学环节、社群服务、主题活动等。通过不同内容、产品与服务的交互，让用户相互陪伴、一起成长。
内容分类：
【亲子家庭】《正面管教》、《亲密关系》、《如何让你爱的人爱上你》、《父母的语言》，用正确的方法向家人传递爱，提升家庭幸福指数。
【心灵成长】《终身成长》、《自卑与超越》、《应对焦虑》、《自尊》，练就一颗强韧的心淡定应对，走向更好的未来。
【人文历史】《列奥纳多·达·芬奇传》、《苏东坡传》、《孔子传》，解读文化旅程，感受伟人平凡传奇的一生。
【职场进阶】《非暴力沟通》、《刻意练习》、《关键对话》、《高效能人士的七个习惯》，打造核心竞争力，职场进阶不停歇。
【商业财经】《可复制的领导力》、《销售就是要玩转情商》、《反脆弱》、《顾客为什么购买》，与行业大师、业内新锐并肩携手，做正确的事。
【健康生活】《活好》、《运动改造大脑》、《高效休息法》、《学会吃饭》，发现小窍门，掌握生活常识，享受智慧之美。
*45分钟为帆书APP书籍解读平均用时。

bluejetty:00027009:ios.name: FlyQ+ EFB
bluejetty:00027009:ios.summary:
FlyQ+ EFB is a top-rated aviation app because it makes your flying easier and safer by thoughtfully integrating powerful features in a way that minimizes the number of screen taps and uses larger fonts to increase readability.
New features
bluejetty:00027009:ios.description:
FlyQ+ EFB is a top-rated aviation app because it makes your flying easier and safer by thoughtfully integrating powerful features in a way that minimizes the number of screen taps and uses larger fonts to increase readability.
New features such as a glide ring, graphical weather briefing, ability to download two data cycles, and a navlog that expands/collapses airways/SIDs/STARs make flying safer and easier than ever before!
The Global Digital Map shows airports, airways, airspace, navaids, and waypoints from all around the world. Text rotates so it's always right-side up and the level of detail adapts to the zoom level.
Our exceptional "4D Predictive Weather" system uses a Timeline and Altitude Slider to help you analyze weather at different times - both past and future - and at different altitudes. 17 weather layers from both the Internet and ADS-B (e.g. Radar, Icing, Turbulence, PIREPs, Winds Aloft, Surface Winds, Surface Analysis, Satellite, and more), many tied to the Timeline and Altitude Slider, give you unprecedented pre-flight and in-flight safety.
Supports more than 20 ADS-B and in-panel devices: Stratus 3, Avidyne, Dynon, Stratux, and more.
The exclusive Augmented Reality (AR) feature provides situational awareness you'd previously only seen in sci-fi movies. 
The Slingshot wireless system means FlyQ+ supplies maps, plates, and apt diagrams wirelessly to certified systems from BendixKing.
The Visual Logbook and Post Flight Playback / Analysis Graphs add a whole new dimension to your flying. Optionally connect with your friends to "see" and even replay their flights. CFI's can track student progress and remotely send endorsements.
Other key features include split screen, 3D synthetic vision, plates on the map, more than 4,600 airport diagrams, rich Documents support, extended runways, distance measurement, fuel prices, NOTAMS, wind-optimized flight planning, and plates for Mexico and Central America.
NEW! NaviGuard GPS anomaly detection guards against GPS spoofing and jamming
> Maps Your Way
+ Digital, 2D maps, 3D Syn Vis, Augmented Reality
+ Sectionals and IFR charts
+ TACs
+ Photo, road, terrain maps
+ 17 Weather Layers
+ Flight Track
+ Fuel Prices
+ TFRs
+ Obstacle and Terrain Avoidance
+ ADS-B Traffic and Weather
+ Extended runways with right-pattern indicators
+ Procedures on map
+ Rings / Extended Course Line
+ CAP grid
+ Heli and Gulf of Mexico charts
+ VFR Flyways
+ Syn Vis includes HITS boxes, EFIS display, TAWS, Obstacles, and AHRS support.
Night Mode preserves your night vision.
Split screen (iPad only) and single screen.
> Procedures
NEW! FlyQ+ includes the same FAA DO-200B certified Seattle Avionics geo-referenced approach plates and apt diagrams that we supply to certified avionics from Honeywell and Aspen. 
Split screen can show a map and a procedure simultaneously.
> Flight Planning that Saves Time and Money
1. Automatically uses recently cleared ATC routes
2. Automatically plans fuel stops based on lowest cost 
3. Uses expected winds to plot the fastest course
4. CAP/SAR patterns
5. Exchange flight plans with Dynon SkyView, Avidyne, and Aspen
6. Practice with X-Plane or MS Flight Sim / Prepar3D
> Weather
Amazing "4D Predictive Weather" uses a Timeline and Altitude slider to make detailed pre-flight and in-flight analysis easy. The Graphical Wind Optimizer uses red and green bars to show the headwind or tailwind at different altitudes. Also includes an extensive gallery of weather images.
> Airport Information
The Airport screen concisely shows key operational info, sat images, and rwy diagrams on a single screen. Weather, approach procedures, A/FD, and FBO info are just a tap away. Includes more than 4,600 SA Airport Diagrams.
> Data Manager
FlyQ+ makes it painless to download new data every month: spin and zoom a 3D globe to visually select the states you need.
> Try it before you buy it
Experience everything FlyQ+ EFB offers with a free 30-day subscription.

bluejetty:00014319:ios.description:
Zoho Invoice is a completely FREE invoicing application that ensures you get paid for your hard work. Zoho Invoice is the perfect invoicing app for your small business, allowing you to create estimates, convert them into professional invoices, send the invoices, and receive payments from customers.
Here's everything you need to know about the ultimate invoice creator app, Zoho Invoice.
The best invoicing app is on the house
Zoho Invoice was a paid app until 2021, when we decided to level the playing field for small businesses and made it completely free. Zoho Invoice does not have hidden paid plans; it is free forever.
Create and send invoices however you'd like
You get to choose from over 18 professional invoice templates and customize the tables, fonts, colors, fields, and more. The invoices can be sent directly to the customer's email inbox or downloaded as a PDF invoice, which can be shared via iMessage or WhatsApp.
Easily collect and track online payments
Connect your Zoho Invoice account to a payment gateway and give your customers the flexibility to pay with their preferred payment modes. Upon payment, invoices are automatically marked as "paid" in Zoho Invoice.
Your payment follow-ups are on autopilot
Configure automated payment reminders to follow up with customers for overdue invoices. You have full control over when the payment reminders are sent and can customize the emails as you'd like.
Get better deals with estimates 
Use Zoho Invoice's estimates to negotiate with customers and close deals. Customers can view, discuss, reject, and approve estimates. Approved estimates are automatically converted into invoices.
Work on hour-based projects with time tracking
If you're a freelancer or small business where you charge customers based on total hours spent on the project, you can use Zoho Invoice to track time and convert timesheets into invoices.
A simplified and elevated customer experience
Your customers are empowered with a portal where they can log in with a user ID and password. Here, they can view credits, approve and reject estimates, pay invoices, download customer statements, and drop feedback.
Track every penny that leaves your business's pockets
All these capabilities aside, Zoho Invoice is also your friendly business expense tracking app. Record unbillable expenses like rent and maintenance. Also, record billable expenses like raw material costs and get reimbursed by customers.
Your business's numbers at your fingertips
The moment you log into Zoho Invoice, the dashboard gives you a visual glimpse of your business's health. Dive into deeper metrics with in-depth reports on best-selling products and services, AR aging, top customers, expenses, and projects.
We're constantly tweaking your favorite invoice maker app to work better with your Apple device. We also focus our efforts towards introducing features exclusive to iOS.
Here are some of Zoho Invoice's special features tailored for iOS:
 • Place a handy widget on your iPhone's home screen that shows crucial business numbers and also allows you to perform quick actions.
 • Secure your financial information with the Touch/Face/Apple ID passcode verification.
 • Print your invoices and estimates using Air Print.
 • Upload and store your customer files securely on iCloud.
 • Use Zoho Invoice's built-in document scanner to save clear copies of paper documents.
 • Add new contacts using the OCR-powered scan feature by simply snapping a picture of the customer's business card.
 • Locate your customers' addresses on the map so your field staff can navigate to the locations effortlessly.
Zoho Invoice is trusted by thousands of businesses around the world. Download the Zoho Invoice app today to simplify your invoicing and payment tracking.
Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions:
- https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
- https://www.zoho.com/terms.html
Have questions? Write to us at support+mobile@zohoinvoice.com

bluejetty:00152136:ios.description:
Match 3D Mania - Tile Game
A challenging and original 3D matching puzzle game that stands out as a highly anticipated brain-training masterpiece on the App Store, thanks to its well-designed gameplay and immersive experience. Whether you're looking to relax during spare moments or systematically exercise your thinking skills, this game delivers a premium gaming experience.
Core Gameplay: A Brain Challenge Testing Observation and Logical Thinking
Amid a cluttered matrix of 3D objects, you need to quickly identify and match three identical target objects. Once matched, the objects will be eliminated, driving the game progress forward. The game features a time-limited challenge mechanism, requiring you to complete matches efficiently within the specified time to achieve a higher score. Additionally, a score multiplier system is introduced—if you can complete consecutive matches within 5 seconds, your score will increase by a factor, offering an advanced path for players striving for high scores.
For scenarios of varying difficulty, the game provides two practical power-ups: the "Find" power-up can accurately locate objects to be matched, solving the problem of visual blind spots; the "Freeze" power-up locks the current score multiplier, giving you more time to plan subsequent moves and helping you break through level bottlenecks.
Core Features: Creating a High-Quality 3D Puzzle Experience
1. Massive 3D Object Library: Contains over 400 carefully modeled 3D objects, covering categories such as food, fruits, toys, and animals. Each level presents a brand-new combination of objects, continuously bringing fresh visual experiences.
2. Immersive Audio-Visual Effects: Adopts high-quality sound effects and vivid 3D visual rendering technology. Exclusive sound effects and animation feedback are triggered simultaneously when objects are matched, creating a delicate interactive experience and enhancing game immersion.
3. Comprehensive Brain Training: Through the complete process of "Observation - Memory - Logical Matching", it effectively exercises concentration, short-term memory, and quick decision-making abilities, realizing the core value of "entertainment as exercise".
4. Fun Collection System: Features a chest unlocking mechanism. You can obtain chests by completing level tasks and collect various rare 3D objects, satisfying collection needs and improving the long-term playability of the game.
5. Diverse Booster Support: Offers a variety of functional boosters that provide precise assistance for different game scenarios. They help you easily tackle high-difficulty levels, lowering the entry barrier while preserving the joy of challenge.
6. Unrestricted Gaming Freedom: Supports both online and offline operation modes, no Wi-Fi or internet connection required. Whether you're on the commute or during a break, you can start the game anytime and enjoy an unconstrained puzzle experience.
Target Audience: A Puzzle Masterpiece for Everyone
Whether you're a fan of 3D puzzle games, matching game enthusiasts, or lovers of traditional Mahjong games, you can find unique fun in this game. We are committed to enabling every player to exercise and relax their brain while enjoying light entertainment through high-quality game design. We sincerely invite you to experience this 3D matching masterpiece that combines fun and challenge, and embark on your own brain-training journey.

The Cropsies are back and they're bigger than ever! 
Rancid Raccoon is up to his old tricks again. Ruining the harmony of rural life by winning all of the Country Shows and claiming the prize money for his sneaky self. The Farm Heroes know he's cheating and it's up to you to help them defeat him. 
IARC rating: 3+
Help them in their mission to grow the biggest Super Cropsies, win the Country Show and stop Rancid ruining the fun for everyone.
Move through this Farmtastic Saga while collecting as many Cropsies as you can! You can help Fidget the squirrel gather his nuts, grow some Super Cropsies and meet a host of exciting characters along the way! But be careful, Rancid the Raccoon is trying to stop you and he'll pop up where you least expect him... 
Take on this Croptastic Saga alone or play with friends to see who can get the highest score!

• Exciting new Country Show! See who can grow the biggest Cropsie!
• Collect Cropsies in hundreds of amazing new game levels
• Switcher game that is easy and fun to play, yet challenging to fully master
• Farmtastic game modes and new super sized Cropsies!
• Have the best and biggest Super Cropsies in all the land to win the Country Show!
• A host of new Heroes, but watch out for Rancid Raccoon, he causes mischief where you least expect!

Browse websites, check your emails, upload photos, post on your social networks, get in touch with friends, do your work, research, shop, do anything you want in parallel at the same time!

- Optimize your time

- Fast & secure
Split View uses the most modern web frameworks to deliver a fast and secure experience for everyone!

Split View is now available for all iOS devices!

bluejetty:00031232:ios.description:
Adorable Pets Await in Duet Friends: Pet Music Games - Your Ultimate Animal Duet Adventure!
If you're searching for the perfect blend of cuteness and musical fun, look no further than Duet Friends: Pet Music Games! This pet game sensation of 2023 combines the joy of adorable pets, soulful duets, and charming gameplay to create an irresistible gaming experience.
Embrace the World of Adorable Pets
In Duet Friends, you'll step into a world filled with irresistibly cute animals. From fluffy kittens and playful puppies to mischievous hamsters, the animal cafe is a paradise for pet lovers. These adorable creatures are not just pets; they're your partners in harmonious duets, and they can't wait to sing along with you!
Key Features That Will Melt Your Heart:
- Engaging Gameplay: Challenge your skills with furry pet duets that require precise timing and coordination. The duet aspect of the game adds a unique twist to traditional pet games, keeping you engaged and entertained.
- Collect a Menagerie of Cuties: Visit the animal cafe and expand your collection of cute kitties, hamsters, and dogs. Each pet comes with its own distinct personality and musical talents, making every duet a delightful surprise.
- Groovy Soundtrack: Enjoy remixes of popular songs as the background music for your pets. Whether you're playing for your cats, dogs, or bunnies, the soothing melodies will enhance your gameplay experience.
Why Duet Friends: Pet Music Games Will Become Your Top Pick:
1. Aesthetic Delights: Immerse yourself in a world of aesthetic games and charming graphics. The delightful combination of adorable pets and catchy tunes creates an atmosphere that's both relaxing and visually appealing. Your dogs and cats will be captivated by the game's charming aesthetics.
2. Heartwarming Stories: Bond with your pet buddies through various activities such as bunny pop, pet music sessions, and collecting pet widgets. As you embark on friendship-filled adventures, you'll uncover heartwarming stories that deepen your connection with these lovable creatures.
3. Endless Entertainment: Unleash your creativity and showcase your affection for your furry friends by engaging in various games with cats, dogs, and other adorable animals. Duet Friends offers an array of activities to keep you entertained for hours on end.
4. Expand Your Pet Crew: Visit the hamster kaufen zoohandlung within the game and find the perfect hamster companion to join your singing pet crew. With cats, hamsters, and dogs, you'll create a diverse and adorable ensemble of singing pets.
5. Join the Community: Connect with fellow players who share your passion for pet games, duets, and all things cute. Share your experiences, tips, and adorable pet stories within the Duet Friends community.
Don't miss the opportunity to embark on a musical adventure filled with singing, adorable pets, and heartwarming tales. Duet Friends: Pet Music Games is not just a game; it's an enchanting journey into the world of harmonious duets and lovable companions. Download the game now and let the harmony of friendship and music fill your gaming experience.
Discover the joy of adorable pet duets, explore the cute and aesthetic world of Duet Friends, and create unforgettable memories with your singing pets. Join the fun today!

bluejetty:00133178:ios.description:
Kids game "Music for kids" game, designed specifically for toddlers of 3-5 years old! This fun educational game features four cute and talented musicians - a monkey, a racoon, a frog, and a cat, who are all musicians! The game's primary aim is to help children explore and develop their musical interests!
Be a real DJ in a studio! Conduct and play with a funny four-musicians band! Use guitars - bass and electric ones, feel the rhythm with a fully-equipped drum set, use vocals and backing vocals and also play the keyboard! 
We made the gameplay of our game "Music for kids" straightforward and intuitive, perfect for young players. 
How to play our musical kids game:
In our fun musical game kids can play on a piano, a bass guitar, a drum set, and microphones. The screen displays the four musicians animals playing their music instruments, creating a mini four-piece band!
Act as a conductor and enjoy fun music! Kids choose which instrument or musician will play at any given time. Kids can select the piano button to hear the frog playing the piano, or push the drum set button to hear the racoon drumming away!
In addition to instrument selection, kids can also choose a microphone button, allowing them to hear one animal singing while the other animals continue to play their instruments! What a super vocalize a cat makes - check it! We’ve implemented this feature to encourage children to explore their creative side and experiment with different sound combinations.
Add special effects too, just push the buttons with confetti and salute! 
Parents Corner in our fun mucical game for kids. Visit the Parents’ Corner to manage the sound and language settings, ensuring that your child's gaming process is enjoyable and safe. Additionally, you can choose a subscription plan to play with no ads and even without Internet.
Try out fun musical game the Music for kids - a great music game for kids! The game is a super option for little kids and preschoolers who like music and music instruments! 
Educational and entertaining game designed to help young children develop their musical interests. With its cute animal characters, intuitive gameplay, and customizable settings, "Music for kids" is a perfect introduction to the world of music!

and on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/gokidsapps/

bluejetty:00039688:ios.name: The Daily Office
bluejetty:00039688:ios.summary: Pray Morning, Midday, Evening, and Compline (bedtime) prayer from the Book of Common Prayer (2019), every day, wherever you are. The Daily Office sets out each office on one page, in order: no flipping between sections, no looking up readin
bluejetty:00039688:ios.description:
Pray Morning, Midday, Evening, and Compline (bedtime) prayer from the Book of Common Prayer (2019), every day, wherever you are. The Daily Office sets out each office on one page, in order: no flipping between sections, no looking up readings in the lectionary, no rubrics to decode.
Join Christians around the world in the pattern of daily prayer the Church has kept since its earliest days.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Morning Prayer, Midday Prayer, Evening Prayer, and Compline for every day of the year
• Family Prayer: shorter devotions in the same pattern, for households with children
• The day's readings on their own, for Morning and Evening Prayer and the Holy Eucharist
• The whole Psalter, searchable and arranged by topic, in contemporary or traditional language
• Collects for the Christian year, the offices, and many occasions
• The Great Litany
• A calendar of the Christian year, with every feast, fast, and commemoration in its liturgical color
• Lives of the saints, with traditions and further reading for each commemoration
PRAY ANYWHERE, EVEN OFFLINE
The days ahead download on their own, up to two months of the offices, Family Prayer, and the readings for your settings, so you can pray on a plane, on retreat, or anywhere without a signal. Keep the spoken office for today and tomorrow too, and the app refreshes your downloads in the background.
PRAY ALONG WITH AUDIO
Every office can be read aloud, with each word highlighted as it is spoken. Audio keeps playing with your screen locked, and you can pause, skip, and scrub from the lock screen or your headphones.
BOOK VIEW
Pray an office one page at a time, turning the pages like a printed prayer book, with nothing else on the screen. On iPhone Duo, open it like a book and the office opens to two pages, one on each side of the fold.
PODCASTS
Prefer your podcast app? Subscribe to Morning and Evening Prayer and the daily readings, or make a podcast with your own settings.
MAKE IT YOURS
• Light, sepia, and dark themes, or follow your device
• Six typefaces, including the Caslon of the 2019 prayer book, Garamond, Baskerville, and a hyperlegible face for low vision
• Any text size, with rubrics in italic or red
• Every choice the rubrics allow: a 30- or 60-day psalter, a one- or two-year lectionary, canticles, the Traditional Language edition, and more
• Bible translations including the ESV, KJV, RSV, NASB, NIV, and NABRE
PRAY TOGETHER
Share your settings with a link or QR code, so a household, small group, or congregation can pray the same office together, in the same room or online.
FAITHFUL TO THE BOOK
The Daily Office carefully follows the text, calendar, and rubrics of the Book of Common Prayer (2019) of the Anglican Church in North America. It is an independent project, generously supported by Anglican House Publishers, publisher of the 2019 prayer book. It is not a substitute for the printed book, but a faithful companion to it: at home, at work, or on the road.
Free, with no ads and no account required. Your settings and downloads are kept on your device.
Questions, corrections, or ideas? Write to feedback@dailyoffice2019.com. We read every message.
